terms.en: Fruit, kaṣāya rasa, rūkṣa, uṣṇa vīrya, madhura vipāka; pacifies kapha and pitta, good for eyes, voice and hair; one of the triphalā. Its seed kernel is mildly intoxicating.
terms.hi: बिभीतकी (बहेड़ा) - कषाय, रूक्ष, उष्ण वीर्य; कफ-पित्तहर, नेत्र-स्वर-केश हितकर; त्रिफला का अंग।

terms.en: The 'three fruits': harītakī, bibhītakī and āmalakī (usually in equal parts). Tridoṣa-balancing, mild laxative, cakṣuṣya (good for eyes) and rasāyana.
terms.hi: त्रिफला - हरीतकी, बिभीतकी, आमलकी (समभाग); त्रिदोषशामक, मृदु विरेचक, चक्षुष्य, रसायन।
terms.modern: Polyherbal combination of three Terminalia/Phyllanthus fruits.

terms.en: Long pepper fruit; kaṭu rasa, madhura vipāka, vīrya described as not very hot (anuṣṇa); dīpana, kāsa-śvāsahara, rasāyana (vardhamāna pippalī rasāyana). Its root (pippalīmūla) is also used.
terms.hi: पिप्पली - कटु रस, मधुर विपाक, अनुष्णशीत; दीपन, कास-श्वासहर, रसायन (वर्धमान पिप्पली)।
terms.modern: Piper longum L., Piperaceae (fruit); contains piperine.

terms.en: Black pepper; kaṭu rasa, laghu, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa vīrya, kaṭu vipāka; dīpana, chedana, pramāthī, kaphahara, krimighna.
terms.hi: मरिच (काली मिर्च) - कटु, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण वीर्य; दीपन, छेदन, कफहर।

terms.en: Dried ginger rhizome; kaṭu rasa, uṣṇa vīrya, madhura vipāka; dīpana, pācana, grāhī, vātakaphahara; called mahauṣadha and viśvabheṣaja ('universal medicine'). Fresh ginger is ārdraka.
terms.hi: शुण्ठी (सोंठ) - कटु, उष्ण वीर्य, मधुर विपाक; दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही; महौषध, विश्वभेषज।

terms.en: Fresh ginger; kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, bhedana; taking it with rock salt before meals is advised to improve appetite and cleanse throat and tongue.
terms.hi: आर्द्रक (अदरक) - कटु, उष्ण; दीपन; भोजन से पहले सैन्धव के साथ लेना हितकर।

terms.en: The 'three pungents': śuṇṭhī, marica and pippalī in equal parts; dīpana, pācana, kaphahara, used for āma, obesity and respiratory disorders.
terms.hi: त्रिकटु - शुण्ठी, मरिच, पिप्पली (समभाग); दीपन, पाचन, कफहर।
terms.modern: Combination of ginger, black pepper and long pepper; piperine enhances absorption of some drugs.

terms.en: Rhizome; tikta-kaṭu, rūkṣa, uṣṇa vīrya, kaṭu vipāka; kuṣṭhaghna, pramehaghna, varṇya, viṣaghna, vraṇaropaṇa. Caraka names haridrā in several mahākaṣāyas.
terms.hi: हरिद्रा (हल्दी) - तिक्त-कटु, रूक्ष, उष्ण वीर्य; कुष्ठघ्न, प्रमेहघ्न, वर्ण्य, विषघ्न।
terms.modern: Curcuma longa L., Zingiberaceae (rhizome); curcuminoids are its main studied constituents.

terms.en: 'Wood turmeric'; tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa; used in eye, skin and liver disorders, prameha and wounds. Its aqueous extract is rasāñjana.
terms.hi: दारुहरिद्रा - तिक्त-कषाय, उष्ण; नेत्र, त्वचा, प्रमेह, व्रण में; इसका घन सत्त्व रसाञ्जन।
terms.modern: Berberis aristata DC., Berberidaceae (stem/root); contains berberine.

terms.en: Tikta-kaṣāya, laghu, śīta vīrya, kaṭu vipāka; kuṣṭhaghna, kaṇḍūghna, krimighna, jvaraghna, pacifies pitta and kapha; leaves, bark and oil are used.
terms.hi: निम्ब (नीम) - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत वीर्य; कुष्ठघ्न, कण्डूघ्न, कृमिघ्न, ज्वरघ्न; कफ-पित्तशामक।

terms.en: Kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kāsa-śvāsahara, krimighna, jvaraghna, pacifies kapha and vāta; also called surasā.
terms.hi: तुलसी (सुरसा) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; कास-श्वासहर, कृमिघ्न, ज्वरघ्न; कफ-वातशामक।
terms.modern: Ocimum tenuiflorum L. (syn. O. sanctum L.), Lamiaceae.

terms.en: Medhya herb used for memory, intellect, anxiety and epilepsy; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta. Its identity is debated: Bacopa monnieri is the official brāhmī in most of India, while some traditions apply the name to Centella asiatica (maṇḍūkaparṇī).
terms.hi: ब्राह्मी - मेध्य; स्मृति, बुद्धि, अपस्मार, उन्माद में; पहचान पर मतभेद (बकोपा बनाम मण्डूकपर्णी)।
terms.modern: Bacopa monnieri (L.) Pennell, Plantaginaceae (official Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia source); Centella asiatica in some regions.

terms.en: 'Frog-leaf'; its juice is the first of Caraka's four medhya rasāyanas; also used for skin disease and wound healing.
terms.hi: मण्डूकपर्णी - मेंढक-पत्र जैसी; इसका स्वरस चरक का प्रथम मेध्य रसायन।

terms.en: 'Conch-flowered'; medhya rasāyana (Caraka uses its paste), also used for insomnia and anxiety. Several plants are sold under this name.
terms.hi: शङ्खपुष्पी - शंख जैसे फूल वाली; मेध्य रसायन; पहचान पर मतभेद।
terms.modern: Convolvulus pluricaulis Choisy (official source); Evolvulus alsinoides and Clitoria ternatea are also used as śaṅkhapuṣpī regionally.

terms.en: 'Sweet stick'; madhura, guru, snigdha, śīta, madhura vipāka; kaṇṭhya, varṇya, vraṇaropaṇa, medhya (powder with milk is a medhya rasāyana), pacifies vāta and pitta. Also called madhuka.
terms.hi: यष्टिमधु (मुलेठी, मधुक) - मधुर, शीत; कण्ठ्य, वर्ण्य, व्रणरोपण, मेध्य; वात-पित्तशामक।
terms.modern: Glycyrrhiza glabra L., Fabaceae (root/stolon); excess use can raise blood pressure (glycyrrhizin).

terms.en: Bark drug; kaṣāya, śīta; hṛdya (cardiotonic), bhagna-sandhānakara (fracture-healing), used in raktapitta, prameha and wounds. Also called kakubha.
terms.hi: अर्जुन (ककुभ) - छाल; कषाय, शीत; हृद्य, भग्नसन्धानकर, रक्तपित्त, प्रमेह में।
terms.modern: Terminalia arjuna (Roxb. ex DC.) Wight & Arn., Combretaceae (bark).

terms.en: 'That which renews again' (the plant revives each rainy season); uṣṇa; śothaghna (anti-oedema), mūtrala, rasāyana; used in śotha, pāṇḍu and udara.
terms.hi: पुनर्नवा - 'पुनः नई होने वाली'; उष्ण; शोथघ्न, मूत्रल, रसायन; शोथ, पाण्डु, उदर में।

terms.en: Spiny fruit (śvadaṃṣṭrā); madhura, śīta, madhura vipāka; mūtrala, aśmarībhedana, vṛṣya, used in mūtrakṛcchra and aśmarī. A member of laghu pañcamūla.
terms.hi: गोक्षुर (गोखरू, श्वदंष्ट्रा) - मधुर, शीत; मूत्रल, अश्मरीभेदन, वृष्य; लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग।

terms.en: Herb named 'strength'; madhura, snigdha, śīta; balya, vātahara, used in vātavyādhi and debility (e.g. balā taila). Not to be confused with bala (strength) or bāla (child).
terms.hi: बला - मधुर, स्निग्ध, शीत; बल्य, वातहर; वातव्याधि में (बला तैल)।

terms.en: Bark is tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; Caraka names it the best drug for checking diarrhoea and drying kapha, pitta and blood; seeds are indrayava.
terms.hi: कुटज - छाल तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; अतिसार में श्रेष्ठ (चरक अग्र्य); बीज इन्द्रयव।
terms.modern: Holarrhena pubescens Wall. ex G.Don (syn. H. antidysenterica), Apocynaceae (bark).

terms.en: Unripe fruit is dīpana, pācana and grāhī (for diarrhoea and grahaṇī); root is a member of bṛhat pañcamūla (daśamūla).
terms.hi: बिल्व (बेल) - कच्चा फल दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही (अतिसार, ग्रहणी); मूल बृहत् पञ्चमूल में।

terms.en: Rhizome; kaṭu-tikta, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa; medhya, lekhana, vāmaka in larger dose, used in speech, memory and epilepsy disorders. Named for promoting speech (vāc).
terms.hi: वचा (बच) - कटु-तिक्त, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण; मेध्य, लेखन, अधिक मात्रा में वामक; वाणी और स्मृति हेतु।
terms.modern: Acorus calamus L., Acoraceae (rhizome); contains β-asarone, a toxicity concern with long-term use.

terms.en: Hairy rhizome; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; medhya, nidrājanana, saṃjñāsthāpana (restores consciousness), used in insomnia, anxiety and unmāda.
terms.hi: जटामांसी - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; मेध्य, निद्राजनक, संज्ञास्थापन।
terms.modern: Nardostachys jatamansi (D.Don) DC., Caprifoliaceae (rhizome); a threatened Himalayan species.

terms.en: Root; tikta, uṣṇa; nidrājanana and used in unmāda and high blood pressure; traditionally also used for snakebite.
terms.hi: सर्पगन्धा - तिक्त, उष्ण; निद्राजनक, उन्माद व उच्च रक्तचाप में।
terms.modern: Rauvolfia serpentina (L.) Benth. ex Kurz, Apocynaceae (root); source of reserpine.

terms.en: Root; kaṭu, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa; Caraka's best drug for dīpana-pācana and for gudaśotha, arśas and śūla; strongly irritant (used after śodhana).
terms.hi: चित्रक - कटु, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण; दीपन-पाचन में श्रेष्ठ, अर्श, शूल में।
terms.modern: Plumbago zeylanica L., Plumbaginaceae (root); contains plumbagin.

terms.en: Leaf pulp; tikta-madhura, picchila, śīta; bhedana, used in liver and menstrual disorders and burns; dried leaf exudate is kumārīsāra.
terms.hi: कुमारी (घृतकुमारी, ग्वारपाठा) - तिक्त-मधुर, पिच्छिल, शीत; भेदन, यकृत व आर्तव विकारों में।
terms.modern: Aloe vera (L.) Burm.f. (syn. A. barbadensis Mill.), Asphodelaceae.

terms.en: Oleo-gum resin; laghu, viśada, sūkṣma, uṣṇa; lekhana and vātahara. Caraka names it the best for medas and vāta; fresh guggulu is bṛṃhaṇa while old guggulu is lekhana. Base of guggulu kalpanās (e.g. yogarāja guggulu).
terms.hi: गुग्गुलु - गोंद-राल; लघु, विशद, सूक्ष्म, उष्ण; लेखन, वातहर; मेद व वात में श्रेष्ठ; नया बृंहण, पुराना लेखन।
terms.modern: Commiphora wightii (Arn.) Bhandari (syn. C. mukul), Burseraceae (oleo-gum resin).

terms.en: Tuber; tikta-kaṭu-kaṣāya, śīta; Caraka's best for sāṅgrāhika (binding), dīpana and pācana; also jvaraghna and tṛṣṇānigrahaṇa.
terms.hi: मुस्ता (मोथा) - तिक्त-कटु-कषाय, शीत; ग्राही, दीपन, पाचन में श्रेष्ठ; ज्वरघ्न।

terms.en: Whole plant; intensely tikta, śīta; jvaraghna, used in fevers, skin disease and liver disorders.
terms.hi: किराततिक्त (चिरायता) - अति तिक्त, शीत; ज्वरघ्न, त्वचा व यकृत विकारों में।

terms.en: Rhizome; tikta, śīta; bhedana (Śārṅgadhara's example), dīpana, used in jvara, kāmalā and liver disorders.
terms.hi: कटुकी (कुटकी) - तिक्त, शीत; भेदन, दीपन; ज्वर, कामला, यकृत विकार में।
terms.modern: Picrorhiza kurroa Royle ex Benth., Plantaginaceae (rhizome).

terms.en: Marking-nut fruit; uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; arśoghna, rasāyana and used in kuṣṭha and vāta-kapha disorders. Must undergo śodhana; its juice causes severe contact dermatitis.
terms.hi: भल्लातक (भिलावा) - उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; अर्शोघ्न, रसायन; शोधन आवश्यक; त्वचा पर फफोले करता है।

terms.en: Root: madhura, uṣṇa; Caraka's best for vṛṣya (virility) and vātahara. Seed oil (eraṇḍa taila) is a virecana drug, esteemed for āmavāta and in sukha-virecana.
terms.hi: एरण्ड (अरण्डी) - मूल मधुर, उष्ण; वृष्य, वातहर में श्रेष्ठ; तैल विरेचक, आमवात में।
terms.modern: Ricinus communis L., Euphorbiaceae; seeds contain the toxin ricin (removed in oil).

terms.en: Root; the best drug for comfortable purgation (sukha-virecana) per Caraka and the chief virecana drug in AH.kalpa.1.1; Śārṅgadhara's example of recana.
terms.hi: त्रिवृत् (निशोथ) - मूल; सुखविरेचन में श्रेष्ठ; रेचन का उदाहरण।
terms.modern: Operculina turpethum (L.) Silva Manso (syn. Ipomoea turpethum), Convolvulaceae (root).

terms.en: Purgative root; Vāgbhaṭa's example of prabhāva: similar to citraka in rasa etc., yet dantī purges.
terms.hi: दन्ती - विरेचक मूल; प्रभाव का उदाहरण (चित्रक के समान होकर भी विरेचक)।

terms.en: Fruit; the best emetic drug (vamana-śreṣṭha) per Vāgbhaṭa and Caraka; Śārṅgadhara's example of vāmaka.
terms.hi: मदनफल (मैनफल) - वमन हेतु श्रेष्ठ द्रव्य।
terms.modern: Catunaregam spinosa (Thunb.) Tirveng. (syn. Randia dumetorum), Rubiaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Leaf; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; the leading drug for raktapitta and also for kāsa and śvāsa.
terms.hi: वासा (अडूसा) - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; रक्तपित्त, कास, श्वास में श्रेष्ठ।
terms.modern: Justicia adhatoda L. (syn. Adhatoda vasica Nees), Acanthaceae (leaf); contains vasicine.

terms.en: Root; madhura-tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa; varṇya, viṣaghna, rakta-prasādana, used in kuṣṭha and wounds.
terms.hi: मञ्जिष्ठा - मधुर-तिक्त-कषाय, उष्ण; वर्ण्य, रक्तप्रसादन, विषघ्न, कुष्ठ में।

terms.en: Root; madhura-tikta, śīta; rakta-śodhaka, dāha-praśamana, jvarahara, used in skin disease and burning sensation.
terms.hi: सारिवा (अनन्तमूल) - मधुर-तिक्त, शीत; रक्तशोधक, दाहप्रशमन, ज्वरहर।

terms.en: Heartwood (śveta candana); tikta-madhura, śīta; dāha-praśamana, varṇya, tṛṣṇāhara, used in pitta disorders.
terms.hi: चन्दन (श्वेत) - तिक्त-मधुर, शीत; दाहप्रशमन, वर्ण्य, पित्तशामक।

terms.en: Root; tikta-madhura, śīta; dāha-praśamana, tṛṣṇā-nigrahaṇa, sveda-reducing; used in pānīya (medicated drinking water).
terms.hi: उशीर (खस) - तिक्त-मधुर, शीत; दाहशामक, तृष्णानिग्रहण।
terms.modern: Chrysopogon zizanioides (L.) Roberty (syn. Vetiveria zizanioides), Poaceae (root).

terms.en: Bark; kaṣāya, śīta; grāhī, cakṣuṣya, śoṇitasthāpana; used in pradara and other yoni disorders.
terms.hi: लोध्र - कषाय, शीत; ग्राही, चक्षुष्य, रक्तस्तम्भक; प्रदर में।

terms.en: Bark; kaṣāya-tikta, śīta; used in excessive uterine bleeding (asṛgdara) and other gynaecological disorders. Name means 'without sorrow'.
terms.hi: अशोक - छाल; कषाय-तिक्त, शीत; असृग्दर (प्रदर) में प्रसिद्ध।
terms.modern: Saraca asoca (Roxb.) Willd., Fabaceae (bark); commonly adulterated with Polyalthia longifolia.

terms.en: Heartwood; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; Caraka's best drug for kuṣṭha; also used for dental and oral health (catechu).
terms.hi: खदिर (कत्था) - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; कुष्ठघ्न में श्रेष्ठ; दन्त-मुख रोगों में।
terms.modern: Senegalia catechu (L.f.) P.J.H.Hurter & Mabb. (syn. Acacia catechu (L.f.) Willd.), Fabaceae.

terms.en: Seed oil, bark and leaves; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kuṣṭhaghna, krimighna, vraṇaśodhana; twigs used as tooth-brush.
terms.hi: करञ्ज - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; कुष्ठघ्न, कृमिघ्न, व्रणशोधन; दातुन हेतु।
terms.modern: Pongamia pinnata (L.) Pierre (syn. Millettia pinnata), Fabaceae.

terms.en: Fruit; kaṭu, uṣṇa; Caraka's best anthelmintic (krimighna); also dīpana.
terms.hi: विडङ्ग (वायविडंग) - कटु, उष्ण; कृमिघ्न में श्रेष्ठ।

terms.en: Oleo-gum resin; kaṭu, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa; Caraka's best for chedana, dīpana, vātānulomana and relieving vāta-kapha; used for colic and flatulence (after frying/śodhana).
terms.hi: हिङ्गु (हींग) - कटु, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण; छेदन, दीपन, वातानुलोमन में श्रेष्ठ; उदरशूल में।

terms.en: Seed; kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, pācana, grāhī; used in indigestion, diarrhoea and grahaṇī.
terms.hi: जीरक (जीरा) - कटु, उष्ण; दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही।

terms.en: Fruit; dīpana, pācana, tṛṣṇā- and dāha-reducing, mūtrala; Bhāvaprakāśa calls it uṣṇa while fresh leaves are regarded as cooling.
terms.hi: धान्यक (धनिया) - दीपन, पाचन, तृष्णा-दाहशामक, मूत्रल।

terms.en: Small cardamom (sūkṣmailā); kaṭu-madhura, śīta; rocana, chardinigrahaṇa, mukhaśodhana; one of trijātaka.
terms.hi: एला (छोटी इलायची) - कटु-मधुर, शीत; रोचन, छर्दिनिग्रहण; त्रिजातक का अंग।

terms.en: Flower bud; tikta-kaṭu, laghu; rocana, dīpana, used in cough, hiccup, toothache and vomiting.
terms.hi: लवङ्ग (लौंग) - तिक्त-कटु, लघु; रोचन, दीपन; कास, हिक्का, दन्तशूल में।
terms.modern: Syzygium aromaticum (L.) Merr. & L.M.Perry, Myrtaceae (flower bud); contains eugenol.

terms.en: Bark; kaṭu-tikta-madhura, uṣṇa; dīpana, kapha-vātahara, mukhaśodhana; one of trijātaka. Also the word for skin (see tvak-skin).
terms.hi: त्वक् (दालचीनी) - कटु-मधुर, उष्ण; दीपन, कफ-वातहर; त्रिजातक का अंग। (त्वक् = त्वचा भी)
terms.modern: Cinnamomum verum J.Presl (syn. C. zeylanicum Blume), Lauraceae (bark).

terms.en: Group of three aromatics: tvak (cinnamon), elā (cardamom) and tejapatra (Indian bay leaf); adding nāgakeśara makes caturjātaka.
terms.hi: त्रिजातक - त्वक्, एला, तेजपत्र; नागकेशर मिलाने पर चातुर्जातक।

terms.en: Stamens/flowers; kaṣāya-tikta; pācana (Śārṅgadhara's example), used in bleeding piles and raktapitta; member of caturjātaka.
terms.hi: नागकेशर - कषाय-तिक्त; पाचन का उदाहरण; रक्तार्श और रक्तपित्त में।
terms.modern: Mesua ferrea L., Calophyllaceae (stamens); market samples vary.

terms.en: The 'ten roots': bṛhat pañcamūla (bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā, gambhārī) plus laghu pañcamūla (śālaparṇī, pṛśniparṇī, bṛhatī, kaṇṭakārī, gokṣura). Tridoṣahara, especially vātahara, śothahara; used in daśamūla kvātha and ariṣṭa.
terms.hi: दशमूल - बृहत् पञ्चमूल (बिल्व, अग्निमन्थ, श्योनाक, पाटला, गम्भारी) + लघु पञ्चमूल (शालपर्णी, पृश्निपर्णी, बृहती, कण्टकारी, गोक्षुर); वातहर, शोथहर।

terms.en: Roots of five trees: bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā and gambhārī; uṣṇa, kapha-vātahara.
terms.hi: बृहत् पञ्चमूल - पाँच वृक्षों की जड़: बिल्व, अग्निमन्थ, श्योनाक, पाटला, गम्भारी।

terms.en: Roots of five small plants: śālaparṇī, pṛśniparṇī, bṛhatī, kaṇṭakārī and gokṣura; vāta-pittahara, bṛṃhaṇa.
terms.hi: लघु पञ्चमूल - शालपर्णी, पृश्निपर्णी, बृहती, कण्टकारी, गोक्षुर।

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla; uṣṇa, śothahara, vāta-kaphahara; its wood was used to kindle fire by friction, hence the name.
terms.hi: अग्निमन्थ (अरणी) - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग; उष्ण, शोथहर।
terms.modern: Premna integrifolia L. (syn. P. serratifolia L.), Lamiaceae; Clerodendrum phlomidis is used in some regions (identity debated).

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla; root bark is grāhī/stambhana and vātahara.
terms.hi: श्योनाक (सोनापाठा) - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग; ग्राही, वातहर।

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla; tridoṣahara, śothahara.
terms.hi: पाटला - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग; शोथहर।
terms.modern: Stereospermum suaveolens (Roxb.) DC. (syn. S. chelonoides), Bignoniaceae.

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla (also kāśmarya); fruit is madhura and bṛṃhaṇa.
terms.hi: गम्भारी (काश्मर्य) - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग।

terms.en: Member of laghu pañcamūla; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kāsa-śvāsahara.
terms.hi: बृहती - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; कास-श्वासहर।
terms.modern: Solanum indicum L. (syn. S. anguivi Lam.), Solanaceae.

terms.en: Thorny member of laghu pañcamūla; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kāsahara (Caraka's list), śvāsahara; used in kaṇṭakārī avaleha/ghṛta.
terms.hi: कण्टकारी (भटकटैया) - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; कासहर, श्वासहर।
terms.modern: Solanum virginianum L. (syn. S. xanthocarpum Schrad. & H.Wendl., S. surattense), Solanaceae.

terms.en: Member of laghu pañcamūla; madhura, guru; tridoṣahara, bṛṃhaṇa, vṛṣya.
terms.hi: शालपर्णी - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; बृंहण, त्रिदोषहर।

terms.en: Member of laghu pañcamūla; tridoṣahara, sandhānīya.
terms.hi: पृश्निपर्णी - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; सन्धानीय।
terms.modern: Uraria picta (Jacq.) Desv. ex DC., Fabaceae.

terms.en: Group of five pungent dīpana-pācana drugs: pippalī, pippalīmūla, cavya, citraka and śuṇṭhī.
terms.hi: पञ्चकोल - पिप्पली, पिप्पलीमूल, चव्य, चित्रक, शुण्ठी; दीपन-पाचन।

terms.en: Group of eight rare Himalayan rejuvenating herbs: jīvaka, ṛṣabhaka, medā, mahāmedā, kākolī, kṣīrakākolī, ṛddhi and vṛddhi. Owing to scarcity and uncertain identity, substitutes (pratinidhi) are permitted (e.g. in Bhāvaprakāśa).
terms.hi: अष्टवर्ग - आठ दुर्लभ हिमालयी रसायन द्रव्य: जीवक, ऋषभक, मेदा, महामेदा, काकोली, क्षीरकाकोली, ऋद्धि, वृद्धि; अभाव में प्रतिनिधि द्रव्य।
terms.modern: Mostly orchids and lilies (e.g. Malaxis, Polygonatum, Habenaria species); identity is debated.

terms.en: Substitute drug permitted when the original is unavailable, chosen for similar properties (e.g. aśvagandhā for medā/mahāmedā in some texts).
terms.hi: प्रतिनिधि द्रव्य - मूल द्रव्य न मिलने पर समान गुण वाला विकल्प।
terms.modern: Comparable to approved substitutes; distinct from adulteration.

terms.en: Seed and seed oil; uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; medhya, used for memory and vāta disorders; also used for its sweat-inducing property.
terms.hi: ज्योतिष्मती (मालकांगनी) - उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; मेध्य।

terms.en: Seed; madhura, guru, snigdha; vājīkaraṇa, balya; pod hairs cause intense itching (hence 'monkey itch'); used in kampavāta.
terms.hi: कपिकच्छु (कौंच) - बीज; मधुर, गुरु; वाजीकरण, बल्य; फली के रोम खुजली करते हैं।
terms.modern: Mucuna pruriens (L.) DC., Fabaceae (seed); contains L-DOPA, studied in Parkinson's disease.

terms.en: Tuber (vidārīkanda); madhura, śīta; balya, stanyajanana, vṛṣya, bṛṃhaṇa.
terms.hi: विदारी (विदारीकन्द) - मधुर, शीत; बल्य, स्तन्यजनन, वृष्य।
terms.modern: Pueraria tuberosa (Willd.) DC., Fabaceae (tuber); Ipomoea mauritiana is also traded as vidārī (identity debated).

terms.en: Root; tikta-kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, pācana, grāhī; widely used in children's diarrhoea, fever and cough. Unlike its relative vatsanābha it is non-toxic, despite the name.
terms.hi: अतिविषा (अतीस) - तिक्त-कटु, उष्ण; दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही; बालरोगों में प्रसिद्ध; विषैली नहीं।
terms.modern: Aconitum heterophyllum Wall. ex Royle, Ranunculaceae (root).

terms.en: Root; tikta, uṣṇa; grāhī, stanyaśodhana, jvaraghna; identity debated.
terms.hi: पाठा - तिक्त, उष्ण; ग्राही, स्तन्यशोधन, ज्वरघ्न।
terms.modern: Cissampelos pareira L., Menispermaceae (commonly accepted); Cyclea peltata used in South India.

terms.en: Caraka's best vātahara drug (agrya); used in vātavyādhi and āmavāta (e.g. rāsnā-saptaka kvātha). Identity varies regionally.
terms.hi: रास्ना - वातहर में श्रेष्ठ; वातव्याधि, आमवात में।
terms.modern: Pluchea lanceolata (DC.) C.B.Clarke (Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia); Alpinia galanga and Vanda roxburghii are used regionally.

terms.en: 'Timber of the gods'; heartwood; tikta, uṣṇa; kapha-vātahara, śothahara, used in vāta disorders and skin disease.
terms.hi: देवदारु - तिक्त, उष्ण; कफ-वातहर, शोथहर।
terms.modern: Cedrus deodara (Roxb. ex D.Don) G.Don, Pinaceae.

terms.en: Leaf; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; vātahara, śothahara, vedanāsthāpana; leaves used for fomentation (patra-piṇḍa sveda) and oil in joint pain.
terms.hi: निर्गुण्डी - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; वातहर, शोथहर, वेदनाशामक; पत्र पिण्ड स्वेद में।

terms.en: Root bark, leaves and seeds; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; śothahara, krimighna, cakṣuṣya, used in vāta-kapha disorders.
terms.hi: शिग्रु (सहजन) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; शोथहर, कृमिघ्न।

terms.en: Oleo-gum resin of the śallakī tree; kaṣāya-tikta; used in joint pain, inflammation and skin disease.
terms.hi: शल्लकी (सलई गुग्गुल) - कषाय-तिक्त; सन्धिशूल व शोथ में।
terms.modern: Boswellia serrata Roxb. ex Colebr., Burseraceae (gum resin); boswellic acids are studied for osteoarthritis.

terms.en: Milky-latex shrub with two varieties (rakta and śveta); uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; latex is an upaviṣa; used externally and in kṣāra preparation. Not to be confused with arka kalpanā (distillate).
terms.hi: अर्क (आक, मदार) - दो प्रकार; उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; दूध उपविष; बाह्य प्रयोग। (अर्क कल्पना से भिन्न)
terms.modern: Calotropis procera (Aiton) Dryand. and C. gigantea (L.) Dryand., Apocynaceae.

terms.en: Latex plant; tīkṣṇa virecana (latex is an upaviṣa and the strongest purgative); latex is used in coating kṣārasūtra.
terms.hi: स्नुही (थूहर) - दूध तीक्ष्ण विरेचक, उपविष; क्षारसूत्र बनाने में।

terms.en: Seeds and leaves; an upaviṣa; madakārī, used after śodhana in śvāsa (as smoking) and painful conditions.
terms.hi: धत्तूर (धतूरा) - उपविष; मदकारी; शोधन के बाद श्वास आदि में।
terms.modern: Datura metel L., Solanaceae; contains tropane alkaloids (hyoscine, atropine), highly toxic.

terms.en: Tuberous root; a highly toxic mahāviṣa (sthāvara viṣa) used only after śodhana (usually in cow's urine) in tiny doses, e.g. in tribhuvanakīrti rasa.
terms.hi: वत्सनाभ (बछनाग) - अति विषैली जड़; केवल शोधन के बाद अल्प मात्रा में।
terms.modern: Aconitum ferox Wall. ex Ser., Ranunculaceae (root); contains aconitine, a cardiotoxin.

terms.en: Seed; an upaviṣa used after śodhana in vāta disorders and as a tonic.
terms.hi: कुपीलु (कुचला) - बीज; उपविष; शोधन के बाद वातव्याधि में।
terms.modern: Strychnos nux-vomica L., Loganiaceae (seed); contains strychnine.

terms.en: Seed; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; grāhī, dīpana, nidrājanana, vājīkaraṇa in small doses; toxic in large doses.
terms.hi: जातीफल (जायफल) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; ग्राही, निद्राजनक; अधिक मात्रा विषैली।

terms.en: Seeds are krimighna; flowers, bark and kṣāra are used (palāśa kṣāra).
terms.hi: पलाश (ढाक) - बीज कृमिघ्न; पुष्प, छाल, क्षार का प्रयोग।

terms.en: Whole plant; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; used in kṣāra preparation (apāmārga kṣāra, also for kṣārasūtra), śirovirecana, and as a tooth-brush.
terms.hi: अपामार्ग (चिरचिटा) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; क्षार बनाने में, शिरोविरेचन में।

terms.en: 'King of hair'; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; keśya (hair tonic), rasāyana, used in liver disorders and greying.
terms.hi: भृङ्गराज (भांगरा) - केश्य, रसायन; यकृत विकार और पलित में।
terms.modern: Eclipta prostrata (L.) L. (syn. E. alba (L.) Hassk.), Asteraceae.

terms.en: Grass; madhura-tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; śoṇitasthāpana (stops bleeding), dāhapraśamana; white variety (śatavīryā/sahasravīryā) in prajāsthāpana group.
terms.hi: दूर्वा (दूब) - शीत; रक्तस्तम्भक, दाहशामक; प्रजास्थापन वर्ग में।

terms.en: Bulb with five rasas (all except amla), kaṭu predominant; uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; vātahara, rasāyana, used in vāta disorders, heart disease and worms. Also called rasona.
terms.hi: लशुन (लहसुन, रसोन) - अम्ल छोड़ पाँच रस, कटु प्रधान; उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; वातहर, रसायन।

terms.en: Root; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; Caraka's best for hikkā, śvāsa, kāsa and pārśvaśūla.
terms.hi: पुष्करमूल - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; हिक्का, श्वास, कास, पार्श्वशूल में श्रेष्ठ।

terms.en: Bark; kaṣāya, śīta; used in gaṇḍamālā, galagaṇḍa and granthi (kāñcanāra guggulu).
terms.hi: काञ्चनार (कचनार) - छाल; कषाय, शीत; गण्डमाला, गलगण्ड, ग्रन्थि में।

terms.en: Bark; tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa; aśmarībhedana, mūtrala; used for urinary stones.
terms.hi: वरुण - छाल; अश्मरीभेदन, मूत्रल।
terms.modern: Crateva nurvala Buch.-Ham. (syn. C. magna (Lour.) DC.), Capparaceae (bark).

terms.en: 'Stone-breaker'; mūtrala, aśmarībhedana; in Caraka's mūtravirecanīya group. Several plants are used under this name.
terms.hi: पाषाणभेद - 'पत्थर तोड़ने वाला'; अश्मरीभेदन, मूत्रल।
terms.modern: Bergenia ciliata (Haw.) Sternb., Saxifragaceae (commonly accepted); identity debated.

terms.en: Fruit; sweet variety is tridoṣahara, sour variety pacifies vāta-kapha; hṛdya, grāhī; rind used in diarrhoea.
terms.hi: दाडिम (अनार) - मधुर प्रकार त्रिदोषहर; हृद्य, ग्राही।

terms.en: Fruit (mṛdvīkā); madhura, śīta, snigdha; jvarahara, kāsahara, used in tṛṣṇā, dāha and raktapitta; basis of drākṣāriṣṭa/drākṣāsava.
terms.hi: द्राक्षा (मुनक्का, मृद्वीका) - मधुर, शीत; ज्वरहर, कासहर, तृष्णा व दाह में।

terms.en: Aromatic root; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; vāta-kaphahara, used in kāsa, śvāsa and skin conditions. Not to be confused with kuṣṭha the disease.
terms.hi: कुष्ठ (कूठ) - सुगन्धित मूल; कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; वात-कफहर। (कुष्ठ रोग से भिन्न)
terms.modern: Saussurea costus (Falc.) Lipsch. (syn. S. lappa), Asteraceae (root); CITES-listed.

terms.en: Silk-cotton tree; its gum (mocarasa) is grāhī and śoṇitasthāpana.
terms.hi: शाल्मली (सेमल) - गोंद मोचरस ग्राही व रक्तस्तम्भक।

terms.en: Flowers; kaṣāya, śīta; grāhī; also the classical fermentation starter in āsava-ariṣṭa preparation.
terms.hi: धातकी (धाय) - पुष्प कषाय, शीत, ग्राही; आसव-अरिष्ट में किण्वन हेतु।

terms.en: Seed; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kuṣṭhaghna, especially used in śvitra (vitiligo).
terms.hi: बाकुची (बावची) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; श्वित्र में प्रसिद्ध।
terms.modern: Psoralea corylifolia L. (syn. Cullen corylifolium), Fabaceae (seed); contains psoralens (photosensitising).

terms.en: Fruit pulp; madhura, śīta; mild laxative (Śārṅgadhara's example of sraṃsana), kuṣṭhaghna, jvaraghna; safe for children and the weak.
terms.hi: आरग्वध (अमलतास) - फल-मज्जा मधुर, शीत; स्रंसन, कुष्ठघ्न।

terms.en: Bark; Caraka's best antidote (viṣaghna); also used in allergic and skin conditions.
terms.hi: शिरीष - विषघ्न में श्रेष्ठ; त्वचा विकारों में।

terms.en: Seed; madhura-tikta-kaṣāya-kaṭu, uṣṇa, snigdha; its oil (tila taila) is the best of oils for abhyaṅga and taila-pāka.
terms.hi: तिल - उष्ण, स्निग्ध; तिल तैल सबसे श्रेष्ठ तैल।

terms.en: Fruit; kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, śūlapraśamana; in Caraka's śūlapraśamana group.
terms.hi: अजमोदा - कटु, उष्ण; दीपन, शूलप्रशमन।
terms.modern: Trachyspermum roxburghianum (DC.) H.Wolff (commonly accepted); Apium graveolens in some texts.

terms.en: Intensely bitter herb used in fever and liver disorders. It is not described in the Bṛhattrayī; it enters later and folk practice (often called bhūnimba).
terms.hi: कालमेघ (भूनिम्ब) - अति तिक्त; ज्वर व यकृत विकार में; बृहत्त्रयी में वर्णित नहीं।

terms.en: 'Foremost': Caraka's list (CS.sutra.25) of the single best drug, food or practice for each purpose, e.g. kuṭaja for diarrhoea, citraka for dīpana, rāsnā for vāta, āmalakī for vayaḥsthāpana.
terms.hi: अग्र्य - सर्वश्रेष्ठ; चरक सूत्र 25 में प्रत्येक कार्य हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ द्रव्य/आचरण की सूची।

terms.en: Iatrochemistry: the science of processing mercury, metals, minerals and gems into medicines. Key texts: Rasaratnasamuccaya, Rasendracūḍāmaṇi, Rasataraṅgiṇī. Taught with bhaiṣajya kalpanā (pharmaceutics).
terms.hi: रसशास्त्र - पारद, धातु, खनिज और रत्नों से औषध निर्माण का शास्त्र; मुख्य ग्रन्थ रसरत्नसमुच्चय, रसतरङ्गिणी।
terms.modern: Comparable to traditional mineral pharmaceutics / iatrochemistry; safety of metal-based drugs depends on proper processing and dose.

terms.en: Mercury, called rasa or pārada; considered the king of rasaśāstra and believed, when processed, to confer health and longevity. Raw mercury is toxic and must undergo saṃskāras. Distinct from rasa (taste) and rasa dhātu.
terms.hi: रस (पारद) - पारा; रसशास्त्र का राजा; कच्चा पारद विषैला, संस्कार के बाद ही प्रयोग।
terms.modern: Mercury (Hg); elemental and inorganic mercury are toxic, so safety concerns are central.

terms.en: Eight purificatory processes of mercury for therapeutic use: svedana, mardana, mūrcchana, utthāpana, pātana, rodhana (bodhana), niyamana and dīpana. Texts describe 18 saṃskāras in all.
terms.hi: अष्टसंस्कार - पारद के आठ शोधन संस्कार: स्वेदन, मर्दन, मूर्च्छन, उत्थापन, पातन, रोधन, नियमन, दीपन।

terms.en: Sublimation/distillation of mercury to separate impurities; three types: ūrdhva (upward), adhaḥ (downward) and tiryak (sideways) pātana. Also used to extract mercury from hiṅgula.
terms.hi: पातन - पारद का ऊर्ध्व, अधः, तिर्यक् पातन (उर्ध्वपातन आदि) द्वारा शोधन।

terms.en: Pharmaceutical purification: processes (heating and quenching, trituration, boiling in specific liquids, etc.) that remove physical and chemical impurities and toxicity and enhance potency. Distinct from śodhana therapy (saṃśodhana).
terms.hi: शोधन - द्रव्य की अशुद्धि और विषाक्तता दूर कर गुण बढ़ाने वाली औषध-निर्माण प्रक्रिया। (संशोधन चिकित्सा से भिन्न)
terms.modern: Comparable to detoxification/purification steps in pharmaceutical processing; e.g. reduces toxic alkaloids in vatsanābha.

terms.en: General purification common to a group, e.g. heating metal sheets red-hot and quenching seven times each in taila, takra, kāñjī, gomūtra and kulattha decoction.
terms.hi: सामान्य शोधन - समूह के लिए सामान्य शोधन; जैसे धातु-पत्र को तपाकर तैल, तक्र, काञ्जी, गोमूत्र, कुलत्थ क्वाथ में सात-सात बार बुझाना।

terms.en: Specific purification prescribed for a particular substance (e.g. gandhaka melted in ghee and poured into milk; vatsanābha boiled in cow's urine).
terms.hi: विशेष शोधन - किसी विशेष द्रव्य के लिए निर्दिष्ट शोधन।

terms.en: 'Killing' a metal or mineral: converting the purified substance into bhasma by trituration with herbal juices and repeated heating in puṭas until it loses metallic properties.
terms.hi: मारण - शुद्ध धातु/खनिज को भावना और पुट द्वारा भस्म बनाना।
terms.modern: Comparable to calcination; produces oxides/sulphides of fine particle size.

terms.en: Assimilation of a metal, mineral or sulphur into mercury by heating (e.g. gandhaka-jāraṇa), increasing the potency of mercury.
terms.hi: जारण - पारद में गन्धक/धातु का पाचन (आत्मसात्) कराना।

terms.en: Process of 'swooning' mercury, making it lose its mobility and form, usually by combining it with sulphur (sagandha) as in kajjalī; also one of the aṣṭasaṃskāras.
terms.hi: मूर्च्छन - पारद को गतिहीन बनाना, प्रायः गन्धक के साथ (कज्जली)।

terms.en: Trituration of a powder with liquid (juice, decoction) until it dries, often repeated many times, to impart properties and fineness.
terms.hi: भावना - चूर्ण को द्रव (स्वरस, क्वाथ) के साथ सूखने तक मर्दन करना।

terms.en: Measured heating unit used in māraṇa: the material in a sealed earthen pot (śarāva-saṃpuṭa) is heated with a fixed quantity of cow-dung cakes. Sizes include mahāpuṭa, gajapuṭa, varāhapuṭa, kukkuṭapuṭa and kapotapuṭa; electric muffle furnaces are now often used.
terms.hi: पुट - मारण हेतु निश्चित मात्रा में ऊष्मा देना (शराव-सम्पुट, उपले); गजपुट, वराहपुट, कुक्कुटपुट, कपोतपुट आदि।
terms.modern: Comparable to controlled calcination; temperature profiles are now standardised with furnaces.

terms.en: A large puṭa: a pit about one rājahasta in each dimension filled with roughly a thousand cow-dung cakes (numbers vary in texts); used for hard metals like lauha and abhraka.
terms.hi: गजपुट - बड़ा पुट; लगभग एक राजहस्त गहरे गड्ढे में लगभग हज़ार उपले (ग्रन्थों में भिन्नता)।

terms.en: A small puṭa using only about eight cow-dung cakes, without a pit; for delicate materials (e.g. some mercurials).
terms.hi: कपोतपुट - छोटा पुट, लगभग आठ उपले, बिना गड्ढे के।

terms.en: Calcined, extremely fine powder (ash) of a purified metal, mineral or gem, made by śodhana and māraṇa with repeated puṭas; must pass bhasma-parīkṣā before use (e.g. svarṇa, lauha, abhraka bhasma).
terms.hi: भस्म - शुद्ध धातु/खनिज/रत्न को शोधन-मारण से बनाया अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म चूर्ण; प्रयोग से पहले परीक्षा।
terms.modern: Often compared to nanoparticle/micro-particle metal oxides and sulphides; toxicity depends on proper processing.

terms.en: Classical quality tests for bhasma: vāritara (floats on water), rekhāpūrṇatva (enters finger lines), niścandratva (no metallic shine), apunarbhava (does not revert to metal), nirutthatva (does not revert or combine with silver), uttama/unāma (floating bhasma bears a grain), nirdhūma, dantāgre kacakacābhāva (no grittiness) and others.
terms.hi: भस्म परीक्षा - वारितर, रेखापूर्णत्व, निश्चन्द्रत्व, अपुनर्भव, निरुत्थ, उत्तम (उनाम), दन्ताग्रे कचकचाभाव आदि।
terms.modern: Comparable to crude tests of particle fineness and completeness of reaction; modern analysis (XRD, SEM, ICP) supplements them.

terms.en: Bhasma test: a pinch sprinkled gently on still water should float, indicating lightness and fineness.
terms.hi: वारितर - भस्म जल पर तैरे तो सूक्ष्म और लघु।
terms.modern: Indicates very fine particles held by surface tension.

terms.en: Extension of vāritara: a rice grain placed on the floating bhasma layer should remain afloat.
terms.hi: उनाम परीक्षा - तैरती भस्म पर चावल का दाना रखने पर भी तैरता रहे।

terms.en: Bhasma test: rubbed between thumb and finger, the bhasma should enter and fill the finger lines (fineness).
terms.hi: रेखापूर्णत्व - अंगूठे-उंगली में मलने पर भस्म अंगुलि-रेखाओं में भर जाए।

terms.en: Bhasma test: absence of metallic lustre (candrikā) when seen in bright light, showing complete conversion.
terms.hi: निश्चन्द्रत्व - तेज प्रकाश में भस्म में धात्विक चमक न हो।

terms.en: Bhasma test: heated with mitra-pañcaka (guḍa, guñjā, ṭaṅkaṇa, madhu, ghṛta), the bhasma should not revert to its metallic state.
terms.hi: अपुनर्भव - मित्रपञ्चक के साथ तपाने पर भस्म पुनः धातु न बने।

terms.en: Bhasma test: heated with a piece of silver, the bhasma should not revert or be absorbed, so the silver's weight stays unchanged.
terms.hi: निरुत्थ - चाँदी के साथ तपाने पर चाँदी का भार न बढ़े।

terms.en: Black, lusterless, fine powder made by triturating purified mercury and sulphur together until no mercury globules are seen; base of many rasauṣadhis (e.g. rasaparpaṭī, kūpīpakva preparations).
terms.hi: कज्जली - शुद्ध पारद और गन्धक को मर्दन कर काजल जैसा काला, चमकहीन चूर्ण।

terms.en: Thin flakes made by melting kajjalī (with or without other drugs) and pressing it between leaves on cow dung; e.g. rasaparpaṭī, used especially in grahaṇī.
terms.hi: पर्पटी - कज्जली को पिघलाकर पत्तों के बीच दबाकर बनाए पतले पत्र; ग्रहणी में (रसपर्पटी)।

terms.en: Preparations made by gradually heating kajjalī in a glass bottle (kūpī) coated with clay, in a sand bath (vālukā yantra), so the product sublimes at the neck or settles at the bottom; e.g. rasasindūra, makaradhvaja.
terms.hi: कूपीपक्व रसायन - कज्जली को काँच की कूपी में वालुका यन्त्र में क्रमिक ताप देकर बनाए योग; जैसे रससिन्दूर।

terms.en: Red sublimate of mercury and sulphur made by the kūpīpakva method; used as a rasāyana and yogavāhī in small doses.
terms.hi: रससिन्दूर - कूपीपक्व विधि से बना पारद-गन्धक का लाल ऊर्ध्वपातित योग।
terms.modern: Mainly red mercuric sulphide (HgS, cinnabar form).

terms.en: Red mineral classed among sādhāraṇa rasas; mercury is extracted from it by ūrdhvapātana (hiṅgulottha pārada).
terms.hi: हिङ्गुल (सिंगरफ) - लाल खनिज; इससे ऊर्ध्वपातन द्वारा पारद निकाला जाता है।

terms.en: Sulphur, chief of the uparasas; purified by melting in ghee and pouring into milk; used in skin diseases and with mercury (kajjalī). Called bali.
terms.hi: गन्धक - उपरस; घी में पिघलाकर दूध में डालकर शोधन; त्वचा रोगों में और पारद के साथ।

terms.en: Mica, a mahārasa; the black (kṛṣṇa) vajra variety is preferred; processed into abhraka bhasma, used as rasāyana and in respiratory disorders.
terms.hi: अभ्रक - महारस; कृष्ण वज्र अभ्रक श्रेष्ठ; अभ्रक भस्म रसायन व श्वास रोग में।
terms.modern: Mica (biotite-type is preferred for black abhraka).

terms.en: Rock exudate that oozes from Himalayan rocks in summer; classed as a mahārasa (Rasaratnasamuccaya) or uparasa in different texts; a celebrated rasāyana, especially in prameha (Caraka: there is no curable disease it cannot cure when properly used).
terms.hi: शिलाजतु (शिलाजीत) - हिमालयी चट्टानों से रिसने वाला पदार्थ; महारस/उपरस; प्रमेह में श्रेष्ठ रसायन।
terms.modern: Complex mixture rich in humic and fulvic acids of plant origin.

terms.en: Group of eight important minerals in Rasaratnasamuccaya: abhraka, vaikrānta, mākṣika, vimala, śilājatu, sasyaka, capala and rasaka. Classifications differ between texts.
terms.hi: महारस - रसरत्नसमुच्चय के अनुसार आठ: अभ्रक, वैक्रान्त, माक्षिक, विमल, शिलाजतु, सस्यक, चपल, रसक।

terms.en: Group of eight secondary minerals in Rasaratnasamuccaya: gandhaka, gairika, kāsīsa, sphaṭikā (alum), haritāla, manaḥśilā, añjana and kaṅkuṣṭha. Classifications differ between texts.
terms.hi: उपरस - आठ: गन्धक, गैरिक, कासीस, स्फटिका, हरिताल, मनःशिला, अञ्जन, कङ्कुष्ठ।

terms.en: Group of eight common minerals in Rasaratnasamuccaya: kampillaka, gaurīpāṣāṇa, navasāra, kapardikā (cowrie), agnijāra, girisindūra, hiṅgula and mṛddāraśṛṅga.
terms.hi: साधारण रस - आठ: कम्पिल्लक, गौरीपाषाण, नवसार, कपर्दिका, अग्निजार, गिरिसिन्दूर, हिङ्गुल, मृद्दारशृङ्ग।

terms.en: Svarṇa mākṣika, a golden mineral among the mahārasas; its bhasma is used in pāṇḍu and as rasāyana.
terms.hi: स्वर्ण माक्षिक - सुनहरा खनिज (महारस); पाण्डु में।

terms.en: Yellow arsenic mineral among the uparasas; used after strict śodhana in skin diseases and fevers; highly toxic.
terms.hi: हरिताल - पीला संखिया खनिज (उपरस); कठोर शोधन के बाद; अति विषैला।

terms.en: Red-orange arsenic mineral among the uparasas; used after śodhana in respiratory disorders and externally; toxic.
terms.hi: मनःशिला (मैनसिल) - लाल-नारंगी संखिया खनिज (उपरस); विषैला।

terms.en: In rasaśāstra, metals: śuddha loha (svarṇa gold, rajata silver, tāmra copper, lauha iron), pūti loha (nāga lead, vaṅga tin) and miśra loha (pittala brass, kāṃsya bronze); yaśada (zinc) is added later. Distinct from body dhātus.
terms.hi: धातु (रसशास्त्र) - शुद्ध लोह: स्वर्ण, रजत, ताम्र, लौह; पूति लोह: नाग, वङ्ग; मिश्र लोह: पित्तल, कांस्य।

terms.en: Gold; its bhasma is used as rasāyana, medhya, hṛdya and to increase ojas; given to newborns in suvarṇaprāśana.
terms.hi: स्वर्ण - सोना; स्वर्ण भस्म रसायन, मेध्य, हृद्य; सुवर्णप्राशन में।

terms.en: Iron (also called loha or ayas); lauha bhasma is used mainly in pāṇḍu (anaemia) and as rasāyana.
terms.hi: लौह (लोहा) - लौह भस्म पाण्डु में मुख्य।
terms.modern: Iron; lauha bhasma is mainly iron oxide.

terms.en: Gems; the nine ratnas: māṇikya (ruby), muktā (pearl), pravāla (coral), marakata (emerald), puṣparāga (yellow sapphire/topaz), vajra (diamond), nīla (blue sapphire), gomeda (hessonite) and vaidūrya (cat's eye). Uparatnas are semi-precious stones.
terms.hi: रत्न - नवरत्न: माणिक्य, मुक्ता, प्रवाल, मरकत, पुष्पराग, वज्र, नील, गोमेद, वैदूर्य।
terms.modern: Gemstones; pearl and coral are biological calcium carbonate.

terms.en: Mortar and pestle (of stone or iron) used for trituration (mardana, bhāvanā).
terms.hi: खल्व यन्त्र - खरल; मर्दन और भावना के लिए।

terms.en: Sand-bath apparatus: a vessel filled with sand in which a kūpī or pot is heated gradually and evenly (used for kūpīpakva rasāyanas).
terms.hi: वालुका यन्त्र - रेत से भरा पात्र, जिसमें कूपी को धीरे-धीरे समान ताप दिया जाता है।

terms.en: Apparatus used in rasaśāstra, e.g. khalva, dolā (for boiling suspended drugs), vālukā, pātana and ḍamaru yantra. Distinct from surgical yantras.
terms.hi: यन्त्र (रसशास्त्र) - उपकरण: खल्व, दोला, वालुका, पातन, डमरू यन्त्र।

terms.en: Ayurvedic pharmaceutics: the methods of preparing dosage forms (kalpanā) from crude drugs, from basic forms like svarasa and kvātha to secondary forms like avaleha, āsava and sneha. Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā is the key text.
terms.hi: भैषज्य कल्पना - औषध-निर्माण विज्ञान; स्वरस, क्वाथ से लेकर अवलेह, आसव, स्नेह तक; मुख्य ग्रन्थ शार्ङ्गधर संहिता।

terms.en: The five primary preparations: svarasa (juice), kalka (paste), kvātha/śṛta (decoction), hima/śīta (cold infusion) and phāṇṭa (hot infusion); each is lighter than the one before it.
terms.hi: पञ्चविध कषाय कल्पना - स्वरस, कल्क, क्वाथ (शृत), हिम (शीत), फाण्ट; उत्तरोत्तर लघु।

terms.en: Fresh juice expressed from a freshly pounded herb; the most potent of the five basic kalpanās. Dose about half a pala (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa).
terms.hi: स्वरस - ताज़ी वनस्पति को कूटकर निचोड़ा गया रस; पाँचों में सबसे गुरु/बलवान; मात्रा अर्ध पल।

terms.en: Fine paste of a fresh or dry drug ground with a little water; also an ingredient in sneha-pāka. Dose about one karṣa (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa).
terms.hi: कल्क - द्रव्य को थोड़ा जल मिलाकर पीसा गया लेप जैसा पिष्ट; स्नेहपाक का अंग; मात्रा एक कर्ष।

terms.en: Decoction: one part coarse drug boiled in sixteen parts water reduced to one-eighth (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa). Also called kaṣāya, śṛta, niryūha. Other texts vary the water (4, 8 or 16 parts) by the hardness of the drug.
terms.hi: क्वाथ (कषाय) - 1 भाग यवकुट द्रव्य, 16 भाग जल में उबालकर 1/8 शेष (शार्ङ्गधर)।

terms.en: Cold infusion: one part drug soaked overnight in six parts cold water, filtered in the morning (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa); suited to pitta conditions and aromatic/delicate drugs. Also called śīta kaṣāya.
terms.hi: हिम (शीत कषाय) - 1 भाग द्रव्य को 6 भाग शीतल जल में रातभर भिगोकर सुबह छानना।

terms.en: Hot infusion: one part drug steeped in four parts hot water, then filtered when cool (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa). The lightest of the five basic kalpanās.
terms.hi: फाण्ट - 1 भाग द्रव्य को 4 भाग गरम जल में डालकर ठण्डा होने पर छानना; सबसे लघु।

terms.en: Fine powder of dried drugs, sieved through cloth (vastragālita); e.g. triphalā cūrṇa, sitopalādi cūrṇa. Dose about one karṣa (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa).
terms.hi: चूर्ण - सूखे द्रव्यों का कपड़छन बारीक चूर्ण; जैसे त्रिफला, सितोपलादि चूर्ण।

terms.en: Pills or tablets made from cūrṇa, extracts or minerals with a binder (guḍa, guggulu, madhu, juice), e.g. sañjīvanī vaṭī, candraprabhā vaṭī.
terms.hi: वटी/गुटिका - चूर्ण आदि को गुड़, गुग्गुलु, मधु या रस से बाँधकर बनाई गोलियाँ।

terms.en: Semi-solid confection made by reheating decoction or juice with sugar or jaggery (and adding powders, ghee, honey), e.g. cyavanaprāśa, vāsāvaleha. Signs of completion include thread formation (tantuvat) and sinking in water. Also called leha.
terms.hi: अवलेह (लेह) - क्वाथ/स्वरस को शर्करा/गुड़ के साथ पकाकर बना अर्धठोस; जैसे च्यवनप्राश; तन्तुवत् लक्षण।

terms.en: Famous rasāyana avaleha based on āmalakī, named after the sage Cyavana who regained youth by it (Caraka).
terms.hi: च्यवनप्राश - आमलकी आधारित प्रसिद्ध रसायन अवलेह; ऋषि च्यवन के नाम पर।

terms.en: Fermented preparations: āsava, ariṣṭa, surā, sīdhu, śukta, kāñjika and others; self-generated alcohol extracts and preserves the drug.
terms.hi: सन्धान कल्पना - किण्वित योग: आसव, अरिष्ट, सुरा, शुक्त, काञ्जिक आदि।

terms.en: Fermented preparation made from fresh juice or cold infusion of drugs without boiling (the drug is not decocted), e.g. kumāryāsava, uśīrāsava.
terms.hi: आसव - बिना उबाले (स्वरस/शीत कषाय से) बनाया किण्वित योग; जैसे कुमार्यासव।

terms.en: Fermented preparation made from a decoction (kvātha) of drugs, with jaggery/honey and dhātakī flowers as starter, e.g. daśamūlāriṣṭa, aśokāriṣṭa. Difference from āsava: ariṣṭa uses a boiled decoction. (Ariṣṭa also means a fatal sign; see riṣṭa.)
terms.hi: अरिष्ट - क्वाथ से बनाया किण्वित योग; जैसे दशमूलारिष्ट। आसव में क्वाथ नहीं, अरिष्ट में क्वाथ।

terms.en: Medicated ghee or oil: generally one part kalka, four parts sneha and sixteen parts liquid (drava) cooked together until the signs of completion (sneha-siddhi lakṣaṇa) appear (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa).
terms.hi: स्नेह कल्पना - औषधसिद्ध घृत/तैल; सामान्यतः 1 भाग कल्क, 4 भाग स्नेह, 16 भाग द्रव; स्नेहसिद्धि लक्षण तक पाक।
terms.modern: Medicated lipid preparations; lipids help extract fat-soluble constituents.

terms.en: Degree of cooking of medicated sneha: mṛdu (soft, kalka still sticky; for nasya), madhyama (kalka rolls into a non-sticky wick; for internal use and general purposes) and khara (kalka hard and brittle; for abhyaṅga) (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa).
terms.hi: स्नेहपाक - मृदु (नस्य), मध्यम (पान, सर्वकर्म), खर (अभ्यंग)।

terms.en: Ghee (clarified butter), the best of the four snehas because it takes on the properties of drugs processed with it without losing its own; pacifies pitta and vāta; base of medicated ghṛtas (e.g. brāhmī ghṛta, phala ghṛta).
terms.hi: घृत (घी) - चार स्नेहों में श्रेष्ठ, संस्कार का अनुवर्तन करता है; पित्त-वातशामक; औषधसिद्ध घृत।
terms.modern: Clarified butter; medicated ghṛtas are lipid-based formulations.

terms.en: Oil, especially sesame oil (tila taila, from which the word comes); best for vāta and kapha; base of medicated oils (e.g. mahānārāyaṇa taila, kṣīrabalā taila).
terms.hi: तैल - विशेषतः तिल तैल; वात-कफ में श्रेष्ठ; औषधसिद्ध तैल।
terms.modern: Oil; medicated oils are lipid-based formulations.

terms.en: Aromatic distillate prepared by distilling drugs soaked in water (described in Arkaprakāśa), e.g. ajamodā arka.
terms.hi: अर्क कल्पना - द्रव्यों को जल में भिगोकर आसवन से प्राप्त सुगन्धित अर्क।

terms.en: Medicated milk: drug boiled in milk with water (commonly 1 part drug : 8 parts milk : 32 parts water) until only the milk remains (Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā, Madhyamakhaṇḍa); e.g. arjuna kṣīrapāka.
terms.hi: क्षीरपाक - द्रव्य को दूध व जल में उबालकर केवल दूध शेष रखना (सामान्यतः 1:8:32)।

terms.en: Medicated paste applied externally; types include pralepa (thin, cold), pradeha (thick, warm) and ālepa (medium). It should be applied against the direction of hair and removed before it dries.
terms.hi: लेप - बाहरी लेप; प्रलेप, प्रदेह, आलेप; सूखने से पहले हटाना।

terms.en: Medicated wick or suppository-like stick (e.g. phala varti for the rectum/vagina, netra varti for the eyes, dhūma varti for smoking).
terms.hi: वर्ति - औषधीय बत्ती (फल वर्ति, नेत्र वर्ति, धूम वर्ति)।

terms.en: Alkali obtained from plant ash (e.g. apāmārga, palāśa, yava); used internally (pānīya kṣāra) and externally (pratisāraṇīya kṣāra) as a chemical cautery. Suśruta calls it superior to sharp instruments; it is mild, medium or strong.
terms.hi: क्षार - वनस्पति-भस्म से प्राप्त क्षार; पानीय और प्रतिसारणीय; सुश्रुत: शस्त्र-अनुशस्त्रों में श्रेष्ठ।

terms.en: Dose or measured quantity; depends on agni, bala, age, disease and drug. In diet, mātrā is the quantity that is digested in due time without disturbing health.
terms.hi: मात्रा - औषध या आहार की उचित मात्रा; अग्नि, बल, आयु, रोग के अनुसार।

terms.en: Classical system of weights and measures (Māgadha māna). Commonly used conversions: 1 guñjā (ratti) about 125 mg, 1 māṣa about 1 g, 1 karṣa (tolā) about 12 g, 1 pala about 48 g, 1 kuḍava about 192 g, 1 prastha about 768 g. Liquids and fresh drugs are often taken double (dvaiguṇya).
terms.hi: मान - तौल-माप पद्धति (मागध मान); प्रचलित: गुञ्जा ≈125 mg, माष ≈1 g, कर्ष ≈12 g, पल ≈48 g, कुडव ≈192 g, प्रस्थ ≈768 g।
terms.modern: Conventional metric equivalents as used in the Ayurvedic Formulary of India; texts differ.

terms.en: Unit of weight equal to four karṣas, conventionally taken as about 48 g.
terms.hi: पल - चार कर्ष; लगभग 48 ग्राम।

terms.en: Unit of weight equal to one tolā, conventionally about 12 g; also called akṣa or suvarṇa.
terms.hi: कर्ष (तोला) - लगभग 12 ग्राम।

terms.en: Vehicle or after-drink taken with or after medicine or food (e.g. warm water, honey, milk, ghee); it helps the drug spread quickly and act better.
terms.hi: अनुपान - औषध/आहार के साथ या बाद में लिया जाने वाला द्रव (उष्ण जल, मधु, दूध); औषध के प्रसार में सहायक।

terms.en: Times of taking medicine, chosen according to the doṣa and disease: e.g. on empty stomach (abhakta), before, during or after meals, between meals, with every morsel, repeatedly, and at night. Vāgbhaṭa lists about ten.
terms.hi: भैषज्य काल - औषध सेवन के समय: अन्न रहित, अन्न से पहले, मध्य, अन्त, ग्रास-ग्रास में, बार-बार, रात्रि आदि।
terms.modern: Comparable to timing of drug administration relative to meals (chronopharmacology).

terms.en: Period during which a preparation retains potency (shelf life), e.g. cūrṇa about two months and āsava-ariṣṭa improving with age per Śārṅgadhara; modern Indian drug rules fix specific shelf lives.
terms.hi: सवीर्यता अवधि - औषध की वीर्यवत्ता की अवधि (शेल्फ लाइफ); चूर्ण लगभग 2 माह, आसव-अरिष्ट पुराने होने पर अधिक गुणकारी।

terms.en: Ayurvedic anatomy: knowledge of the structure of the body. Suśruta insisted on dissection (of a cadaver softened in water) for direct knowledge.
terms.hi: रचना शारीर - शरीर-रचना विज्ञान; सुश्रुत ने शव-विच्छेदन पर बल दिया।

terms.en: Bones. Caraka (Ātreya) counts 360 including teeth and nails; Suśruta (Dhanvantari) counts 300. Suśruta's five types: kapāla, rucaka, taruṇa, valaya and nalaka.
terms.hi: अस्थि - हड्डियाँ; चरक: 360 (दाँत-नख सहित), सुश्रुत: 300; सुश्रुत के 5 प्रकार: कपाल, रुचक, तरुण, वलय, नलक।
terms.modern: Bones (modern count 206 in adults); classical counts include teeth, nails and cartilages.

terms.en: Joints. Suśruta counts 210 and classifies them as ceṣṭāvanta (movable) and sthira (fixed), with eight structural types (kora, ulūkhala, sāmudga, pratara, tunnasevanī, vāyasatuṇḍa, maṇḍala, śaṅkhāvarta). Not to be confused with grammatical sandhi.
terms.hi: सन्धि (जोड़) - सुश्रुत: 210; चल और स्थिर; आठ आकृति-भेद।

terms.en: Ligaments and tendon-like binding structures; Suśruta counts 900 and compares them to the lashings that hold a boat together. Upadhātu of medas (Caraka).
terms.hi: स्नायु - शरीर को बाँधने वाली रचनाएँ; सुश्रुत: 900; नाव के बन्धन की तरह।
terms.modern: Often compared to ligaments, tendons and fascia (not nerves, despite modern Hindi usage).

terms.en: Muscles: Suśruta counts 500, with 20 extra in women (in breasts and genital region). They cover the bones, joints, vessels and snāyus.

Vessels: 700 sirās arise from ten root vessels in the navel/heart region and spread like leaf veins. Suśruta classifies them by doṣa carried: vātavaha (aruṇa), pittavaha (nīla), kaphavaha (gaurī) and raktavaha (rohiṇī). Upadhātu of rakta (Caraka).
terms.hi: सिरा - 700 सिराएँ, दस मूल सिराओं से पत्ते की नसों जैसी फैली; वातवह, पित्तवह, कफवह, रक्तवह।
terms.modern: Often compared to veins and other vessels in general.

terms.en: Pulsating vessels (from 'dhmā', to blow): Suśruta describes 24 dhamanīs arising from the navel (10 upward, 10 downward, 4 oblique); Caraka names ten great vessels (mahāmūla) attached to the heart carrying ojas.
terms.hi: धमनी - स्पन्दन करने वाली नलिकाएँ; सुश्रुत: नाभि से 24; चरक: हृदय से जुड़ी 10 महामूला धमनियाँ।
terms.modern: Often compared to arteries, though classical dhamanīs also include nerve-like and other channels.

terms.en: Channels of transport and transformation (from 'sru', to flow), each named for what it carries. Caraka lists 13 (plus manovaha implied); Suśruta lists 11 pairs (22). Each has a mūla (root). Signs of vitiation: atipravṛtti, saṅga, sirāgranthi, vimārgagamana.
terms.hi: स्रोतस् - वहन करने वाले मार्ग ('स्रु' = बहना); चरक: 13, सुश्रुत: 11 जोड़े (22); प्रत्येक का मूल; दुष्टि के चार लक्षण।
terms.modern: Often compared to physiological transport systems from vessels and ducts down to cell-membrane pathways.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries prāṇa (breath/life). Mūla per Caraka: hṛdaya and mahāsrotas; per Suśruta: hṛdaya and rasavāhinī dhamanīs. Vitiation causes abnormal breathing.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। प्राणवह - मूल: हृदय, महास्रोतस् (चरक)।
terms.modern: Often compared to the respiratory system.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries water/fluids. Mūla: tālu (palate) and kloma. Vitiation causes dryness of mouth and excessive thirst.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। उदकवह - मूल: तालु, क्लोम।
terms.modern: Often compared to fluid balance and thirst regulation.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries food. Mūla per Caraka: āmāśaya and vāma pārśva (left side); per Suśruta: āmāśaya and annavāhinī dhamanīs. Vitiation causes anorexia, indigestion and vomiting.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। अन्नवह - मूल: आमाशय, वाम पार्श्व।
terms.modern: Often compared to the upper digestive tract.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries rasa dhātu. Mūla: hṛdaya and the ten dhamanīs (Caraka); Suśruta: hṛdaya and rasavāhinī dhamanīs.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। रसवह - मूल: हृदय, दस धमनियाँ।
terms.modern: Often compared to the lymphatic/circulatory transport of plasma.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries rakta. Mūla: yakṛt (liver) and plīhā (spleen).
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। रक्तवह - मूल: यकृत, प्लीहा।
terms.modern: Often compared to haemopoietic and blood-circulating structures.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries/nourishes māṃsa. Mūla: snāyu and tvak (Caraka); Suśruta adds raktavāhinī dhamanīs.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। मांसवह - मूल: स्नायु, त्वक्।

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries/nourishes medas. Mūla: vṛkka (kidneys) and vapāvahana (omentum) per Caraka; kaṭi and vṛkka per Suśruta.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। मेदोवह - मूल: वृक्क, वपावहन (चरक)।

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Nourishes asthi. Mūla: medas and jaghana (hip region). Not in Suśruta's list.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। अस्थिवह - मूल: मेद, जघन।

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Nourishes majjā. Mūla: asthi (bones) and sandhi (joints). Not in Suśruta's list.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। मज्जवह - मूल: अस्थि, सन्धि।

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries śukra. Mūla: vṛṣaṇa (testes) and śepha (penis) per Caraka; stana and vṛṣaṇa per Suśruta.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। शुक्रवह - मूल: वृषण, शेफ (चरक)।
terms.modern: Often compared to the male reproductive tract.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries urine. Mūla: basti (bladder) and vaṅkṣaṇa (groin) per Caraka; basti and meḍhra per Suśruta.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। मूत्रवह - मूल: बस्ति, वङ्क्षण (चरक)।
terms.modern: Often compared to the urinary tract.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries faeces. Mūla: pakvāśaya and sthūlaguda (rectum) per Caraka; pakvāśaya and guda per Suśruta.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। पुरीषवह - मूल: पक्वाशय, स्थूलगुद।
terms.modern: Often compared to the colon and rectum.

terms.en: One of Caraka's thirteen srotas (CS.vimana.5). Carries sweat. Mūla: medas and lomakūpa (hair follicles). Not in Suśruta's list.
terms.hi: चरक के 13 स्रोतों में एक। स्वेदवह - मूल: मेद, लोमकूप।
terms.modern: Often compared to sweat glands and ducts.

terms.en: Suśruta's channel carrying ārtava, with mūla in garbhāśaya (uterus) and ārtavavāhinī dhamanīs; not in Caraka's list of thirteen.
terms.hi: आर्तववह स्रोतस् - सुश्रुत; मूल: गर्भाशय, आर्तववाहिनी धमनियाँ।
terms.modern: Often compared to the female reproductive tract.

terms.en: Channels of the mind, mentioned by Caraka in the context of unmāda and apasmāra; not counted among the thirteen. Commentators place them in the whole body with the heart as seat.
terms.hi: मनोवह स्रोतस् - मन के मार्ग; चरक ने उन्माद-अपस्मार में उल्लेख किया।
terms.modern: Loosely compared to neural pathways of mental function.

terms.en: Four signs of vitiated channels: atipravṛtti (excess flow), saṅga (obstruction), sirāgranthi (nodular dilatation) and vimārgagamana (flow in the wrong path).
terms.hi: स्रोतोदुष्टि - चार लक्षण: अतिप्रवृत्ति, सङ्ग, सिराग्रन्थि, विमार्गगमन।
terms.modern: Comparable to hypersecretion, obstruction, varicosity/tumour-like swelling and reflux/extravasation.

terms.en: Membranes forming the boundary between dhātus and their āśayas, compared to the heartwood layer of a tree. Seven kalās: māṃsadharā, raktadharā, medodharā, śleṣmadharā, purīṣadharā, pittadharā and śukradharā (Suśruta). Also kalā means a unit of time.
terms.hi: कला - धातु और आशय के बीच की झिल्ली; सात कलाएँ: मांसधरा, रक्तधरा, मेदोधरा, श्लेष्मधरा, पुरीषधरा, पित्तधरा, शुक्रधरा।
terms.modern: Often compared to membranes and epithelial/serous linings (e.g. pittadharā to the small-intestinal mucosa).

terms.en: Sixth kalā, located between āmāśaya and pakvāśaya; it holds the four kinds of food and is identified with grahaṇī by Suśruta.
terms.hi: पित्तधरा कला - छठी कला; आमाशय-पक्वाशय के बीच; ग्रहणी।
terms.modern: Often compared to the mucosa of the duodenum/small intestine.

terms.en: Receptacles/viscera that hold something: seven in men (vātāśaya, pittāśaya, śleṣmāśaya, raktāśaya, āmāśaya, pakvāśaya, mūtrāśaya), with an eighth, garbhāśaya, in women.
terms.hi: आशय - धारण करने वाले अंग; सात (वात, पित्त, श्लेष्म, रक्त, आम, पक्व, मूत्र आशय) + स्त्रियों में गर्भाशय।

terms.en: The trunk cavity and its contents, also the mahāsrotas (alimentary tract) from mouth to anus. Organs in it (koṣṭhāṅga) include hṛdaya, kloma, phupphusa, yakṛt, plīhā, uṇḍuka, vṛkka, nābhi, antra and basti. Distinct from koṣṭha as bowel nature.
terms.hi: कोष्ठ (शारीर) - धड़ की गुहा व महास्रोतस्; कोष्ठाङ्ग: हृदय, क्लोम, फुफ्फुस, यकृत, प्लीहा, उण्डुक, वृक्क, नाभि, आन्त्र, बस्ति।

terms.en: Skin. Suśruta describes seven layers (avabhāsinī, lohitā, śvetā, tāmrā, vedinī, rohiṇī, māṃsadharā); Caraka describes six. It forms from rakta during development like cream on boiling milk.
terms.hi: त्वचा - सुश्रुत: सात स्तर (अवभासिनी, लोहिता, श्वेता, ताम्रा, वेदिनी, रोहिणी, मांसधरा); चरक: छह।
terms.modern: Skin (epidermis and dermis layers); correlation of each classical layer is speculative.

terms.en: Sixteen great snāyus (tendons) in the limbs, neck and back; upadhātu of rakta (Caraka).
terms.hi: कण्डरा - सोलह बड़ी स्नायुएँ (हाथ, पैर, गर्दन, पीठ); रक्त का उपधातु।
terms.modern: Often compared to large tendons (e.g. calcaneal tendon).

terms.en: The six major parts of the body: head (with neck), trunk (antarādhi), two upper limbs and two lower limbs.
terms.hi: षडङ्ग - शरीर के छह अंग: शिर, अन्तराधि (धड़), दो बाहु, दो सक्थि।

terms.en: Sub-parts of the body such as forehead, nose, chin, eyes, fingers, organs like heart and liver, etc.
terms.hi: प्रत्यङ्ग - उप-अंग जैसे ललाट, नासा, नेत्र, अंगुलि, हृदय आदि।

terms.en: Measurement of the body and its parts in units of the person's own finger-breadth (svāṅguli); an ideal body is 84 aṅgulas tall (Caraka; Suśruta gives 120).
terms.hi: अङ्गुलि प्रमाण - अपनी अंगुलि से शरीर का माप; आदर्श ऊँचाई 84 अंगुल (चरक), 120 (सुश्रुत)।

terms.en: Ten seats of life (daśa prāṇāyatana): head, tongue root (rasana-bandhana), throat, blood, heart, navel, bladder, śukra, ojas and anus.
terms.hi: जीवितधाम (दश प्राणायतन) - शिर, रसनाबन्धन, कण्ठ, रक्त, हृदय, नाभि, बस्ति, शुक्र, ओज, गुद।

terms.en: The heart: seat of consciousness (cetanā), ojas, sādhaka pitta, avalambaka kapha and vyāna vāyu; root of rasavaha and prāṇavaha srotas; one of the trimarmas and a sadyaḥ-prāṇahara sirā marma. Described as shaped like an inverted lotus bud.
terms.hi: हृदय - चेतना, ओज का स्थान; रसवह व प्राणवह स्रोतस् का मूल; त्रिमर्म में एक; अधोमुख कमल-कलिका जैसा।
terms.modern: Heart; classical texts also attribute mental functions to it.

terms.en: An organ named as a root of udakavaha srotas and a seat of kapha; its identity is disputed (pancreas, gall bladder, right lung, trachea and others have been proposed).
terms.hi: क्लोम - उदकवह स्रोतस् का मूल; पहचान विवादित (अग्न्याशय, पित्ताशय आदि)।
terms.modern: Identity disputed; often compared to the pancreas, but there is no consensus.

terms.en: The lungs; formed from the froth (phena) of blood during foetal development, located to the left of the heart (Suśruta).
terms.hi: फुफ्फुस - फेफड़े; गर्भ में रक्त के फेन से बनते हैं।

terms.en: The liver, located on the right side below the heart; formed from rakta during development; root of raktavaha srotas and seat of rañjaka pitta (Suśruta).
terms.hi: यकृत् - जिगर; दक्षिण भाग में; रक्तवह स्रोतस् का मूल; रञ्जक पित्त का स्थान (सुश्रुत)।

terms.en: The spleen, on the left side below the heart; formed from rakta; root of raktavaha srotas.
terms.hi: प्लीहा (तिल्ली) - वाम भाग में; रक्तवह स्रोतस् का मूल।

terms.en: A koṣṭhāṅga where faeces collect; Suśruta says it forms from the essence of blood and kapha.
terms.hi: उण्डुक - कोष्ठाङ्ग जहाँ मल एकत्र होता है।
terms.modern: Often compared to the caecum (with the appendix).

terms.en: The two kidneys, formed from the essence of rakta and medas; root of medovaha srotas (Caraka).
terms.hi: वृक्क - दो गुर्दे; रक्त-मेद के सार से बने; मेदोवह स्रोतस् का मूल।

terms.en: Intestines; Suśruta gives their length as 3.5 vyāmas in men and 3 in women.
terms.hi: आन्त्र - आँतें; सुश्रुत: पुरुष में 3.5 व्याम, स्त्री में 3 व्याम।

terms.en: Urinary bladder, root of mūtravaha srotas and one of the trimarmas (a sadyaḥ-prāṇahara snāyu marma). The same word denotes the enema therapy (basti karma), named after the animal bladder used as its bag.
terms.hi: बस्ति - मूत्राशय; मूत्रवह स्रोतस् का मूल; त्रिमर्म में एक। (बस्ति चिकित्सा भी)

terms.en: The receptacle of unripe (undigested) food, located between the navel and nipples; seat of kledaka and avalambaka kapha and of āma; root of annavaha srotas.
terms.hi: आमाशय - अपक्व अन्न का आशय; नाभि-स्तन के बीच; कफ का स्थान; अन्नवह स्रोतस् का मूल।
terms.modern: Often compared to the stomach (and upper small intestine).

terms.en: Receptacle of digested food and the chief seat of vāta; root of purīṣavaha srotas.
terms.hi: पक्वाशय - पचे अन्न का आशय; वात का मुख्य स्थान; पुरीषवह स्रोतस् का मूल।
terms.modern: Often compared to the large intestine (colon).

terms.en: The organ that 'holds' (grahaṇa) food until it is digested, situated at the door of the pakvāśaya, above the navel; the seat of agni (it is supported by agni and agni depends on it). Its weakness causes grahaṇī roga.
terms.hi: ग्रहणी - अन्न को पचने तक धारण करने वाला अंग; पक्वाशय-द्वार पर; अग्नि का अधिष्ठान।
terms.modern: Often compared to the duodenum and small intestine.

terms.en: Anus and rectum: 4.5 aṅgulas long with three folds (valis) named pravāhaṇī, visarjanī and saṃvaraṇī (Suśruta); a sadyaḥ-prāṇahara māṃsa marma and one of the ten seats of life.
terms.hi: गुद - गुदा-मलाशय; तीन वलियाँ: प्रवाहणी, विसर्जनी, संवरणी; सद्यःप्राणहर मर्म।

terms.en: Navel/central abdomen: chief seat of pitta, origin of the 24 dhamanīs (Suśruta), a seat of life and a sadyaḥ-prāṇahara sirā marma.
terms.hi: नाभि - पित्त का मुख्य स्थान; 24 धमनियों का उद्गम; सद्यःप्राणहर मर्म।

terms.en: Brain matter, described as ghee-like substance in the skull; also called mastiṣka.
terms.hi: मस्तुलुङ्ग (मस्तिष्क) - खोपड़ी में घृत जैसा पदार्थ।

terms.en: The head, called uttamāṅga (best part), where prāṇa and all senses reside; one of the trimarmas. (Not to be confused with sirā, vessel.)
terms.hi: शिरस् - सिर; उत्तमाङ्ग; प्राण और सभी इन्द्रियों का आश्रय; त्रिमर्म में एक। (सिरा से भिन्न)

terms.en: Vital points where māṃsa, sirā, snāyu, asthi and sandhi meet and prāṇa specially resides; injury causes death or disability. Suśruta and Vāgbhaṭa count 107: 44 in the limbs (11 each), 26 in the trunk and 37 above the clavicle.
terms.hi: मर्म - जहाँ मांस, सिरा, स्नायु, अस्थि, सन्धि मिलते हैं और प्राण विशेष रूप से रहता है; 107 मर्म।
terms.modern: Often compared to anatomically vulnerable sites (major vessels, nerves, joints); not the same as acupuncture points.

terms.en: The three principal marmas: śiras (head), hṛdaya (heart) and basti (bladder); Caraka devotes a chapter to their protection and diseases.
terms.hi: त्रिमर्म - तीन प्रधान मर्म: शिर, हृदय, बस्ति।

terms.en: Marmas where muscle predominates; Suśruta counts 11 (e.g. talahṛdaya, indrabasti, guda, stanarohita).
terms.hi: मांस मर्म - मांस प्रधान; सुश्रुत: 11 (तलहृदय, इन्द्रबस्ति, गुद आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas where vessels predominate; Suśruta counts 41 (e.g. hṛdaya, nābhi, śṛṅgāṭaka, sthapanī). Vāgbhaṭa counts 37 and adds 9 dhamanī marmas.
terms.hi: सिरा मर्म - सिरा प्रधान; सुश्रुत: 41 (हृदय, नाभि, शृङ्गाटक, स्थपनी आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas where snāyu predominates; Suśruta counts 27 (e.g. kṣipra, basti, utkṣepa).
terms.hi: स्नायु मर्म - स्नायु प्रधान; सुश्रुत: 27 (क्षिप्र, बस्ति, उत्क्षेप आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas where bone predominates; 8 in number (e.g. śaṅkha, kaṭīkataruṇa).
terms.hi: अस्थि मर्म - अस्थि प्रधान; 8 (शङ्ख आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas at joints; 20 in number (e.g. jānu, kūrpara, gulpha, maṇibandha, adhipati).
terms.hi: सन्धि मर्म - सन्धि प्रधान; 20 (जानु, कूर्पर, गुल्फ, मणिबन्ध, अधिपति आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas whose injury causes immediate death; 19 in number (e.g. śṛṅgāṭaka, adhipati, śaṅkha, hṛdaya, nābhi, basti, guda). Predominantly āgneya.
terms.hi: सद्यःप्राणहर मर्म - आघात से तुरन्त मृत्यु; 19 (हृदय, नाभि, बस्ति, गुद, शङ्ख, अधिपति आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas whose injury causes death after some time; 33 in number (e.g. kṣipra, talahṛdaya, indrabasti). Saumya and āgneya in nature.
terms.hi: कालान्तरप्राणहर मर्म - कुछ समय बाद मृत्यु; 33 (क्षिप्र, तलहृदय, इन्द्रबस्ति आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas where death follows only when the embedded foreign body (śalya) is removed; 3 in number (two utkṣepa and one sthapanī). Vāyavya in nature.
terms.hi: विशल्यघ्न मर्म - शल्य निकालने पर मृत्यु; 3 (दो उत्क्षेप, एक स्थपनी)।

terms.en: Marmas whose injury causes deformity or disability; 44 in number (e.g. jānu, kūrpara, nīlā, manyā). Saumya in nature.
terms.hi: वैकल्यकर मर्म - विकलाङ्गता करने वाले; 44 (जानु, कूर्पर आदि)।

terms.en: Marmas whose injury causes severe pain; 8 in number (gulpha, maṇibandha and kūrca-śiras on each side). Āgneya and vāyavya in nature.
terms.hi: रुजाकर मर्म - तीव्र वेदना करने वाले; 8 (गुल्फ, मणिबन्ध, कूर्चशिर)।

terms.en: Snāyu marma between the great toe/thumb and the second digit; kālāntara-prāṇahara, injury causes death by convulsions (ākṣepaka).
terms.hi: क्षिप्र मर्म - अंगूठे और तर्जनी के बीच; स्नायु मर्म; आक्षेपक से मृत्यु।

terms.en: Māṃsa marma in the centre of the sole/palm in line with the middle digit; kālāntara-prāṇahara, injury causes death through pain.
terms.hi: तलहृदय मर्म - तलवे/हथेली के मध्य; मांस मर्म; वेदना से मृत्यु।

terms.en: Māṃsa marma in the middle of the calf (and forearm); kālāntara-prāṇahara, injury causes death from blood loss.
terms.hi: इन्द्रबस्ति मर्म - पिंडली के मध्य; रक्तक्षय से मृत्यु।

terms.en: Sandhi marma at the knee; vaikalyakara, injury causes lameness.
terms.hi: जानु मर्म - घुटना; सन्धि मर्म; लंगड़ापन।

terms.en: Sandhi marma at the crown of the head (vertex); sadyaḥ-prāṇahara.
terms.hi: अधिपति मर्म - सिर के शीर्ष पर; सद्यःप्राणहर।

terms.en: Asthi marma at the temples; sadyaḥ-prāṇahara.
terms.hi: शङ्ख मर्म - कनपटी; अस्थि मर्म; सद्यःप्राणहर।

terms.en: Sirā marma between the eyebrows; viśalyaghna.
terms.hi: स्थपनी मर्म - भौंहों के बीच; विशल्यघ्न।

terms.en: (1) Cause of disease (synonyms: hetu, nimitta, āyatana, pratyaya, utthāna, kāraṇa). (2) Diagnosis as a whole, i.e. knowledge of disease through the nidāna pañcaka. Mādhava Nidāna is the classic diagnostic text.
terms.hi: निदान - (1) रोग का कारण (हेतु, निमित्त, आयतन, प्रत्यय, उत्थान, कारण); (2) रोग-निर्णय (निदान पञ्चक द्वारा)।

terms.en: The five means of knowing a disease: nidāna (cause), pūrvarūpa (prodrome), rūpa (signs and symptoms), upaśaya (therapeutic test/what relieves) and saṃprāpti (pathogenesis).
terms.hi: निदान पञ्चक - रोग ज्ञान के पाँच साधन: निदान, पूर्वरूप, रूप, उपशय, सम्प्राप्ति।
terms.modern: Comparable to aetiology, prodrome, clinical features, therapeutic trial and pathogenesis.

terms.en: Cause. Classified as sannikṛṣṭa (immediate), viprakṛṣṭa (distant), vyabhicārī (weak, not always producing disease) and prādhānika (dominant, e.g. poison); also as doṣa-, vyādhi- and ubhaya-hetu. Caraka's three root causes are asātmyendriyārtha-saṃyoga, prajñāparādha and pariṇāma.
terms.hi: हेतु - कारण; सन्निकृष्ट, विप्रकृष्ट, व्यभिचारी, प्राधानिक; मूल त्रिविध हेतु: असात्म्येन्द्रियार्थसंयोग, प्रज्ञापराध, परिणाम।

terms.en: Caraka's three causes of all disease: asātmyendriyārtha-saṃyoga (improper contact of senses with objects), prajñāparādha (intellectual error) and pariṇāma/kāla (time/season), each as hīna, mithyā or ati-yoga.
terms.hi: त्रिविध हेतु - असात्म्येन्द्रियार्थसंयोग, प्रज्ञापराध, परिणाम (काल)।

terms.en: 'Offence against wisdom': wrong action by body, speech or mind due to impairment of dhī (understanding), dhṛti (restraint) and smṛti (memory), e.g. suppressing natural urges or acting rashly. Caraka considers it a root cause of disease.
terms.hi: प्रज्ञापराध - धी, धृति, स्मृति के भ्रंश से शरीर, वाणी, मन द्वारा किया गया गलत कर्म; रोग का मूल कारण।
terms.modern: Comparable to unhealthy behavioural choices (lifestyle risk factors).

terms.en: Unwholesome contact of the senses with their objects: deficient (hīna), wrong (mithyā) or excessive (ati) use of eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin.
terms.hi: असात्म्येन्द्रियार्थसंयोग - इन्द्रियों का विषयों से हीन, मिथ्या या अति योग।
terms.modern: Comparable to sensory overload/deprivation or harmful exposures.

terms.en: Time as a cause of disease, especially abnormal seasons (hīna, mithyā or atiyoga of season). Pariṇāma also means transformation.
terms.hi: परिणाम (काल) - रोग के कारण के रूप में काल, विशेषतः ऋतुओं का हीन, मिथ्या, अतियोग।

terms.en: Deficient, wrong and excessive use of time (kāla), sense objects (artha) and actions (karma); these are the sole cause of disease, while their samyag-yoga (proper use) is the cause of health.
terms.hi: हीन-मिथ्या-अतियोग - काल, अर्थ, कर्म का कम, गलत और अधिक प्रयोग = रोग का कारण; सम्यग्योग = आरोग्य।

terms.en: Prodromal signs and symptoms that appear before a disease manifests fully; they indicate the coming disease (sāmānya, general, and viśeṣa, specific).
terms.hi: पूर्वरूप - रोग प्रकट होने से पहले के लक्षण; सामान्य और विशेष।

terms.en: The fully manifested signs and symptoms of a disease (synonyms: liṅga, lakṣaṇa, ākṛti, cihna). Also: visible form, the object of sight.
terms.hi: रूप - रोग के व्यक्त लक्षण (लिङ्ग, लक्षण, चिह्न)।

terms.en: Relief obtained from medicine, diet or regimen that acts against the cause, the disease or both (or acts in a reverse-seeming way); equated with sātmya. Used as a diagnostic test when the disease is unclear. Classical texts describe 18 types.
terms.hi: उपशय - हेतु, व्याधि या दोनों के विपरीत (या विपरीतार्थकारी) औषध, अन्न, विहार से सुख; अस्पष्ट रोग में निदान हेतु; 18 प्रकार।
terms.modern: Comparable to a therapeutic trial / diagnostic test of treatment.

terms.en: The opposite of upaśaya: factors that aggravate the disease (vyādhi-asātmya).
terms.hi: अनुपशय - जिससे रोग बढ़े (व्याधि-असात्म्य)।

terms.en: Pathogenesis: how the vitiated doṣa spreads and produces the disease (synonyms: jāti, āgati). Types: saṅkhyā (number), vikalpa (proportion of doṣas), prādhānya (primary/secondary), bala (strength) and kāla (time).
terms.hi: सम्प्राप्ति - दुष्ट दोष किस प्रकार फैलकर रोग उत्पन्न करता है (जाति, आगति); भेद: संख्या, विकल्प, प्राधान्य, बल, काल।

terms.en: Components used to analyse pathogenesis in teaching and clinic: doṣa, dūṣya, srotas, srotoduṣṭi type, agni, āma, udbhava-sthāna (site of origin), adhiṣṭhāna (site of settling), vyakta-sthāna (site of manifestation), rogamārga and svabhāva.
terms.hi: सम्प्राप्ति घटक - दोष, दूष्य, स्रोतस्, स्रोतोदुष्टि, अग्नि, आम, उद्भवस्थान, अधिष्ठान, व्यक्तस्थान, रोगमार्ग।

terms.en: That which is vitiated: the dhātus and malas, which the doṣas spoil to produce disease.
terms.hi: दूष्य - जिसे दूषित किया जाए: धातु और मल।

terms.en: Defect or weakness in a channel (kha = srotas) that allows circulating aggravated doṣas to lodge there and start disease.
terms.hi: खवैगुण्य - स्रोतस् की दुर्बलता/विकृति, जहाँ फैलते दोष ठहरकर रोग उत्पन्न करते हैं।
terms.modern: Comparable to a locus minoris resistentiae (site of lowered resistance).

terms.en: Suśruta's six stages of disease and opportunities for treatment: sañcaya (accumulation), prakopa (aggravation), prasara (spread), sthānasaṃśraya (localisation), vyakti (manifestation) and bheda (differentiation/complication). Earlier treatment is easier.
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल - रोग की छह अवस्थाएँ (चिकित्सा के अवसर): सञ्चय, प्रकोप, प्रसर, स्थानसंश्रय, व्यक्ति, भेद।
terms.modern: Comparable to stages of disease progression and levels of prevention.

terms.en: Stage of Suśruta's ṣaṭkriyākāla (SS.sutra.21). Accumulation of a doṣa in its own site (also caya); signs include dislike of causative factors and liking for opposite qualities (e.g. vāta: stiffness and fullness of abdomen).
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल की एक अवस्था। सञ्चय - दोष का अपने स्थान में संचय; विपरीत गुणों की इच्छा।

terms.en: Stage of Suśruta's ṣaṭkriyākāla (SS.sutra.21). Aggravation of the accumulated doṣa, which becomes excited and tends to leave its site (also kopa).
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल की एक अवस्था। प्रकोप - संचित दोष का उत्तेजित होना।

terms.en: Stage of Suśruta's ṣaṭkriyākāla (SS.sutra.21). Spread of aggravated doṣa beyond its site through the body, alone or in combination (15 kinds of spread).
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल की एक अवस्था। प्रसर - दोष का अपने स्थान से बाहर पूरे शरीर में फैलना (15 प्रकार)।

terms.en: Stage of Suśruta's ṣaṭkriyākāla (SS.sutra.21). Localisation: circulating doṣas lodge in a weak site (kha-vaiguṇya) and interact with dūṣyas; prodromal signs (pūrvarūpa) appear.
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल की एक अवस्था। स्थानसंश्रय - दोष का दुर्बल स्थान में ठहरना; पूर्वरूप प्रकट।

terms.en: Stage of Suśruta's ṣaṭkriyākāla (SS.sutra.21). Manifestation: the disease appears with its full signs and symptoms (rūpa).
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल की एक अवस्था। व्यक्ति - रोग के पूर्ण लक्षण प्रकट।

terms.en: Stage of Suśruta's ṣaṭkriyākāla (SS.sutra.21). Differentiation: the disease becomes chronic or complicated and its type (doṣa variety) becomes distinguishable.
terms.hi: षट्क्रियाकाल की एक अवस्था। भेद - रोग का प्रकार स्पष्ट; जीर्ण या उपद्रवयुक्त।

terms.en: Seasonal cycle of the doṣas: vāta accumulates in grīṣma, aggravates in varṣā and subsides in śarad; pitta accumulates in varṣā, aggravates in śarad and subsides in hemanta; kapha accumulates in śiśira, aggravates in vasanta and subsides in grīṣma.
terms.hi: चय-प्रकोप-प्रशम - ऋतु अनुसार दोषों का चक्र: वात - ग्रीष्म चय, वर्षा प्रकोप, शरद् प्रशम; पित्त - वर्षा, शरद्, हेमन्त; कफ - शिशिर, वसन्त, ग्रीष्म।

terms.en: Disease, literally 'that which causes various kinds of suffering'; a synonym of roga.
terms.hi: व्याधि - अनेक प्रकार का दुःख देने वाला; रोग का पर्याय।

terms.en: Curable disease; divided into sukhasādhya (easily curable) and kṛcchrasādhya (curable with difficulty).
terms.hi: साध्य - चिकित्सा योग्य रोग; सुखसाध्य और कृच्छ्रसाध्य।

terms.en: Easily curable: recent, single-doṣa disease in a strong young patient with dissimilar doṣa and dūṣya, favourable season and constitution and all four limbs of treatment present.
terms.hi: सुखसाध्य - नया, एकदोषज, बलवान युवा रोगी, दोष-दूष्य असमान, अनुकूल ऋतु-प्रकृति।

terms.en: Curable with difficulty: needs surgery, caustics or cautery, or involves mixed factors.
terms.hi: कृच्छ्रसाध्य - कठिनाई से साध्य; शस्त्र आदि की आवश्यकता।

terms.en: Incurable disease; divided into yāpya (controllable while treatment continues) and anupakrama/pratyākhyeya (beyond treatment).
terms.hi: असाध्य - अचिकित्स्य; याप्य और अनुपक्रम (प्रत्याख्येय)।

terms.en: Palliable: a disease that remains controlled only as long as wholesome treatment and regimen continue, and relapses when they stop.
terms.hi: याप्य - पथ्य-चिकित्सा जारी रहने तक नियन्त्रित, छोड़ने पर पुनः।
terms.modern: Comparable to chronic controllable diseases (e.g. diabetes, hypertension).

terms.en: Beyond treatment (pratyākhyeya): a disease with fatal signs (riṣṭa) or the reverse of all favourable factors, which the physician should decline.
terms.hi: अनुपक्रम (प्रत्याख्येय) - चिकित्सा से परे; अरिष्ट लक्षण युक्त।

terms.en: Complication: a secondary disease arising from the same doṣa as the main disease and appearing later; it should be treated quickly, as it weakens the patient.
terms.hi: उपद्रव - मुख्य रोग के ही दोष से बाद में उत्पन्न गौण रोग।

terms.en: Signs indicating approaching death, described in Caraka's Indriyasthāna and AH.sharira.5; they appear as flowers foretell fruit. Not to be confused with ariṣṭa the fermented preparation.
terms.hi: अरिष्ट (रिष्ट) - मृत्यु-सूचक लक्षण; चरक इन्द्रियस्थान। (अरिष्ट कल्पना से भिन्न)

terms.en: Occlusion: one vāta subtype or a doṣa, dhātu or mala obstructing the movement of vāta (e.g. kapha-āvṛta vāta), producing complex symptoms. Caraka describes it in vātavyādhi.
terms.hi: आवरण - किसी दोष, धातु या मल द्वारा वात की गति का अवरोध (जैसे कफावृत वात)।

terms.en: Diseases caused by a single specific doṣa: 80 of vāta, 40 of pitta and 20 of kapha (Caraka), as opposed to sāmānyaja diseases caused by any doṣa.
terms.hi: नानात्मज व्याधि - एक विशिष्ट दोष से: वात 80, पित्त 40, कफ 20 (चरक)।

terms.en: Diseases that can be produced by any of the doṣas (e.g. jvara, atisāra), classified by the doṣa involved.
terms.hi: सामान्यज व्याधि - किसी भी दोष से होने वाले रोग (ज्वर, अतिसार)।

terms.en: Rugviniścaya of Mādhavakara (about 7th-8th century CE), the standard text of diagnosis, arranged disease-wise by nidāna pañcaka; first to describe āmavāta and amlapitta as separate diseases.
terms.hi: माधव निदान (रुग्विनिश्चय) - माधवकर; निदान का प्रमुख ग्रन्थ; आमवात, अम्लपित्त का प्रथम स्वतन्त्र वर्णन।

terms.en: Examination of the patient (to know strength and constitution), as distinct from roga parīkṣā (examination of the disease by nidāna pañcaka). Caraka's tenfold examination is the main method.
terms.hi: रोगी परीक्षा - रोगी का बल, प्रकृति आदि जानना; रोग परीक्षा (निदान पञ्चक) से भिन्न।

terms.en: Threefold examination of the patient by darśana (inspection), sparśana (touch/palpation) and praśna (questioning) (Vāgbhaṭa). Caraka uses 'trividha parīkṣā' also for the three pramāṇas.
terms.hi: त्रिविध परीक्षा - दर्शन, स्पर्शन, प्रश्न (वाग्भट)।

terms.en: Suśruta's sixfold examination: by the five senses (hearing, touch, sight, taste, smell) and by questioning (praśna).
terms.hi: षड्विध परीक्षा (सुश्रुत) - पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रियाँ + प्रश्न।

terms.en: Eightfold examination popularised by Yogaratnākara: nāḍī (pulse), mūtra (urine), mala (stool), jihvā (tongue), śabda (voice/sounds), sparśa (touch), dṛk (eyes) and ākṛti (general appearance).
terms.hi: अष्टविध परीक्षा (योगरत्नाकर) - नाडी, मूत्र, मल, जिह्वा, शब्द, स्पर्श, दृक्, आकृति।
terms.modern: Comparable to a bedside general and systemic examination.

terms.en: Pulse examination at the radial artery with three fingers (index for vāta, middle for pitta, ring for kapha). Pulse movement is likened to a snake (vāta), frog (pitta) and swan (kapha). Not described in the Bṛhattrayī; developed by Śārṅgadhara and later texts.
terms.hi: नाडी परीक्षा - तीन अंगुलियों से कलाई की नाडी; वात सर्प, पित्त मण्डूक, कफ हंस गति; बृहत्त्रयी में वर्णित नहीं।
terms.modern: Radial pulse examination; the doṣa-wise interpretation has limited validation.

terms.en: Tongue examination: a coated (lipta) tongue suggests āma; dry, cracked tongue suggests vāta; red/yellow suggests pitta; white, slimy suggests kapha.
terms.hi: जिह्वा परीक्षा - लिप्त जिह्वा = आम; रूक्ष-फटी = वात; लाल-पीली = पित्त; श्वेत-पिच्छिल = कफ।

terms.en: Urine examination including colour and the taila-bindu test (behaviour of an oil drop placed on urine) described in later texts to judge doṣa and prognosis.
terms.hi: मूत्र परीक्षा - रंग आदि और तैल-बिन्दु परीक्षा (मूत्र पर तेल की बूँद का व्यवहार)।
terms.modern: Urinalysis (crude); the oil-drop test is not validated.

terms.en: Caraka's tenfold examination of the patient: prakṛti, vikṛti, sāra, saṃhanana, pramāṇa, sātmya, sattva, āhāraśakti, vyāyāmaśakti and vayas; used to judge strength (bala) and plan dose.
terms.hi: दशविध परीक्षा (चरक) - प्रकृति, विकृति, सार, संहनन, प्रमाण, सात्म्य, सत्त्व, आहारशक्ति, व्यायामशक्ति, वय।
terms.modern: Comparable to a holistic assessment of constitution, fitness and tolerance.

terms.en: The morbid state: the disease and its strength, assessed through hetu, doṣa, dūṣya, prakṛti, deśa, kāla and signs. Second item of the tenfold examination.
