terms.hi: विकृति - विकार की अवस्था और बल; दशविध परीक्षा का दूसरा अंग।

terms.en: Assessment of the best-developed tissue: eight sāras - tvak (rasa), rakta, māṃsa, medas, asthi, majjā, śukra and sattva. A person with all sāras is strongest. Distinct from sara (mobile) guṇa.
terms.hi: सार परीक्षा - सबसे उत्तम धातु का ज्ञान; आठ सार: त्वक् (रस), रक्त, मांस, मेद, अस्थि, मज्जा, शुक्र, सत्त्व।
terms.modern: Loosely comparable to assessing tissue quality/physical fitness.

terms.en: Compactness of body build: well-knit (susaṃhata) body with balanced bones, joints and muscles indicates strength.
terms.hi: संहनन - शरीर का सुगठन; सुसंहत शरीर बलवान।

terms.en: Examination of body measurements in the person's own aṅgulas; proportionate measure indicates long life and strength.
terms.hi: प्रमाण परीक्षा - अपनी अंगुलि से शरीर के माप; समप्रमाण शरीर दीर्घायु।

terms.en: Capacity for food: abhyavaharaṇa śakti (ability to take food) and jaraṇa śakti (ability to digest), indicating agni and strength.
terms.hi: आहारशक्ति - अभ्यवहरण शक्ति (भोजन ग्रहण) और जरण शक्ति (पाचन)।

terms.en: Capacity for exercise, judged by tolerance of physical work; indicates strength.
terms.hi: व्यायामशक्ति - शारीरिक श्रम की क्षमता।

terms.en: Fever, called the 'king of diseases' (rogapati); its cardinal feature is santāpa (raised temperature affecting body and mind). Arises from āma in the āmāśaya obstructing channels and driving agni outward. Eight types by doṣa (3 single, 3 dual, sannipāta, āgantu).
terms.hi: ज्वर - रोगों का राजा (रोगपति); मुख्य लक्षण सन्ताप; आम द्वारा स्रोतोरोध से अग्नि बाहर; आठ प्रकार।
terms.modern: Fever (a symptom of many diseases); classical jvara also includes some non-infectious and mental states.

terms.en: Irregular/intermittent fever with five types: santata, satata, anyedyuṣka, tṛtīyaka and caturthaka.
terms.hi: विषमज्वर - अनियमित ज्वर; सन्तत, सतत, अन्येद्युष्क, तृतीयक, चतुर्थक।
terms.modern: Often compared to intermittent fevers such as malaria (tṛtīyaka and caturthaka resemble tertian and quartan patterns).

terms.en: Diarrhoea: excessive passage of liquid stools. Six types: vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja, bhayaja and śokaja; sāma and nirāma stages guide treatment.
terms.hi: अतिसार - दस्त; छह प्रकार: वातज, पित्तज, कफज, सन्निपातज, भयज, शोकज।

terms.en: Frequent, painful straining with small stools mixed with mucus (and sometimes blood).
terms.hi: प्रवाहिका - बार-बार कुन्थन के साथ थोड़ा, आँव (कभी रक्त) युक्त मल।

terms.en: Disorder of the grahaṇī due to weak agni: stools alternately loose and hard, undigested food in stool, with indigestion and weakness.
terms.hi: ग्रहणी रोग - मन्द अग्नि से ग्रहणी विकार; कभी पतला कभी बद्ध मल, अपक्व अन्न युक्त।
terms.modern: Often compared to malabsorption syndromes and irritable bowel syndrome.

terms.en: Fleshy growths in the anal canal that torment like an enemy (ari). Six types (vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, raktaja, sannipātaja, sahaja), dry (śuṣka) or bleeding (ārdra/srāvī). Treated by drugs, kṣāra, agni and śastra.
terms.hi: अर्श - गुदा में मांसांकुर जो शत्रु की तरह पीड़ा दें; छह प्रकार; शुष्क और स्रावी।

terms.en: Cough, named for its sound. Five types: vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, kṣataja (from chest injury) and kṣayaja (from tissue wasting).
terms.hi: कास - खाँसी; पाँच प्रकार: वातज, पित्तज, कफज, क्षतज, क्षयज।

terms.en: Dyspnoea/breathlessness. Five types: mahā, ūrdhva, chinna, tamaka and kṣudra; it shares causes with hikkā and arises from the āmāśaya with kapha obstructing vāta.
terms.hi: श्वास - साँस फूलना; पाँच प्रकार: महा, ऊर्ध्व, छिन्न, तमक, क्षुद्र।
terms.modern: Dyspnoea; tamaka śvāsa is often compared to bronchial asthma.

terms.en: Type of śvāsa with attacks of wheezing (ghurghuraka), worse at night and in cold, cloudy weather, relieved by sitting up and expectoration; considered yāpya.
terms.hi: तमक श्वास - घुर्घुर ध्वनि, रात्रि व मेघ-ऋतु में वृद्धि, बैठने व कफ निकलने से आराम; याप्य।

terms.en: Hiccup (also hidhmā). Five types: annajā, yamalā, kṣudrā, gambhīrā and mahatī.
terms.hi: हिक्का (हिध्मा) - हिचकी; पाँच प्रकार: अन्नजा, यमला, क्षुद्रा, गम्भीरा, महती।

terms.en: 'King of wasting diseases' (also śoṣa, kṣaya), with progressive depletion of dhātus beginning from blocked channels or loss of śukra and ojas; classically it first afflicted the Moon (king of stars). Cardinal features include cough, fever, emaciation and haemoptysis.
terms.hi: राजयक्ष्मा (शोष, क्षय) - धातुओं का क्रमिक क्षय; कास, ज्वर, कृशता, रक्तष्ठीवन।
terms.modern: Often compared to pulmonary tuberculosis, but the classical concept is broader (wasting states).

terms.en: Wasting/drying of the body and dhātus; used as a synonym of rājayakṣmā and also for wasting from various causes (e.g. excess sex, grief, ageing, travel, injury).
terms.hi: शोष - शरीर व धातुओं का सूखना; राजयक्ष्मा का पर्याय।

terms.en: Group of 20 urinary disorders with excessive and turbid urination: 10 kaphaja, 6 pittaja and 4 vātaja. Medas, kleda and kapha are the main dūṣyas. Untreated, they become incurable (madhumeha).
terms.hi: प्रमेह - अधिक व आविल मूत्र वाले 20 रोग: 10 कफज, 6 पित्तज, 4 वातज।
terms.modern: Polyuric metabolic disorders; overlaps with diabetes mellitus and other urinary conditions.

terms.en: A vātaja prameha in which the patient passes honey-like (sweet, astringent, pale, dry) urine and the body also becomes sweet; all pramehas when neglected end as madhumeha. Two causes: dhātu-kṣaya and āvaraṇa (obstruction).
terms.hi: मधुमेह - वातज प्रमेह; मधु जैसा मीठा मूत्र; उपेक्षित सभी प्रमेह मधुमेह बनते हैं; धातुक्षय और आवरण से।

terms.en: Skin diseases in general ('that which disfigures'), always involving all three doṣas with tvak, rakta, māṃsa and ambu (seven dravyas). Caraka: 7 mahākuṣṭha and 11 kṣudrakuṣṭha (18 total). Not limited to leprosy.
terms.hi: कुष्ठ - त्वचा रोग; सात द्रव्य दूषित (त्रिदोष + त्वक्, रक्त, मांस, अम्बु); 7 महाकुष्ठ + 11 क्षुद्रकुष्ठ = 18।
terms.modern: Skin diseases broadly (eczema, psoriasis, fungal infections, etc.); some descriptions resemble leprosy but kuṣṭha is not synonymous with it.

terms.en: White patches of skin without discharge (also kilāsa); Caraka says it arises from untruthfulness, ingratitude, insulting gods/teachers, sins and viruddha āhāra. Old, hairless patches and those on genitals/palms are hard to cure.
terms.hi: श्वित्र (किलास) - त्वचा पर सफेद दाग, स्राव रहित।

terms.en: Disease characterised by pallor (pāṇḍu = yellowish-white), with weakness, breathlessness and loss of ojas qualities. Five types: vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja and mṛdbhakṣaṇaja (from eating clay) per Caraka.
terms.hi: पाण्डु - पीला-सफेद वर्ण, दुर्बलता, श्वास; पाँच प्रकार (मृद्भक्षणजन्य सहित)।

terms.en: Yellow discolouration of eyes, skin, urine and nails due to pitta, often following pāṇḍu. Caraka distinguishes koṣṭhāśrita (bahupittā) and śākhāśrita (rūddhapathā, with pale stools).
terms.hi: कामला - पित्त से नेत्र, त्वचा, मूत्र का पीलापन; कोष्ठाश्रित और शाखाश्रित।
terms.modern: Often compared to jaundice; śākhāśrita kāmalā resembles obstructive jaundice.

terms.en: Bleeding disorder where aggravated pitta vitiates blood, which escapes through upper orifices (ūrdhvaga, kapha-associated), lower orifices (adhoga, vāta-associated) or both (ubhayaga).
terms.hi: रक्तपित्त - पित्त से दूषित रक्त का ऊर्ध्व (मुख-नासा), अधो (गुद-मूत्र) या उभय मार्ग से स्राव।
terms.modern: Haemorrhagic disorders (e.g. epistaxis, haemoptysis, bleeding diatheses).

terms.en: Disorder of sour (vidagdha) pitta with sour/bitter belching, burning in throat and chest, nausea and indigestion; ūrdhvaga and adhoga types. Described in detail by Kāśyapa and Mādhava.
terms.hi: अम्लपित्त - अम्लोद्गार, कण्ठ-हृदय दाह, उत्क्लेश; ऊर्ध्वग व अधोग।
terms.modern: Often compared to gastritis, hyperacidity and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease.

terms.en: Disease in which āma, carried by vāta, lodges in kapha sites, especially joints, causing painful swelling, stiffness, fever and heaviness; pain moves like a scorpion sting. First described as a separate disease by Mādhavakara.
terms.hi: आमवात - वात द्वारा वहित आम का सन्धियों में स्थित होना; वृश्चिक-दंश जैसी वेदना, शोथ, जकड़न।

terms.en: Disease in which aggravated vāta is obstructed by vitiated rakta, starting in the small joints of the feet (or hands), with pain, swelling and discolouration; uttāna (superficial) and gambhīra (deep) types. Also called vātaśoṇita, āḍhyavāta.
terms.hi: वातरक्त - दुष्ट रक्त द्वारा वात का अवरोध; पैरों के छोटे जोड़ों से आरम्भ; उत्तान व गम्भीर।
terms.modern: Often compared to gout, and sometimes to other inflammatory arthropathies.

terms.en: Diseases caused specifically by vāta (80 nānātmaja types), either from dhātu-kṣaya or mārgāvaraṇa (obstruction); includes pakṣāghāta, ardita, gṛdhrasī, sandhivāta and others.
terms.hi: वातव्याधि - वात जन्य रोग (80 नानात्मज); धातुक्षय या मार्गावरण से।

terms.en: Vāta lodged in joints producing swelling that feels like an air-filled bag, pain on movement and restricted flexion/extension; described under vātavyādhi.
terms.hi: सन्धिवात - सन्धि में वात; वायु भरी थैली जैसा शोथ, गति में वेदना।

terms.en: Pain beginning in the buttock and radiating down the back of the thigh, knee and calf to the foot with stiffness; the gait resembles a vulture (gṛdhra). Vātaja and vāta-kaphaja types.
terms.hi: गृध्रसी - नितम्ब से पैर तक फैलती वेदना; गिद्ध जैसी चाल; वातज और वात-कफज।

terms.en: Paralysis of one half of the body (pakṣa) with loss of movement and sensation, caused by vāta (often with āvaraṇa).
terms.hi: पक्षाघात - शरीर के एक भाग का लकवा।
terms.modern: Often compared to hemiplegia (e.g. after stroke).

terms.en: Deviation of half of the face, with difficulty in speech, closing the eye and eating; caused by vāta.
terms.hi: अर्दित - मुख का आधा भाग टेढ़ा होना।
terms.modern: Often compared to facial palsy (e.g. Bell's palsy).

terms.en: Tremor disorder due to vāta (vepathu in the classics; named kampavāta in Basavarājīyam).
terms.hi: कम्पवात (वेपथु) - वात से कम्पन।

terms.en: Episodic loss of memory/consciousness (apa-smṛti) with abhorrent movements, due to doṣas affecting the heart, mind and channels of consciousness. Four types: vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja.
terms.hi: अपस्मार - स्मृति का अपगम; दौरे में संज्ञानाश, विकृत चेष्टाएँ; चार प्रकार।

terms.en: Derangement of mind, intellect, consciousness, memory, desires, conduct and behaviour. Six types per Vāgbhaṭa: three doṣaja, sannipātaja, ādhija (grief) and viṣaja; Caraka also describes āgantu (bhūta) unmāda.
terms.hi: उन्माद - मन, बुद्धि, संज्ञा, स्मृति, आचार का विभ्रम; छह प्रकार।

terms.en: Heart disease, five types: vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja and krimija.
terms.hi: हृद्रोग - हृदय रोग; पाँच प्रकार (कृमिज सहित)।
terms.modern: Heart disease (broad; correlation of types with specific modern diseases is speculative).

terms.en: Abdominal enlargement, arising mainly from weak agni and blocked channels; eight types: vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja (dūṣyodara), plīhodara, baddhodara, kṣatodara and jalodara.
terms.hi: उदर रोग - पेट का बढ़ना; मन्दाग्नि मुख्य कारण; आठ प्रकार (जलोदर सहित)।
terms.modern: Abdominal distension; jalodara is often compared to ascites.

terms.en: A round, mobile or fixed mass in the abdomen between heart and bladder, like a knot of air, without suppuration; five types: three doṣaja, sannipātaja and raktaja (in women).
terms.hi: गुल्म - हृदय-बस्ति के बीच गोल, चल या स्थिर गाँठ, पाकरहित; पाँच प्रकार।
terms.modern: Abdominal masses or phantom swellings; correlation is uncertain.

terms.en: Swelling (also śvayathu, śopha), local or general, of vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja and other types; nija or āgantuja.
terms.hi: शोथ (श्वयथु) - सूजन; स्थानीय या सर्वाङ्ग।

terms.en: Rapidly spreading (visarpaṇa) inflammatory skin condition involving rakta, lasīkā, tvak and māṃsa; seven types (vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja, agni, granthi, kardama).
terms.hi: विसर्प - तेज़ी से फैलने वाला त्वचा-शोथ; सात प्रकार।
terms.modern: Often compared to erysipelas and cellulitis; some forms resemble herpes zoster.

terms.en: Abscess: a deep, painful, rapidly suppurating swelling, external or internal.
terms.hi: विद्रधि - गहरा, पीड़ायुक्त, शीघ्र पकने वाला शोथ (बाह्य/आभ्यन्तर)।

terms.en: Painful and difficult urination; eight types per Caraka.
terms.hi: मूत्रकृच्छ्र - कष्टपूर्वक मूत्र त्याग; आठ प्रकार।

terms.en: Obstruction or suppression of urine (retention), with several types including aṣṭhīlā and mūtrotsaṅga; distinguished from mūtrakṛcchra by obstruction predominating over pain.
terms.hi: मूत्राघात - मूत्र का अवरोध/अल्पता।
terms.modern: Urinary retention / obstructive uropathy (e.g. prostatic enlargement).

terms.en: Worms and microorganisms: Caraka describes 20 types, external (bāhya: lice etc.) and internal (purīṣaja, śleṣmaja, raktaja).
terms.hi: कृमि - कीड़े/सूक्ष्म जीव; 20 प्रकार; बाह्य और आभ्यन्तर।
terms.modern: Parasites (helminths, lice) and, for raktaja types, possibly microorganisms.

terms.en: Vomiting: five types (vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, sannipātaja and dviṣṭārtha-saṃyogaja, from disliked objects).
terms.hi: छर्दि - वमन (उल्टी); पाँच प्रकार।

terms.en: Morbid thirst, a disease when excessive; Caraka describes five types and Suśruta seven. Normal thirst is a vega that should not be suppressed.
terms.hi: तृष्णा - अत्यधिक प्यास (रोग); सामान्य प्यास अधारणीय वेग।

terms.en: Loss of taste/relish for food although hunger may be present (aruci); five types.
terms.hi: अरोचक (अरुचि) - भोजन में रुचि न होना।

terms.en: Indigestion; four main types: āma (kapha), vidagdha (pitta), viṣṭabdha (vāta) and rasaśeṣa. Considered a root of many diseases.
terms.hi: अजीर्ण - अपच; चार प्रकार: आम, विदग्ध, विष्टब्ध, रसशेष।

terms.en: Acute condition from overeating/indigestion with simultaneous vomiting and diarrhoea and piercing pains as if by needles (sūcī).
terms.hi: विषूचिका - सुई चुभने जैसी पीड़ा के साथ एक साथ वमन और अतिसार।
terms.modern: Often compared to cholera / acute gastroenteritis.

terms.en: Indigestion in which food stagnates in the gut without vomiting or purging, with distension and pain; its severe form is daṇḍālasaka.
terms.hi: अलसक - अन्न आमाशय में रुका रहे, न वमन न विरेचन; आध्मान।
terms.modern: Comparable to acute gastric stasis/ileus-like states.

terms.en: Obesity: excess medas and māṃsa, with pendulous buttocks, abdomen and breasts and reduced enthusiasm; one of Caraka's eight nindita (undesirable) body types; medoroga.
terms.hi: स्थौल्य - मोटापा; मेद-मांस की अधिकता; चरक के आठ निन्दित पुरुषों में।

terms.en: Emaciation/underweight; Caraka considers excessive thinness worse than obesity in some respects. One of the eight nindita types.
terms.hi: कार्श्य - अत्यधिक दुबलापन; आठ निन्दित पुरुषों में।

terms.en: Headache (śiroroga); includes ardhāvabhedaka (half-sided headache) and sūryāvarta (headache waxing and waning with the sun).
terms.hi: शिरःशूल - सिरदर्द; अर्धावभेदक, सूर्यावर्त आदि।
terms.modern: Headache; ardhāvabhedaka is often compared to migraine.

terms.en: Simultaneous vitiation of all three doṣas; such diseases are generally severe and hard to cure. Combination of two doṣas is saṃsarga.
terms.hi: सन्निपात - तीनों दोषों का एक साथ प्रकोप; दो दोषों का = संसर्ग।

terms.en: Combined vitiation of two doṣas (dvandva).
terms.hi: संसर्ग - दो दोषों का एक साथ प्रकोप।

terms.en: Treatment: all measures that restore balance of the dhātus (doṣas, tissues, wastes). Caraka defines it as the effort that brings imbalanced dhātus back to equilibrium; synonyms include bheṣaja, praśamana, prakṛti-sthāpana and hita.
terms.hi: चिकित्सा - विषम धातुओं को सम करने वाला प्रयत्न; पर्याय भेषज, प्रशमन, प्रकृतिस्थापन।

terms.en: The four 'feet' of treatment: bhiṣak (physician), dravya (drug), upasthātā (attendant/nurse) and rogī (patient), each with four qualities. The physician is the most important.
terms.hi: चिकित्सा चतुष्पाद - भिषक्, द्रव्य, उपस्थाता, रोगी; प्रत्येक के चार गुण; वैद्य प्रधान।

terms.en: Physician (also vaidya). Ideal qualities: dakṣa (skilful), learned from a proper teacher, experienced in practice and pure (śuci).
terms.hi: भिषक् (वैद्य) - चिकित्सक; गुण: दक्ष, गुरु से शास्त्र ज्ञान, दृष्टकर्मा, शुचि।

terms.en: Attendant/nurse, one of the four limbs of treatment; should be devoted, clean, skilful and intelligent.
terms.hi: उपस्थाता (परिचारक) - अनुरक्त, शुचि, दक्ष, बुद्धिमान।

terms.en: Caraka's three approaches to treatment: daivavyapāśraya (spiritual/faith-based), yuktivyapāśraya (rational: diet, drugs, procedures) and sattvāvajaya (control of the mind).
terms.hi: त्रिविध औषध - दैवव्यपाश्रय, युक्तिव्यपाश्रय, सत्त्वावजय।

terms.en: Faith/spiritual therapy: mantras, auspicious acts, offerings, prayers, gems, fasting, pilgrimage and the like.
terms.hi: दैवव्यपाश्रय - मन्त्र, मंगल कर्म, बलि, होम, मणि धारण, उपवास आदि।
terms.modern: Comparable to spiritual care and placebo-related healing rituals.

terms.en: Rational therapy based on reasoning: appropriate planning of diet and medicines (antaḥparimārjana, bahiḥparimārjana and śastrapraṇidhāna).
terms.hi: युक्तिव्यपाश्रय - युक्तिपूर्वक आहार-औषध योजना; अन्तःपरिमार्जन, बहिःपरिमार्जन, शस्त्रप्रणिधान।

terms.en: 'Conquest of the mind': withdrawing the mind from unwholesome objects through knowledge (jñāna), science (vijñāna), courage (dhairya), memory (smṛti) and concentration (samādhi).
terms.hi: सत्त्वावजय - अहितकर विषयों से मन को रोकना; ज्ञान, विज्ञान, धैर्य, स्मृति, समाधि द्वारा।
terms.modern: Often compared to psychotherapy and counselling.

terms.en: Internal medication: treatment given inside the body (oral drugs, diet) for diseases due to faulty diet.
terms.hi: अन्तःपरिमार्जन - शरीर के भीतर दी जाने वाली चिकित्सा (मुख से औषध, आहार)।

terms.en: External therapy through the skin: abhyaṅga, sveda, pradeha, pariṣeka, unmardana and similar.
terms.hi: बहिःपरिमार्जन - बाहरी चिकित्सा: अभ्यंग, स्वेद, प्रदेह, परिषेक, उन्मर्दन।

terms.en: Surgical measures: excision, incision, puncture, scraping, extraction, application of leeches and the like.
terms.hi: शस्त्रप्रणिधान - शस्त्र कर्म: छेदन, भेदन, व्यधन, लेखन, जलौका आदि।

terms.en: Reducing (lightening) therapy: anything that produces lightness of the body (apatarpaṇa). Caraka lists ten types: four kinds of purification (vamana, virecana, nirūha, śirovirecana), thirst, wind, sun, pācana, fasting and exercise. Vāgbhaṭa divides it into śodhana (5) and śamana (7).
terms.hi: लंघन - शरीर में लघुता लाने वाली चिकित्सा (अपतर्पण); शोधन और शमन रूप।
terms.modern: Comparable to fasting and reducing therapies.

terms.en: Nourishing (building) therapy that produces bulk (santarpaṇa), for the emaciated, weak, convalescent, elderly and those exhausted by disease, sorrow or travel.
terms.hi: बृंहण - शरीर को पुष्ट करने वाली चिकित्सा (सन्तर्पण); कृश, दुर्बल, क्षीण के लिए।

terms.en: The six fundamental therapeutic measures (Caraka): laṅghana, bṛṃhaṇa, rūkṣaṇa, snehana, svedana and stambhana; Vāgbhaṭa reduces them to two (bṛṃhaṇa and laṅghana).
terms.hi: षडुपक्रम - छह मूल उपक्रम: लंघन, बृंहण, रूक्षण, स्नेहन, स्वेदन, स्तम्भन।

terms.en: Drying therapy that produces dryness and roughness, e.g. dry powders, udvartana, dry fomentation; used in kapha and medas conditions and before snehana when āma is present.
terms.hi: रूक्षण - रूक्षता उत्पन्न करने वाली चिकित्सा; कफ-मेद रोगों में।

terms.en: Fasting, a form of laṅghana used for āma, fever and kapha disorders; contraindicated in the weak and in vāta conditions.
terms.hi: उपवास - लंघन का प्रकार; आम, ज्वर, कफ में; दुर्बल व वात में निषिद्ध।

terms.en: Treatment opposite to the cause (e.g. hot, unctuous food for cold-dry causes); one of the upaśaya methods. With vyādhi-viparīta and ubhaya-viparīta it gives the basic logic of treatment.
terms.hi: हेतुविपरीत - कारण के विपरीत चिकित्सा; व्याधिविपरीत और उभयविपरीत के साथ।

terms.en: Treatment that directly opposes the disease regardless of cause, e.g. kuṭaja for diarrhoea.
terms.hi: व्याधिविपरीत - सीधे रोग के विपरीत चिकित्सा; जैसे अतिसार में कुटज।

terms.en: Treatment that seems similar to the cause or disease but works to relieve it, e.g. emetics in vomiting, or warm fomentation in a pitta-type swelling to hasten suppuration.
terms.hi: विपरीतार्थकारी - हेतु या व्याधि के समान दिखकर भी रोग का शमन करने वाली चिकित्सा (जैसे छर्दि में वमन)।
terms.modern: Loosely comparable to paradoxical or 'like-treats-like' interventions.

terms.en: Avoidance of causative factors: the first and essential principle of treatment (Suśruta: 'saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam').
terms.hi: निदानपरिवर्जन - रोग के कारणों का त्याग; चिकित्सा का प्रथम सूत्र।

terms.en: Wholesome diet and regimen, that which does not harm the 'path' (channels) and is pleasing to the mind; Lolimbarāja says with pathya medicine is hardly needed, without it medicine fails.
terms.hi: पथ्य - हितकर आहार-विहार जो स्रोतों को हानि न करे।
terms.modern: Comparable to a therapeutic diet/lifestyle prescription.

terms.en: Unwholesome diet and regimen to be avoided in a given disease or state.
terms.hi: अपथ्य - अहितकर आहार-विहार।

terms.en: Medicine; divided into śodhana (purifying) and śamana (pacifying). Synonym: bheṣaja.
terms.hi: औषध (भेषज) - दवा; शोधन और शमन।

terms.en: Rasāyana taken by a healthy person for a desired goal: prāṇakāmya (longevity), medhākāmya (intellect) or śrīkāmya (lustre).
terms.hi: काम्य रसायन - स्वस्थ व्यक्ति द्वारा इच्छित लक्ष्य हेतु: प्राणकाम्य, मेधाकाम्य, श्रीकाम्य।

terms.en: Rasāyana given in a particular disease to aid recovery and prevent recurrence, e.g. śilājatu in prameha.
terms.hi: नैमित्तिक रसायन - विशेष रोग में दिया जाने वाला रसायन (जैसे प्रमेह में शिलाजतु)।

terms.en: Indoor method of rasāyana in a specially built three-chambered hut (kuṭī) after śodhana, under strict regimen; contrasted with vātātapika (outdoor) rasāyana for ordinary life.
terms.hi: कुटीप्रावेशिक रसायन - शोधन के बाद त्रिगर्भा कुटी में कठोर नियम से; वातातपिक (बाहरी) से भिन्न।

terms.en: 'Wind-and-sun' method: rasāyana taken while continuing normal daily life, with less benefit but more convenience than kuṭīprāveśika.
terms.hi: वातातपिक रसायन - सामान्य दिनचर्या जारी रखते हुए रसायन सेवन।

terms.en: Behavioural rejuvenation: truthfulness, non-anger, non-violence, abstinence from alcohol, calmness, cleanliness, charity, respect for elders and teachers, etc., which yield rasāyana benefits without drugs.
terms.hi: आचार रसायन - सत्य, अक्रोध, अहिंसा, शान्ति, शौच, दान, गुरु-वृद्ध सेवा आदि से बिना औषध रसायन लाभ।
terms.modern: Comparable to the health benefits of ethical living and psychological well-being.

terms.en: Four intellect-promoting rasāyanas of Caraka: maṇḍūkaparṇī svarasa, yaṣṭimadhu cūrṇa with milk, guḍūcī svarasa and śaṅkhapuṣpī kalka; śaṅkhapuṣpī is said to be the best.
terms.hi: मेध्य रसायन - मण्डूकपर्णी स्वरस, यष्टिमधु चूर्ण, गुडूची स्वरस, शङ्खपुष्पी कल्क; शङ्खपुष्पी श्रेष्ठ।

terms.en: Physician; literally 'one who has knowledge (vidyā)'. Caraka calls one with both knowledge and skill a 'prāṇābhisara' (saviour of life).
terms.hi: वैद्य - विद्या जानने वाला; चिकित्सक।

terms.en: The five purification procedures. Caraka: vamana, virecana, nirūha (āsthāpana) basti, anuvāsana basti and nasya (śirovirecana). Suśruta counts basti as one and includes raktamokṣaṇa. Performed with pūrvakarma and paścātkarma.
terms.hi: पञ्चकर्म - पाँच शोधन कर्म; चरक: वमन, विरेचन, निरूह, अनुवासन, नस्य; सुश्रुत: बस्ति एक, रक्तमोक्षण सम्मिलित।
terms.modern: Comparable to structured elimination/detoxification protocols; evidence varies by procedure.

terms.en: Preparatory procedures before main śodhana: dīpana-pācana (to digest āma), snehana and svedana, which loosen doṣas and bring them from the periphery (śākhā) to the koṣṭha.
terms.hi: पूर्वकर्म - शोधन से पहले: दीपन-पाचन, स्नेहन, स्वेदन; दोषों को शाखा से कोष्ठ में लाना।

terms.en: The main procedure itself (vamana, virecana, basti, nasya or raktamokṣaṇa).
terms.hi: प्रधानकर्म - मुख्य शोधन कर्म।

terms.en: Post-procedure care: dhūmapāna (after vamana), saṃsarjana krama (graded diet), rasāyana and avoidance of the eight strainful activities (parihārya viṣaya).
terms.hi: पश्चात्कर्म - शोधन के बाद: धूमपान, संसर्जन क्रम, रसायन, परिहार्य विषयों का त्याग।

terms.en: Oleation therapy producing unctuousness, softness and moistness: internal (snehapāna) and external (abhyaṅga etc.). The four mahāsnehas are sarpis (ghee), majjā, vasā and taila; ghee is the best.
terms.hi: स्नेहन - शरीर में स्निग्धता लाने वाली चिकित्सा; आभ्यन्तर (स्नेहपान) और बाह्य (अभ्यंग); चार महास्नेह, घृत श्रेष्ठ।
terms.modern: Oleation (internal intake of medicated fats and external oil application).

terms.en: Internal intake of sneha. Types by purpose: śodhanāṅga (before śodhana, in increasing doses), śamana (for pacification, before food when hungry) and bṛṃhaṇa (with food). Acchapāna is sneha taken alone.
terms.hi: स्नेहपान - स्नेह का पान; शोधनाङ्ग (वर्धमान मात्रा), शमन, बृंहण; अच्छपान = केवल स्नेह।

terms.en: Drinking pure sneha without mixing it with food (vicāraṇā); the best form of snehapāna for śodhana preparation.
terms.hi: अच्छपान - बिना अन्न मिलाए केवल स्नेह पीना; शोधन हेतु श्रेष्ठ।

terms.en: Sneha given mixed with food or other preparations (e.g. in rice, soups, milk), for those who cannot take pure sneha; Caraka lists 24 such forms.
terms.hi: विचारणा स्नेह - अन्न आदि में मिलाकर दिया गया स्नेह; चरक 24 प्रकार।

terms.en: Signs of proper oleation: vāta moving downward (anulomana), good appetite, unctuous and unformed stools, softness and unctuousness of the body, and aversion to sneha with tiredness.
terms.hi: सम्यक् स्निग्ध लक्षण - वातानुलोमन, दीप्त अग्नि, स्निग्ध-असंहत मल, अंगों में मृदुता-स्निग्धता, स्नेह से अरुचि।

terms.en: Sudation therapy that relieves stiffness, heaviness and cold and induces sweating. Caraka: 13 sāgni (with fire) and 10 niragni (without fire) types; Vāgbhaṭa: four types - tāpa, upanāha, ūṣma and drava.
terms.hi: स्वेदन - स्तम्भ, गौरव, शीत दूर कर पसीना लाने वाली चिकित्सा; चरक: 13 साग्नि, 10 निरग्नि; वाग्भट: ताप, उपनाह, ऊष्म, द्रव।
terms.modern: Comparable to thermal therapy/fomentation (heat increases circulation and relieves muscle spasm).

terms.en: Sudation using fire/heat; Caraka's 13 types: saṅkara, prastara, nāḍī, pariṣeka, avagāha, jentāka, aśmaghna, karṣū, kuṭī, bhū, kumbhī, kūpa and holāka.
terms.hi: साग्नि स्वेद - अग्नि द्वारा स्वेद; 13 प्रकार: सङ्कर, प्रस्तर, नाडी, परिषेक, अवगाह, जेन्ताक आदि।

terms.en: Sudation without fire; Caraka's 10 means: vyāyāma (exercise), uṣṇa sadana (warm room), guru prāvaraṇa (heavy covering), kṣudhā (hunger), bahupāna (much drinking), bhaya (fear), krodha (anger), upanāha (poultice), āhava (fighting) and ātapa (sunlight).
terms.hi: निरग्नि स्वेद - बिना अग्नि; 10 प्रकार: व्यायाम, उष्ण सदन, गुरु प्रावरण, क्षुधा, बहुपान, भय, क्रोध, उपनाह, आहव, आतप।

terms.en: Steam directed through a tube (nāḍī) from a vessel of boiling decoction onto a body part.
terms.hi: नाडी स्वेद - नली द्वारा क्वाथ की भाप शरीर के भाग पर देना।

terms.en: Sudation with heated boluses (piṇḍa/poṭṭalī) of herbs, sand, leaves (patra piṇḍa) or rice cooked in milk and decoction (ṣaṣṭika-śāli piṇḍa sveda, njavarakizhi); a form of saṅkara sveda.
terms.hi: पिण्ड स्वेद - गरम पोटली से स्वेद (पत्र पिण्ड, षष्टिकशालि पिण्ड स्वेद)।

terms.en: Therapeutic emesis: expulsion of doṣas, chiefly kapha, through the mouth; best treatment for kapha (e.g. kāsa, śvāsa, kuṣṭha with kapha). Śuddhi graded by vegas: 8 pravara, 6 madhyama, 4 avara.
terms.hi: वमन - मुख द्वारा दोष (मुख्यतः कफ) का निष्कासन; कफ की श्रेष्ठ चिकित्सा; वेग: 8 प्रवर, 6 मध्यम, 4 अवर।

terms.en: Therapeutic purgation: expulsion of doṣas, chiefly pitta, through the anus; best treatment for pitta. Śuddhi graded by vegas: 30 pravara, 20 madhyama, 10 avara.
terms.hi: विरेचन - गुदा द्वारा दोष (मुख्यतः पित्त) का निष्कासन; पित्त की श्रेष्ठ चिकित्सा; वेग: 30, 20, 10।

terms.en: Medicated enema given through the anus (also urethra/vagina as uttara basti); the best treatment for vāta and called 'half of all treatment' (ardha-cikitsā) by Caraka. Main types: nirūha (decoction) and anuvāsana (oil).
terms.hi: बस्ति कर्म - गुदा मार्ग से औषध प्रवेश (एनिमा); वात की श्रेष्ठ चिकित्सा; अर्धचिकित्सा; निरूह और अनुवासन।
terms.modern: Medicated enema; rectal absorption allows local and systemic effects.

terms.en: Decoction-based cleansing enema (also āsthāpana, 'that which establishes life/age'), prepared by mixing in order honey, salt, sneha, kalka and kvātha.
terms.hi: निरूह (आस्थापन) बस्ति - क्वाथ प्रधान शोधन बस्ति; क्रम: मधु, सैन्धव, स्नेह, कल्क, क्वाथ।

terms.en: Oil-based enema that can remain in the body without harm ('anuvasan' = staying); given after food, it nourishes and pacifies vāta.
terms.hi: अनुवासन बस्ति - स्नेह प्रधान बस्ति, शरीर में रुक सके; भोजन के बाद।

terms.en: A small-dose anuvāsana basti (equal to the minimum dose of snehapāna) that can be given daily to children, the elderly and the weak without strict restrictions.
terms.hi: मात्रा बस्ति - अल्प मात्रा अनुवासन; बालक, वृद्ध, दुर्बल को प्रतिदिन; विशेष परहेज़ नहीं।

terms.en: Basti given through the urethra (in men and women) or vagina (in women), used for urinary and genital disorders.
terms.hi: उत्तर बस्ति - मूत्रमार्ग या योनिमार्ग से बस्ति; मूत्र-जनन विकारों में।

terms.en: Basti courses alternating anuvāsana and nirūha: karma basti 30 (18 anuvāsana + 12 nirūha), kāla basti 16 (10 + 6; Caraka's verse calls it half of karma basti) and yoga basti 8 (5 + 3).

Administration of medicine through the nose, the gateway to the head, for diseases above the clavicle (ūrdhvajatru). Vāgbhaṭa: virecana, bṛṃhaṇa and śamana by action; marśa and pratimarśa by dose; also avapīḍa and dhmāna/pradhamana.
terms.hi: नस्य - नासा (शिर का द्वार) से औषध; ऊर्ध्वजत्रु रोगों में; विरेचन, बृंहण, शमन; मर्श, प्रतिमर्श, अवपीड, प्रधमन।

terms.en: Purgation of the head: nasya with sharp drugs to expel kapha and doṣas from the head; Caraka's name for nasya among the pañcakarma.
terms.hi: शिरोविरेचन - तीक्ष्ण द्रव्यों से शिर के दोषों का निष्कासन।

terms.en: Low-dose oil nasya (about two drops) that can be used daily at any age and season without complications; contrasted with marśa (high dose).
terms.hi: प्रतिमर्श नस्य - अल्प मात्रा (लगभग दो बूँद) स्नेह नस्य; प्रतिदिन, किसी भी आयु में।

terms.en: Nasya with juice squeezed from a paste (kalka) of drugs into the nostrils; used for loss of consciousness, epilepsy and similar states.
terms.hi: अवपीड नस्य - कल्क निचोड़कर रस को नासा में डालना।

terms.en: Blowing fine powder into the nose through a tube (dhmāna); strongly cleansing.
terms.hi: प्रधमन नस्य - नली से चूर्ण को नासा में फूँकना।

terms.en: Therapeutic bloodletting for diseases of rakta and pitta: by instruments (śastra: pracchāna and sirāvyadha) or without (aśastra: jalaukā, śṛṅga, alābu, ghaṭī). Suśruta lists śṛṅga for vāta, jalaukā for pitta and alābu for kapha.
terms.hi: रक्तमोक्षण - दुष्ट रक्त निकालना; शस्त्र (प्रच्छान, सिरावेध) और अशस्त्र (जलौका, शृङ्ग, अलाबु)।

terms.en: Leech therapy; Suśruta describes 12 kinds of leeches (6 poisonous, 6 non-poisonous) and their use, especially for pitta-type blood disorders and in delicate patients.
terms.hi: जलौकावचारण - जोंक द्वारा रक्तमोक्षण; 12 प्रकार (6 सविष, 6 निर्विष)।
terms.modern: Leech therapy (hirudotherapy); leech saliva contains anticoagulants such as hirudin.

terms.en: Venesection: puncturing a vein to let out vitiated blood; Suśruta calls it 'half of surgical treatment' (ardha-cikitsā in śalya).
terms.hi: सिरावेध - सिरा का वेधन कर दुष्ट रक्त निकालना; शल्य में अर्धचिकित्सा।

terms.en: Bloodletting by multiple superficial scratches/incisions over a localised area.
terms.hi: प्रच्छान - छोटे-छोटे सतही चीरे लगाकर रक्तमोक्षण।

terms.en: Graded diet after śodhana to rekindle agni: peyā, vilepī, akṛta yūṣa, kṛta yūṣa, akṛta māṃsarasa and kṛta māṃsarasa, then normal food; duration depends on the grade of purification (pravara, madhyama, avara).
terms.hi: संसर्जन क्रम - शोधन के बाद क्रमिक आहार: पेया, विलेपी, अकृत-कृत यूष, अकृत-कृत मांसरस; शुद्धि अनुसार अवधि।
terms.modern: Comparable to graded refeeding after a procedure.

terms.en: Degree of purification after śodhana: pravara (best), madhyama (medium) and avara (minimum), judged by vegas, quantity of output, end-point (anta) and features (laiṅgikī).
terms.hi: शुद्धि - शोधन की मात्रा: प्रवर, मध्यम, अवर; वैगिकी, मानिकी, आन्तिकी, लैङ्गिकी।

terms.en: Proper response to a procedure; ayoga is insufficient response and atiyoga excessive response, each with specific signs and complications (vyāpat).
terms.hi: सम्यग्योग - उचित प्रभाव; अयोग (कम) और अतियोग (अधिक) के लक्षण।

terms.en: Inadequate (ayoga) and excessive (atiyoga) effect of a therapy. For example, atiyoga of virecana can cause bleeding, fainting and dehydration.
terms.hi: अयोग-अतियोग - चिकित्सा का कम या अधिक प्रभाव।

terms.en: Complication of a procedure or disease; Caraka describes the complications of vamana-virecana (CS.siddhi.6) and basti (CS.siddhi.7).
terms.hi: व्यापद् - कर्म के उपद्रव (वमन-विरेचन व्यापद्, बस्ति व्यापद्)।

terms.en: Continuous pouring of medicated oil, milk, buttermilk (takradhārā) or decoction in a stream on the forehead; a form of mūrdhni taila (pariṣeka) popularised in Kerala practice for insomnia, stress and headache.
terms.hi: शिरोधारा - माथे पर औषधीय तैल, दूध, तक्र या क्वाथ की निरन्तर धारा; अनिद्रा, तनाव में।
terms.modern: Studied as a relaxation therapy; evidence is limited.

terms.en: Oil applied to the head, four types in increasing efficacy: śiro-abhyaṅga, pariṣeka (pouring, e.g. śirodhārā), picu (oil-soaked cotton) and śirobasti (oil retained in a cap on the head).
terms.hi: मूर्धतैल - सिर पर तैल के चार प्रकार: शिरोभ्यंग, परिषेक (शिरोधारा), पिचु, शिरोबस्ति।

terms.en: Medicated oil retained on the scalp inside a leather or rexine cap fixed around the head; the strongest form of mūrdhni taila, used in vāta disorders of the head, insomnia and facial palsy.
terms.hi: शिरोबस्ति - सिर पर टोपी बाँधकर उसमें तैल रोकना; मूर्धतैल का सबसे प्रभावी रूप।

terms.en: Dry powder massage against the direction of hair; reduces kapha and medas, firms the body and improves skin.
terms.hi: उद्वर्तन - रोमों के विपरीत दिशा में चूर्ण मर्दन; कफ-मेद कम करता है।

terms.en: 'Conduct of the healthy': the branch dealing with preservation of health through daily and seasonal regimen, good conduct, diet, sleep, hygiene, yoga and community health.
terms.hi: स्वस्थवृत्त - स्वस्थ के आचरण का शास्त्र; दिनचर्या, ऋतुचर्या, सद्वृत्त, आहार, योग, सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य।
terms.modern: Comparable to preventive and social medicine with lifestyle medicine.

terms.en: Daily regimen: waking in brāhma muhūrta, attending to natural calls, dantadhāvana, añjana, nasya, gaṇḍūṣa, dhūmapāna, tāmbūla, abhyaṅga, vyāyāma, udvartana, snāna, suitable food and work, and sadvṛtta.
terms.hi: दिनचर्या - ब्राह्म मुहूर्त में उठना, दन्तधावन, अञ्जन, नस्य, गण्डूष, अभ्यंग, व्यायाम, उद्वर्तन, स्नान, उचित आहार।
terms.modern: Comparable to daily healthy routines (circadian hygiene).

terms.en: Night regimen: light, early dinner, proper sleep at the right time and rules for sexual conduct.
terms.hi: रात्रिचर्या - रात्रि के नियम: हल्का, समय पर भोजन, उचित निद्रा।

terms.en: The auspicious period before sunrise (roughly 1.5 hours before) when a healthy person should rise to protect life.
terms.hi: ब्राह्म मुहूर्त - सूर्योदय से लगभग डेढ़ घण्टा पहले का समय; स्वस्थ व्यक्ति को उठना चाहिए।

terms.en: Cleaning teeth with a twig (about 12 aṅgulas, as thick as the little finger) of astringent, pungent or bitter trees such as arka, nyagrodha, khadira, karañja and kakubha (arjuna).
terms.hi: दन्तधावन - अर्क, न्यग्रोध, खदिर, करञ्ज, ककुभ आदि की कषाय-कटु-तिक्त दातुन (12 अंगुल)।
terms.modern: Oral hygiene; some twigs have antimicrobial activity.

terms.en: Collyrium applied to the eyes; daily sauvīrāñjana is advised since the eye is fiery (tejomaya) and vulnerable to kapha; rasāñjana is used weekly. Also a therapeutic eye procedure (kriyākalpa).
terms.hi: अञ्जन - आँखों में काजल/अञ्जन; प्रतिदिन सौवीराञ्जन, सप्ताह में रसाञ्जन।

terms.en: Solid aqueous extract of dāruharidrā (concentrated with milk/water), used as eye collyrium and for wounds and skin disease.
terms.hi: रसाञ्जन - दारुहरिद्रा का घन सत्त्व; नेत्र अञ्जन, व्रण, त्वचा रोग में।

terms.en: Holding liquid (oil, decoction, milk) in the mouth without moving it until the eyes and nose water; four types: snigdha, śamana, śodhana and ropaṇa. Kavala is the mobile gargle with less liquid.
terms.hi: गण्डूष - मुख में द्रव भरकर बिना हिलाए रोकना; चार प्रकार; कवल में द्रव घुमाया जाता है।
terms.modern: Oil pulling/oral retention; evidence for oral health is modest.

terms.en: Gargling: a smaller quantity of liquid is moved around in the mouth and spat out.
terms.hi: कवल - थोड़ा द्रव मुख में घुमाकर थूकना।

terms.en: Inhalation of medicated smoke through a pipe (dhūmanetra) to prevent and treat kapha-vāta disorders above the clavicle; types include prāyogika/śamana, snaihika and vairecanika (tīkṣṇa). Smoke is inhaled by nose or mouth but always exhaled through the mouth.
terms.hi: धूमपान - नली से औषधीय धूम; प्रायोगिक, स्नैहिक, वैरेचनिक; धुआँ सदैव मुख से छोड़ें।

terms.en: Daily oil massage that counters ageing, fatigue and vāta, improves vision, nourishment, sleep, skin and lifespan; especially for head, ears and feet. Avoided in kapha conditions, after śodhana and in indigestion.
terms.hi: अभ्यंग - तैल मर्दन; जरा, श्रम, वात नाशक; दृष्टि, पुष्टि, निद्रा, त्वचा, आयु वर्धक; सिर, कान, पैर में विशेष।
terms.modern: Oil massage; studied for relaxation and skin health.

terms.en: Exercise: gives lightness, capacity for work, strong agni and reduction of medas. Should be done to half one's strength (ardhaśakti), mainly in cold seasons and spring; excess causes thirst, wasting, dyspnoea, bleeding and fever.
terms.hi: व्यायाम - लघुता, कार्यक्षमता, दीप्त अग्नि, मेद क्षय; अर्धशक्ति तक; अति से तृष्णा, क्षय, श्वास।
terms.modern: Physical exercise; 'half strength' parallels moderate-intensity guidance.

terms.en: Bathing: dīpana, vṛṣya, life-promoting, gives energy and strength and removes itching, dirt, fatigue, sweat and burning. Hot water on the head harms the eyes and hair.
terms.hi: स्नान - दीपन, वृष्य, आयुष्य, बल देने वाला; सिर पर गरम जल नेत्र-केश के लिए हानिकर।

terms.en: Seasonal regimen: diet and conduct adapted to each of the six seasons to prevent doṣa accumulation and aggravation.
terms.hi: ऋतुचर्या - छह ऋतुओं के अनुसार आहार-विहार।
terms.modern: Comparable to seasonal adaptation of lifestyle.

terms.en: Season. Six ṛtus of two months each starting from Māgha: śiśira, vasanta, grīṣma (ādāna) and varṣā, śarad, hemanta (visarga). Ṛtu also means the fertile period in women (ṛtukāla).
terms.hi: ऋतु - छह ऋतुएँ (दो-दो मास): शिशिर, वसन्त, ग्रीष्म (आदान); वर्षा, शरद्, हेमन्त (विसर्ग)।

terms.en: One of the six seasons (ṛtu); each spans two lunar months (AH.sutra.3.1). Māgha-Phālguna (about mid-January to mid-March); cold and dry, the first season of ādāna; regimen as in hemanta with more care against cold and dryness; kapha accumulates.
terms.hi: छह ऋतुओं में एक (दो मास)। शिशिर - माघ-फाल्गुन; शीत-रूक्ष; हेमन्त जैसी चर्या; कफ संचय।

terms.en: One of the six seasons (ṛtu); each spans two lunar months (AH.sutra.3.1). Caitra-Vaiśākha; accumulated kapha liquefies by the sun and aggravates, so vamana, exercise, udvartana, dry and light food (old barley, wheat, honey) are advised; avoid heavy, sweet, oily food and day sleep.
terms.hi: छह ऋतुओं में एक (दो मास)। वसन्त - चैत्र-वैशाख; कफ प्रकोप; वमन, व्यायाम, उद्वर्तन, लघु-रूक्ष आहार; दिवास्वप्न निषेध।

terms.en: One of the six seasons (ṛtu); each spans two lunar months (AH.sutra.3.1). Jyeṣṭha-Āṣāḍha; strength is least; sweet, cold, liquid and unctuous food, cool water and rest are advised; avoid salty, sour, pungent food and exercise; vāta accumulates.
terms.hi: छह ऋतुओं में एक (दो मास)। ग्रीष्म - ज्येष्ठ-आषाढ; बल न्यूनतम; मधुर, शीत, द्रव, स्निग्ध आहार; वात संचय।

terms.en: One of the six seasons (ṛtu); each spans two lunar months (AH.sutra.3.1). Śrāvaṇa-Bhādrapada; agni is weak and all doṣas are disturbed, vāta aggravated; boiled water, old grains, honey and basti are advised; avoid river water, day sleep and exertion.
terms.hi: छह ऋतुओं में एक (दो मास)। वर्षा - श्रावण-भाद्रपद; अग्नि मन्द, वात प्रकोप; उबला जल, पुराने अन्न, बस्ति।

terms.en: One of the six seasons (ṛtu); each spans two lunar months (AH.sutra.3.1). Āśvina-Kārttika; accumulated pitta is aggravated by sudden sun; virecana, raktamokṣaṇa, bitter ghee, sweet-bitter-astringent light food and haṃsodaka water are advised.
terms.hi: छह ऋतुओं में एक (दो मास)। शरद् - आश्विन-कार्तिक; पित्त प्रकोप; विरेचन, रक्तमोक्षण, तिक्त घृत, हंसोदक।

terms.en: One of the six seasons (ṛtu); each spans two lunar months (AH.sutra.3.1). Mārgaśīrṣa-Pauṣa; agni is strongest and strength greatest, so heavy, unctuous, sweet-sour-salty food, oil massage, exercise and warm clothing are advised.
terms.hi: छह ऋतुओं में एक (दो मास)। हेमन्त - मार्गशीर्ष-पौष; अग्नि व बल सर्वाधिक; गुरु, स्निग्ध, मधुर-अम्ल-लवण आहार, अभ्यंग।

terms.en: Northern solstice period (uttarāyaṇa: śiśira, vasanta, grīṣma) when the sun and wind 'take away' strength; āgneya in nature, tikta, kaṣāya and kaṭu rasas become strong, and strength progressively declines.
terms.hi: आदान काल - उत्तरायण (शिशिर, वसन्त, ग्रीष्म); सूर्य-वायु बल हरते हैं; आग्नेय; तिक्त, कषाय, कटु रस बलवान।

terms.en: Southern solstice period (dakṣiṇāyana: varṣā, śarad, hemanta) when the moon releases strength; saumya in nature, amla, lavaṇa and madhura rasas become strong, and strength progressively increases.
terms.hi: विसर्ग काल - दक्षिणायन (वर्षा, शरद्, हेमन्त); चन्द्रमा बल देता है; सौम्य; अम्ल, लवण, मधुर रस बलवान।

terms.en: The junction of two seasons (last week of one and first week of the next), when the regimen of the previous season should be given up and the next adopted gradually.
terms.hi: ऋतुसन्धि - दो ऋतुओं का संधिकाल (पिछली का अन्तिम व अगली का प्रथम सप्ताह); चर्या धीरे-धीरे बदलें।

terms.en: Code of right conduct (personal, social, ethical, hygienic) for health of body and mind and control of the senses: truthfulness, kindness, cleanliness, moderation and respect.
terms.hi: सद्वृत्त - शरीर-मन के स्वास्थ्य हेतु सदाचरण: सत्य, दया, शौच, संयम, आदर।
terms.modern: Comparable to behavioural, ethical and mental hygiene guidance.

terms.en: Natural urges. AH.sutra.4.1 lists 13 that must not be suppressed: flatus, faeces, urine, sneezing, thirst, hunger, sleep, cough, breathlessness on exertion, yawning, tears, vomiting and semen.
terms.hi: वेग - प्राकृतिक आवेग; 13 अधारणीय: अधोवायु, मल, मूत्र, छींक, प्यास, भूख, निद्रा, कास, श्रमश्वास, जम्हाई, आँसू, वमन, शुक्र।
terms.modern: Physiological urges; suppression is linked to many disorders.

terms.en: Urges that should not be suppressed (13 natural urges); their suppression aggravates vāta and causes specific diseases (e.g. suppressing urine causes pain in bladder and penis, dysuria, headache).
terms.hi: अधारणीय वेग - न रोके जाने वाले 13 वेग; रोकने से वात प्रकोप और रोग।

terms.en: Urges that should be controlled: impulses of greed, grief, fear, anger, ego, shamelessness, jealousy, excessive attachment and malice, and harmful acts of speech and body.
terms.hi: धारणीय वेग - रोकने योग्य: लोभ, शोक, भय, क्रोध, अहंकार, ईर्ष्या, अतिराग आदि।

terms.en: The three sub-pillars of life: āhāra (food), nidrā (sleep) and brahmacarya (regulated sexual conduct/celibacy). Properly used, they give strength, complexion and growth.
terms.hi: त्रयोपस्तम्भ - जीवन के तीन उपस्तम्भ: आहार, निद्रा, ब्रह्मचर्य।
terms.modern: Comparable to the diet-sleep-lifestyle triad of health.

terms.en: Food and diet, the first upastambha; that which is taken in. Four forms: aśita (eaten), pīta (drunk), līḍha (licked) and khādita (chewed). Proper food is the cause of growth, strength, health and life.
terms.hi: आहार - भोजन; चार प्रकार: अशित, पीत, लीढ, खादित; बल, आरोग्य, आयु का कारण।

terms.en: Regulated, disciplined sexual conduct (or celibacy where appropriate), the third upastambha; preserves śukra and ojas.
terms.hi: ब्रह्मचर्य - संयमित यौन आचरण (या ब्रह्मचर्य); शुक्र व ओज की रक्षा।

terms.en: Caraka's eight determinants of the effect of food: prakṛti (nature of food), karaṇa (processing), saṃyoga (combination), rāśi (quantity), deśa (place), kāla (time/state), upayoga-saṃsthā (rules of eating) and upayoktā (the eater).
terms.hi: आहारविधि विशेषायतन - आठ: प्रकृति, करण, संयोग, राशि, देश, काल, उपयोगसंस्था, उपयोक्ता।
terms.modern: Comparable to food science factors: composition, processing, combinations, portion, environment, timing, eating behaviour and the individual.

terms.en: Eating in proper quantity: the amount that is digested in due time without disturbing health, depending on agni. Caraka advises filling the stomach one-third with solid food, one-third with liquids and leaving one-third for doṣas.
terms.hi: मात्राशित - उचित मात्रा में भोजन; अग्नि अनुसार; पेट का 1/3 ठोस, 1/3 द्रव, 1/3 खाली।

terms.en: Incompatible food: combinations or practices that provoke doṣas but do not expel them, e.g. milk with fish, equal quantities of honey and ghee, heated honey, milk with sour fruits. Caraka lists 18 kinds of incompatibility (deśa, kāla, agni, mātrā, sātmya, saṃyoga, saṃskāra, etc.).
terms.hi: विरुद्ध आहार - असंगत भोजन: दूध-मछली, समान मात्रा मधु-घृत, गरम मधु आदि; 18 प्रकार।
terms.modern: Comparable to food incompatibility/food-drug interactions; many classical claims are untested.

terms.en: Destruction of communities by epidemics, caused by vitiation of air, water, land and season (vāyu, udaka, deśa, kāla), rooted in adharma and prajñāparādha. Treated with pañcakarma, rasāyana, truthfulness and compassion.
terms.hi: जनपदोद्ध्वंस - महामारी; वायु, जल, देश, काल की विकृति से; अधर्म व प्रज्ञापराध मूल।
terms.modern: Epidemics; the four factors resemble environmental determinants of disease.

terms.en: Place, of two kinds: bhūmi deśa (land: jāṅgala dry/vāta-predominant, ānūpa marshy/kapha-predominant and sādhāraṇa balanced) and deha deśa (the body, the site of disease).
terms.hi: देश - भूमि देश (जाङ्गल, आनूप, साधारण) और देह देश (शरीर)।
terms.modern: Comparable to geographical/environmental factors in health.

terms.en: Dry, open land with little water and sparse vegetation; vāta-predominant, and people there are generally strong; preferred for collecting drugs.
terms.hi: जाङ्गल देश - शुष्क, कम जल-वनस्पति वाला; वात प्रधान।

terms.en: Marshy, water-rich land with dense vegetation; kapha-predominant, prone to kapha-vāta diseases.
terms.hi: आनूप देश - जल-बहुल, दलदली; कफ प्रधान।

terms.en: Patañjali's eightfold yoga: yama, niyama, āsana, prāṇāyāma, pratyāhāra, dhāraṇā, dhyāna and samādhi. Part of the svasthavṛtta syllabus.
terms.hi: अष्टाङ्ग योग - यम, नियम, आसन, प्राणायाम, प्रत्याहार, धारणा, ध्यान, समाधि।
terms.modern: Yoga practices are studied for stress, fitness and chronic disease.

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Five ethical restraints: ahiṃsā (non-violence), satya (truth), asteya (non-stealing), brahmacarya and aparigraha (non-possessiveness).
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। यम - अहिंसा, सत्य, अस्तेय, ब्रह्मचर्य, अपरिग्रह।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Five observances: śauca (cleanliness), santoṣa (contentment), tapas (austerity), svādhyāya (self-study) and īśvara-praṇidhāna (devotion).
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। नियम - शौच, सन्तोष, तप, स्वाध्याय, ईश्वरप्रणिधान।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. A steady and comfortable posture (sthira-sukham āsanam).
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। आसन - स्थिर और सुखद शारीरिक स्थिति।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Regulation of breath through pūraka (inhalation), kumbhaka (retention) and recaka (exhalation).
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। प्राणायाम - श्वास का नियमन: पूरक, कुम्भक, रेचक।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Withdrawal of the senses from their objects.
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। प्रत्याहार - इन्द्रियों को विषयों से हटाना।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Fixing the mind on one point or object (concentration).
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। धारणा - मन को एक स्थान पर स्थिर करना।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Meditation: an unbroken flow of attention towards the object of concentration.
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। ध्यान - ध्येय में चित्त का अविच्छिन्न प्रवाह।

terms.en: One of the eight limbs of Patañjali's aṣṭāṅga yoga. Complete absorption in which only the object shines forth; Caraka also lists samādhi among the means of sattvāvajaya.
terms.hi: पतञ्जलि के अष्टाङ्ग योग का एक अंग। समाधि - ध्येय में पूर्ण तल्लीनता।

terms.en: Buttermilk (curd churned with one-quarter water and fat removed); dīpana, grāhī, light; highly praised for grahaṇī and arśas.
terms.hi: तक्र (छाछ) - दही में 1/4 जल मिलाकर मथा, मक्खन रहित; दीपन, ग्राही; ग्रहणी, अर्श में श्रेष्ठ।

terms.en: Honey; kaṣāya-madhura, rūkṣa, lekhana, yogavāhī, good for kapha. It must not be heated or given to people in hot conditions, and equal quantities of honey and ghee are incompatible.
terms.hi: मधु (शहद) - कषाय-मधुर, रूक्ष, लेखन, योगवाही, कफहर; गरम न करें; समान मात्रा घृत के साथ विरुद्ध।

terms.en: Milk, especially cow's milk: madhura, snigdha, śīta; jīvanīya, rasāyana, ojas-increasing; Caraka calls it the best jīvanīya.
terms.hi: क्षीर (दूध) - गोदुग्ध मधुर, स्निग्ध, शीत; जीवनीय, रसायन, ओजवर्धक।

terms.en: Fine rice harvested in winter; madhura, śīta, light; raktaśāli is the best. Ṣaṣṭika is a rice that ripens in sixty days, used in piṇḍa sveda and diet.
terms.hi: शालि - शीतकालीन चावल; मधुर, शीत, लघु; रक्तशालि श्रेष्ठ; षष्टिक 60 दिन में पकने वाला।

terms.en: Barley; kaṣāya-madhura, rūkṣa, lekhana; good in prameha, obesity and kapha disorders.
terms.hi: यव (जौ) - रूक्ष, लेखन; प्रमेह, स्थौल्य, कफ में हितकर।

terms.en: The best of pulses: kaṣāya-madhura, light, dry, does not aggravate doṣas much; used in yūṣa for convalescents.
terms.hi: मुद्ग (मूँग) - दालों में श्रेष्ठ; लघु; यूष हेतु।

terms.en: Rock salt from Sindh, the best of salts: slightly sweet, not very hot, good for eyes, tridoṣa-balancing; Caraka recommends it for daily use.
terms.hi: सैन्धव लवण - सेंधा नमक; नमकों में श्रेष्ठ; नेत्र्य, त्रिदोषशामक; नित्य सेवनीय।

terms.en: Thin rice gruel with more liquid and few grains; light, dīpana, first item of saṃsarjana krama.
terms.hi: पेया - अधिक द्रव और कम दाने वाली पतली यवागू; लघु, दीपन; संसर्जन का प्रथम आहार।

terms.en: Thick rice gruel with little liquid; nourishing, given after peyā in saṃsarjana krama.
terms.hi: विलेपी - गाढ़ी यवागू; पेया के बाद।

terms.en: Gruel made of grains (rice, barley) cooked with water, often with medicinal herbs; Caraka describes 28 medicated yavāgūs.
terms.hi: यवागू - अन्न को जल में पकाकर बनाई लपसी; चरक ने 28 औषधीय यवागू बताईं।

terms.en: Soup of pulses (especially mudga); kṛta (seasoned with salt, sour and spices) or akṛta (unseasoned).
terms.hi: यूष - दाल का सूप (मुख्यतः मूँग); कृत और अकृत।

terms.en: Five products of the cow: milk, curd, ghee, urine and dung; used in medicine (e.g. pañcagavya ghṛta in apasmāra) and purification.
terms.hi: पञ्चगव्य - गाय के पाँच उत्पाद: दूध, दही, घी, मूत्र, गोबर।

terms.en: Surgery: the branch dealing with removal of foreign bodies (śalya) and with diseases treated by instruments, kṣāra, agni and bandaging; Suśruta Saṃhitā is its main text.
terms.hi: शल्य तन्त्र - शल्य (बाह्य पदार्थ) निकालने और शस्त्र, क्षार, अग्नि से साध्य रोगों का तन्त्र; मुख्य ग्रन्थ सुश्रुत संहिता।

terms.en: Anything that causes pain to body or mind (literally 'dart'); foreign bodies such as arrowheads, splinters and stones. Their five directions of movement and methods of extraction are described.
terms.hi: शल्य - शरीर या मन को पीड़ा देने वाला (तीर की नोक, कांटा आदि बाह्य पदार्थ)।

terms.en: Blunt surgical instruments used to extract foreign bodies and examine: Suśruta lists 101, with the hand as the chief yantra; types include svastika, sandaṃśa, tāla, nāḍī, śalākā and upayantra.
terms.hi: यन्त्र - कुण्ठ (भोथरे) शल्य उपकरण; सुश्रुत: 101; हाथ प्रधान यन्त्र।

terms.en: Sharp surgical instruments; Suśruta lists 20 (e.g. maṇḍalāgra, vṛddhipatra, kuśapatra), Vāgbhaṭa 26.
terms.hi: शस्त्र - तीक्ष्ण शल्य उपकरण; सुश्रुत: 20, वाग्भट: 26।

terms.en: Accessory or substitute sharp means used where instruments are unsuitable: kṣāra, agni, jalaukā, nails, bamboo bark, glass, etc.
terms.hi: अनुशस्त्र - शस्त्र के स्थान पर उपयोगी साधन: क्षार, अग्नि, जलौका, नख, काँच आदि।

terms.en: Suśruta's eight surgical procedures: chedana (excision), bhedana (incision), lekhana (scraping), vedhana/vyadhana (puncture), eṣaṇa (probing), āharaṇa (extraction), visrāvaṇa (draining) and sīvana (suturing).
terms.hi: अष्टविध शस्त्रकर्म - छेदन, भेदन, लेखन, वेधन, एषण, आहरण, विस्रावण, सीवन।
terms.modern: Excision, incision, scraping, puncture, probing, extraction, drainage and suturing.

terms.en: Surgical incision, e.g. to drain an abscess; one of the eight śastrakarmas. Not to be confused with bhedana as a purgative drug action.
terms.hi: भेदन - शल्य चीरा (जैसे विद्रधि का); अष्टविध शस्त्रकर्म में एक। (भेदन औषध-कर्म से भिन्न)

terms.en: Three phases of surgery: pūrvakarma (pre-operative preparation), pradhānakarma (operation) and paścātkarma (post-operative care).
terms.hi: त्रिविध कर्म (शल्य) - पूर्वकर्म, प्रधानकर्म, पश्चात्कर्म।

terms.en: Practical training on models before operating on patients, e.g. incision on fruits like gourds, scraping on hide with hair, puncturing vessels of dead animals, suturing on cloth, bandaging on dummies.
terms.hi: योग्या - शल्यकर्म का अभ्यास (फल, चर्म, मृत पशु की सिरा, वस्त्र आदि पर)।

terms.en: Application of caustic alkali to excise or cauterise tissue (e.g. arśas, warts, fistula); considered superior to sharp instruments because it does several actions (excision, incision, scraping) and treats deep tissue.
terms.hi: क्षारकर्म - क्षार द्वारा छेदन/दहन (अर्श, भगन्दर आदि)।

terms.en: Medicated thread coated repeatedly with snuhī latex, apāmārga kṣāra and haridrā, used to cut and heal fistula-in-ano (bhagandara) and nāḍī vraṇa gradually; mentioned by Suśruta and detailed by Cakradatta.
terms.hi: क्षारसूत्र - स्नुही क्षीर, अपामार्ग क्षार, हरिद्रा से लेपित धागा; भगन्दर में।
terms.modern: Medicated seton; clinical trials support its use in fistula-in-ano.

terms.en: Therapeutic cauterisation with heated instruments (śalākā) or substances; diseases treated by it do not recur. Patterns include valaya, bindu, vilekhā and pratisāraṇa.
terms.hi: अग्निकर्म - तप्त शलाका आदि से दहन; इससे साध्य रोग पुनः नहीं होते।

terms.en: Wound or ulcer, literally 'that which covers/scars'. Two types: nija (from doṣas) and āgantu (traumatic); also śuddha (clean) and duṣṭa (unhealthy). Suśruta describes 60 measures (ṣaṣṭi upakrama) to treat it.
terms.hi: व्रण - घाव/अल्सर; निज और आगन्तु; शुद्ध और दुष्ट; 60 उपक्रम।

terms.en: Unhealthy (chronic, infected) wound: foul smell, abnormal colour, excessive discharge, pain and delayed healing; needs śodhana before ropaṇa.
terms.hi: दुष्ट व्रण - दुर्गन्ध, विवर्ण, अधिक स्राव, वेदना, देर से भरने वाला घाव।

terms.en: Clean wound: tongue-coloured (pinkish), soft, smooth, painless, without discharge, with slightly raised edges; ready to heal (ropaṇa).
terms.hi: शुद्ध व्रण - जिह्वा जैसा वर्ण, मृदु, वेदना-स्राव रहित; रोपण योग्य।

terms.en: Fresh traumatic wound; six types: chinna (cut), bhinna (penetrating), viddha (punctured), kṣata (lacerated), piccita (crushed) and ghṛṣṭa (abraded).
terms.hi: सद्योव्रण - ताज़ा आघातज घाव; छह: छिन्न, भिन्न, विद्ध, क्षत, पिच्चित, घृष्ट।
terms.modern: Acute traumatic wounds (incised, penetrating, punctured, lacerated, crushed, abraded).

terms.en: Suśruta's sixty measures for wound management, from apatarpaṇa, lepa and pariṣeka through śodhana, ropaṇa, cutting, suturing and bandaging to rakṣā-vidhāna (protection).
terms.hi: षष्टि उपक्रम - व्रण चिकित्सा के 60 उपाय (अपतर्पण से रक्षाविधान तक)।

terms.en: Inflammatory swelling that precedes suppuration, in three stages: āma (unripe), pacyamāna (ripening) and pakva (ripe); proper stage identification decides incision.
terms.hi: व्रणशोथ - पाक से पहले का शोथ; तीन अवस्थाएँ: आम, पच्यमान, पक्व।
terms.modern: Comparable to stages of inflammation leading to abscess formation.

terms.en: Fracture or dislocation; two types: kāṇḍa-bhagna (fracture of bone shaft, 12 types) and sandhi-mukta (dislocation, 6 types). Treated by reduction, immobilisation (kuśa splints) and medication.
terms.hi: भग्न - अस्थि-भंग; काण्डभग्न (12) और सन्धिमुक्त (6)।

terms.en: A track opening near the anus that 'tears' the perineal region (bhaga, guda, basti); five types by doṣa and āgantu (Suśruta).
terms.hi: भगन्दर - गुदा के पास नाडी जो भग-गुद-बस्ति प्रदेश को विदीर्ण करे; पाँच प्रकार।

terms.en: Stone (urinary calculus); four types: ślaiṣmika, paittika, vātika and śukrāśmarī. Suśruta describes perineal lithotomy for stones that do not respond to drugs.
terms.hi: अश्मरी - पथरी; चार प्रकार: श्लैष्मिक, पैत्तिक, वातिक, शुक्राश्मरी; सुश्रुत ने शस्त्रकर्म बताया।

terms.en: A large, round, fixed, slowly growing, deep-rooted swelling that rarely suppurates; types by doṣa, rakta, māṃsa and medas.
terms.hi: अर्बुद - बड़ा, गोल, स्थिर, धीरे बढ़ने वाला, गहरा शोथ, जो प्रायः नहीं पकता।
terms.modern: Often compared to neoplasms (benign and malignant tumours).

terms.en: A round, knotty swelling (literally 'knot') formed by doṣas vitiating māṃsa, rakta, medas and sirā; types include vātaja, pittaja, kaphaja, medoja and sirāja.
terms.hi: ग्रन्थि - गाँठ जैसी गोल सूजन; वातज, पित्तज, कफज, मेदोज, सिराज।
terms.modern: Cysts, nodules and swellings (e.g. lipoma, sebaceous cyst, ganglion).

terms.en: Swelling in the front of the neck that hangs like a scrotum, slowly growing.
terms.hi: गलगण्ड - गले के सामने लटकने वाली सूजन।

terms.en: A garland-like chain of swellings in the neck, axilla or groin.
terms.hi: गण्डमाला - गले, कक्षा, वंक्षण में माला जैसी गाँठें।
terms.modern: Often compared to cervical lymphadenitis (e.g. tuberculous, scrofula).

terms.en: Bandaging; Suśruta describes 14 types of bandages (e.g. kośa, svastika, anuvellita, cīna) applied tight, medium or loose according to site and doṣa.
terms.hi: बन्ध - पट्टी बाँधना; सुश्रुत: 14 प्रकार।

terms.en: Reconstructive surgery: Suśruta's karṇa-sandhāna (ear-lobe repair) and nāsā-sandhāna (rhinoplasty with a pedicled cheek flap), regarded as early plastic surgery.
terms.hi: सन्धान कर्म - कर्ण-सन्धान और नासा-सन्धान (गाल की त्वचा से नाक बनाना)।
terms.modern: Plastic/reconstructive surgery (Suśruta's rhinoplasty is widely cited historically).

terms.en: Branch dealing with diseases above the clavicle (ūrdhvajatru): eye, ear, nose, mouth, throat and head; named after the śalākā (probe) used. Also called ūrdhvāṅga.
terms.hi: शालाक्य तन्त्र - जत्रु के ऊपर के रोग (नेत्र, कर्ण, नासा, मुख, शिर); शलाका के प्रयोग से नाम।
terms.modern: Ophthalmology and ENT (with head and oral diseases).

terms.en: The eye; made of all five mahābhūtas with tejas predominant. Suśruta describes five maṇḍalas (pakṣma, vartma, śveta, kṛṣṇa, dṛṣṭi), six sandhis and six paṭalas (two in the eyelid and four in the eyeball).
terms.hi: नेत्र - आँख; तेज प्रधान; पाँच मण्डल, छह सन्धि, छह पटल।

terms.en: Layers of the eye: Suśruta describes four paṭalas in the eyeball (besides two of the eyelid); progressive involvement of these layers produces timira, kāca and liṅganāśa.
terms.hi: पटल - नेत्र के स्तर; चार पटलों की क्रमिक विकृति से तिमिर, काच, लिङ्गनाश।
terms.modern: Correlation of each paṭala with ocular tissues is debated.

terms.en: Progressive blurring of vision when doṣas affect the inner layers (paṭalas); neglected, timira becomes kāca and kāca becomes blindness (liṅganāśa).
terms.hi: तिमिर - दृष्टि का क्रमिक धुंधलापन; उपेक्षा से काच, फिर लिङ्गनाश।
terms.modern: Often compared to refractive errors and early cataract.

terms.en: Advanced loss of vision when the fourth paṭala is affected; the kaphaja variety is treated surgically by couching with a barley-tipped needle (yavavaktra śalākā).
terms.hi: लिङ्गनाश - चौथे पटल की विकृति से दृष्टिनाश; कफज लिङ्गनाश का शलाका से वेधन।
terms.modern: Kaphaja liṅganāśa is often compared to mature cataract (Suśruta's couching).

terms.en: Eye disease with discharge, redness and congestion (syanda = flowing); considered the root of almost all eye diseases; neglected, it may progress to adhimantha.
terms.hi: अभिष्यन्द - स्राव, लालिमा वाला नेत्र रोग; प्रायः सभी नेत्र रोगों का मूल।

terms.en: Severe eye disease with churning pain in the eye spreading to half the head; can destroy vision quickly.
terms.hi: अधिमन्थ - नेत्र में मथने जैसी पीड़ा जो आधे सिर तक फैले; शीघ्र दृष्टिनाश।

terms.en: Local ocular therapeutic procedures: seka (pouring), āścyotana (eye drops), piṇḍī, viḍālaka (eyelid paste), tarpaṇa, puṭapāka and añjana.
terms.hi: क्रियाकल्प - नेत्र की स्थानीय चिकित्साएँ: सेक, आश्च्योतन, पिण्डी, विडालक, तर्पण, पुटपाक, अञ्जन।

terms.en: Retaining medicated ghee over the open eyes within a dough ring for a set time; nourishes the eyes in dryness, fatigue and vāta disorders.
terms.hi: नेत्र तर्पण - आँखों पर आटे की मेड़ बनाकर औषधसिद्ध घृत रोकना।

terms.en: Juice extracted from drugs cooked in a sealed leaf-and-clay bolus, poured into the eyes after tarpaṇa; types: snehana, lekhana and prasādana.
terms.hi: पुटपाक - पुट में पकाए द्रव्यों का रस नेत्र में; स्नेहन, लेखन, प्रसादन।

terms.en: Instilling drops of medicated liquid into the eye from a height of two aṅgulas; advised as the first treatment in all eye diseases.
terms.hi: आश्च्योतन - दो अंगुल ऊँचाई से नेत्र में औषध की बूँदें; नेत्र रोगों में प्रथम चिकित्सा।

terms.en: Filling the ears with warm medicated oil, as part of dinacaryā and for ear diseases (vāta, deafness, tinnitus).
terms.hi: कर्णपूरण - कान में गुनगुना औषधीय तैल भरना।
terms.modern: Ear instillation (contraindicated in perforated eardrum or discharge).

terms.en: Ear pain, chiefly due to vāta; also karṇanāda (tinnitus) and bādhirya (deafness) are related ear diseases.
terms.hi: कर्णशूल - कान का दर्द; कर्णनाद, बाधिर्य सम्बन्धित रोग।

terms.en: Running nose with sneezing, heaviness of the head and discharge; neglected, it can lead to many diseases including rājayakṣmā.
terms.hi: प्रतिश्याय - नाक बहना, छींक, सिर में भारीपन।
terms.modern: Often compared to coryza/common cold and rhinitis.

terms.en: Chronic nasal disease with blockage, alternately dry and moist nose, loss of smell and taste.
terms.hi: पीनस - नासा अवरोध, गन्ध-रस ज्ञान नाश वाला दीर्घकालीन नासा रोग।
terms.modern: Often compared to chronic rhinitis and sinusitis.

terms.en: Severe, periodic pain in half of the head (neck, eyebrow, temple, ear, eye), like cutting or piercing.
terms.hi: अर्धावभेदक - आधे सिर में आवर्ती तीव्र वेदना।

terms.en: Diseases of the mouth in seven sites: lips, gums, teeth, tongue, palate, throat and whole oral cavity; Suśruta describes 65.
terms.hi: मुखरोग - सात स्थानों (ओष्ठ, दन्तमूल, दन्त, जिह्वा, तालु, कण्ठ, सर्वसर) के रोग; सुश्रुत: 65।

terms.en: Obstetrics (with strī roga, gynaecology): conception, pregnancy care, labour, puerperium and diseases of women. Not one of the eight classical branches by name; it is drawn from Śārīra and Cikitsā sections and Kāśyapa Saṃhitā.
terms.hi: प्रसूति तन्त्र (स्त्री रोग सहित) - गर्भधारण, गर्भिणी परिचर्या, प्रसव, सूतिका और स्त्री रोग।

terms.en: Embryo/foetus: formed by the union of śukra, ārtava and the jīva (ātmā with sattva) in the uterus, together with the five mahābhūtas.
terms.hi: गर्भ - गर्भाशय में शुक्र, आर्तव और जीव (आत्मा-सत्त्व) का संयोग; पञ्चमहाभूत युक्त।

terms.en: Suśruta's four essentials for conception: ṛtu (fertile period), kṣetra (healthy uterus/reproductive tract), ambu (nutrient fluid) and bīja (healthy śukra and ārtava), likened to growing a seed.
terms.hi: गर्भसम्भव सामग्री - ऋतु, क्षेत्र, अम्बु, बीज (बीज बोने की तरह)।
terms.modern: Comparable to fertile window, healthy reproductive tract, nutrition and healthy gametes.

terms.en: Six factors that form the foetus and determine its features: mātṛja (from mother), pitṛja (from father), ātmaja (from self), sātmyaja (from habituation), rasaja (from nutrition) and sattvaja (from mind).
terms.hi: षड्भाव - गर्भ के छह घटक: मातृज, पितृज, आत्मज, सात्म्यज, रसज, सत्त्वज।
terms.modern: Partly comparable to maternal and paternal inheritance plus environmental and nutritional factors.

terms.en: Uterus, the eighth āśaya in women, shaped like the mouth of a rohita fish, located between pittāśaya and pakvāśaya (third āvarta of the yoni).
terms.hi: गर्भाशय - स्त्रियों का आठवाँ आशय; रोहित मछली के मुख जैसा।

terms.en: The fertile period of the menstrual cycle, about 12 nights from the onset of menstruation (excluding the first days of bleeding); the uterus is receptive then.
terms.hi: ऋतुकाल - मासिक धर्म के आरम्भ से लगभग 12 रात्रि का गर्भधारण योग्य काल।
terms.modern: Comparable to the proliferative/fertile phase of the menstrual cycle.

terms.en: Regimen during menstruation (first three days): rest, celibacy, light diet, avoiding exertion, day sleep, bathing, oil massage and cosmetics.
terms.hi: रजस्वला चर्या - मासिक धर्म के तीन दिन के नियम: विश्राम, ब्रह्मचर्य, लघु आहार।
terms.modern: Menstrual hygiene and rest guidance (some classical restrictions are culture-specific).

terms.en: Antenatal care: diet, conduct and month-wise regimen (māsānumāsika) for the pregnant woman, avoiding garbhopaghātakara bhāvas (factors harmful to the foetus).
terms.hi: गर्भिणी परिचर्या - गर्भवती का आहार-विहार; मासानुमासिक चर्या; गर्भोपघातकर भावों का त्याग।

terms.en: Month-by-month diet in pregnancy: e.g. milk in the first months, milk with honey and ghee, rice with milk, butter, ghee medicated with madhura drugs in the middle months, and anuvāsana basti and tampons of oil in the eighth and ninth months to prepare for labour.
terms.hi: मासानुमासिक परिचर्या - प्रत्येक मास का गर्भिणी आहार (दूध, मधु-घृत, क्षीरपाक; आठवें-नवें मास में अनुवासन बस्ति, पिचु)।
terms.modern: Comparable to trimester-wise nutrition and birth preparation.

terms.en: Factors harmful to the foetus: e.g. heavy exertion, travel on rough vehicles, fasting, alcohol, meat in excess, emotional shock, sleeping supine, sitting on hard surfaces, strong purgatives.
terms.hi: गर्भोपघातकर भाव - गर्भ को हानि करने वाले भाव: अति श्रम, मद्य, उपवास, शोक, उत्तान शयन आदि।
terms.modern: Comparable to teratogenic and pregnancy-risk factors.

terms.en: The 'two-hearted' state of pregnancy (from the fourth month, when the foetal heart develops); the mother's cravings should be fulfilled within reason, as their denial may harm the foetus.
terms.hi: दौहृद - 'दो हृदय वाली' अवस्था (चौथे मास से); गर्भिणी की इच्छाओं की उचित पूर्ति।

terms.en: Rite and medications given in early pregnancy (before the sex is manifest) traditionally aimed at a male child and healthy progeny. Sex-selection practices are illegal in India (PCPNDT Act); today it is taught as a historical/supportive rite.
terms.hi: पुंसवन - प्रारम्भिक गर्भ में संस्कार/औषध; लिंग चयन भारत में अवैध है।
terms.modern: No scientific basis for sex determination; legal restrictions apply.

terms.en: Labour/delivery; Suśruta and Caraka describe signs of imminent labour (āsanna prasava), the delivery room (sūtikāgāra) and management of normal and abnormal labour.
terms.hi: प्रसव - बच्चे का जन्म; आसन्नप्रसव लक्षण, सूतिकागार, सामान्य-असामान्य प्रसव।

terms.en: Placenta (after-birth), through which the foetus is nourished via the umbilical cord (nābhi-nāḍī); retained aparā is a serious complication.
terms.hi: अपरा - नाल/जरायु; नाभिनाडी द्वारा गर्भ का पोषण।

terms.en: Obstructed labour due to abnormal presentation or position of the foetus; Suśruta describes four main types (kīla, pratikhura, bījaka, parigha) and eight abnormal positions, with manipulation or surgical management.
terms.hi: मूढगर्भ - असामान्य स्थिति के कारण अवरुद्ध प्रसव; सुश्रुत: चार मुख्य प्रकार (कील, प्रतिखुर, बीजक, परिघ)।

terms.en: A woman after delivery (puerperium), until about one and a half months or till the return of menstruation; she needs a special regimen (sūtikā paricaryā) of rest, massage, warm water and digestive diet.
terms.hi: सूतिका - प्रसव के बाद की स्त्री (लगभग डेढ़ मास); विश्राम, अभ्यंग, उष्ण जल, दीपन आहार।

terms.en: Disorders of the female reproductive tract; Caraka and Suśruta describe 20, by doṣa and other causes (e.g. udāvartā, vandhyā, upaplutā, viplutā).
terms.hi: योनिव्यापद् - स्त्री जननाङ्ग के 20 रोग।

terms.en: Excessive or prolonged menstrual or intermenstrual bleeding (also pradara, raktapradara); four types by doṣa.
terms.hi: असृग्दर (प्रदर) - अत्यधिक या दीर्घ रक्तस्राव; चार प्रकार।
terms.modern: Often compared to menorrhagia and abnormal uterine bleeding.

terms.en: Infertility; may result from defects in ṛtu, kṣetra, ambu or bīja, or from yonivyāpad.
terms.hi: वन्ध्यत्व - बाँझपन; ऋतु, क्षेत्र, अम्बु, बीज की विकृति से।

terms.en: Paediatrics (bāla tantra): care of the newborn and child, breastfeeding and wet-nurse (dhātrī), and children's diseases including grahas. Kāśyapa Saṃhitā is the chief text.
terms.hi: कौमारभृत्य (बाल तन्त्र) - नवजात व बालकों की देखभाल, स्तन्य, धात्री और बाल रोग; मुख्य ग्रन्थ काश्यप संहिता।

terms.en: Child; Vāgbhaṭa classifies by diet: kṣīrapa (milk-fed, up to 1 year), kṣīrānnāda (milk and food, 1 to 2 years) and annāda (food-fed, after 2 years). Not to be confused with bala (strength).
terms.hi: बाल - बालक; क्षीरप (1 वर्ष तक), क्षीरान्नाद (1-2 वर्ष), अन्नाद (2 वर्ष बाद)।
terms.modern: Child; the classification parallels infancy, weaning and early childhood.

terms.en: Newborn care rite: after clearing the airway and cutting the cord, the baby is given honey and ghee (with gold) to lick, and mantras are recited.
terms.hi: जातकर्म - नवजात संस्कार; नाल छेदन के बाद मधु-घृत (स्वर्ण सहित) चटाना।
terms.modern: Neonatal care; giving honey to newborns is now discouraged because of infant botulism risk.

terms.en: Giving fine gold (rubbed or as bhasma) with honey and ghee to children, which Kāśyapa says promotes intellect, digestion, strength, longevity, complexion and immunity.
terms.hi: सुवर्णप्राशन - बालक को स्वर्ण (भस्म) मधु-घृत के साथ चटाना; मेधा, अग्नि, बल, आयु वर्धक।
terms.modern: Claims of immunity and cognitive benefit are not established by robust trials.

terms.en: Giving medicines to infants in a lickable form (with honey, ghee); Kāśyapa devotes a chapter to it.
terms.hi: लेहन - शिशु को चाटने योग्य औषध (मधु-घृत के साथ) देना।

terms.en: Wet-nurse: classical texts describe her qualities (healthy, of same caste, with living children, abundant pure milk). Dhātrī also is a name of āmalakī.
terms.hi: धात्री - धाय (स्तनपान कराने वाली); आमलकी का भी नाम।

terms.en: Vitiation of breast milk; Caraka describes eight defects (e.g. vaivarṇya, vaigandhya, vairasya, picchilya, phenasaṅghāta, raukṣya, gaurava, sneha) and their tests and remedies.
terms.hi: स्तन्य दुष्टि - स्तन्य के आठ दोष (विवर्णता, दुर्गन्ध, विरसता, पिच्छिलता आदि)।

terms.en: Introduction of solid food (weaning), traditionally around the sixth month with light, wholesome food.
terms.hi: अन्नप्राशन - छठे मास के आसपास अन्न आरम्भ।
terms.modern: Introduction of complementary feeding (WHO also recommends about 6 months).

terms.en: Ear-piercing rite for protection and ornament, performed in the sixth or seventh month in a favourable season (Suśruta).
terms.hi: कर्णवेधन - छठे या सातवें मास में कान छेदन (सुश्रुत)।

terms.en: Disorders of children attributed to 'seizers' (grahas) such as skanda and pūtanā, causing fever, convulsions, crying and wasting; Suśruta names nine.
terms.hi: बालग्रह - स्कन्द, पूतना आदि 'ग्रहों' से बालकों के रोग; ज्वर, आक्षेप; सुश्रुत: नौ।
terms.modern: Often interpreted as childhood infections and neonatal illnesses.

terms.en: Kāśyapa's condition of a child who cannot walk even after one year, with emaciation; types are kṣīraja, garbhaja and vyādhija.
terms.hi: फक्क रोग - एक वर्ष बाद भी न चल पाने वाला कृश बालक (काश्यप)।
terms.modern: Often compared to rickets and protein-energy malnutrition.

terms.en: Teething; Kāśyapa describes it as a cause of fever, diarrhoea, cough and other ailments in infants.
terms.hi: दन्तोद्भव - दाँत निकलना; ज्वर, अतिसार आदि का कारण (काश्यप)।
terms.modern: Teething (modern view: it causes only mild symptoms).

terms.en: Toxicology (daṃṣṭrā/viṣa cikitsā): poisons from plants, minerals and animals, their actions, antidotes and treatment; now taught with medical jurisprudence (vyavahāra āyurveda).
terms.hi: अगद तन्त्र - विष विज्ञान (स्थावर, जङ्गम, कृत्रिम विष) और चिकित्सा; विधि वैद्यक सहित।

terms.en: Poison: that which causes sorrow (viṣāda) and death. Arose from the churning of the ocean (Vāgbhaṭa). Types: sthāvara (plant/mineral), jaṅgama (animal) and kṛtrima (artificial/gara).
terms.hi: विष - विषाद (दुःख) और मृत्यु देने वाला; स्थावर, जङ्गम, कृत्रिम।

terms.en: Ten qualities of poison: laghu, rūkṣa, āśu (quick), viśada, vyavāyī, tīkṣṇa, vikāśī, sūkṣma, uṣṇa and anirdeśya rasa (indistinct taste); they are opposite to the qualities of ojas.
terms.hi: विष के दस गुण: लघु, रूक्ष, आशु, विशद, व्यवायी, तीक्ष्ण, विकाशी, सूक्ष्म, उष्ण, अनिर्देश्य रस; ओज के विपरीत।

terms.en: Immobile poisons from plants and minerals; Suśruta lists ten sites (root, leaf, fruit, flower, bark, latex, heartwood, gum, mineral, tuber), e.g. vatsanābha (kanda viṣa).
terms.hi: स्थावर विष - वनस्पति और खनिज विष; दस अधिष्ठान (मूल, पत्र, फल, पुष्प, कन्द आदि)।

terms.en: Animal poisons (snakes, scorpions, spiders, insects, rabid dogs), with 16 sites such as fangs, sting, nails, saliva and urine.
terms.hi: जङ्गम विष - प्राणिज विष (सर्प, वृश्चिक, लूता, कीट, अलर्क); 16 अधिष्ठान।

terms.en: Artificial or compound poison (kṛtrima viṣa), often made from combining non-poisonous substances, given secretly with food; produces chronic symptoms.
terms.hi: गर विष (कृत्रिम) - अविषैले द्रव्यों के संयोग से बना, भोजन में दिया विष; दीर्घकालीन लक्षण।
terms.modern: Comparable to deliberate chronic poisoning or toxic combinations.

terms.en: Weakened, residual poison that remains in the body (because of reduced potency or partial detoxification), not fatal but producing chronic disorders when aggravated by causes like bad weather or diet.
terms.hi: दूषीविष - शरीर में शेष रह गया मन्दवीर्य विष; उत्तेजक कारणों से दीर्घकालीन रोग।
terms.modern: Often compared to cumulative/chronic low-dose toxicity.

terms.en: Semi-poisons, less toxic than mahāviṣas, used medicinally after śodhana: e.g. arka, snuhī, dhattūra, kupīlu, bhallātaka, guñjā, ahiphena (opium), karavīra and lāṅgalī.
terms.hi: उपविष - महाविष से कम विषैले; शोधन के बाद औषध रूप में: अर्क, स्नुही, धत्तूर, कुपीलु, भल्लातक, गुञ्जा।
terms.modern: Toxic medicinal plants requiring processing and dose control.

terms.en: Successive stages of poisoning as the poison advances through the dhātus: seven vegas in snake-bite (Suśruta) and eight (Caraka), with stage-specific treatment.
terms.hi: विषवेग - विष के क्रमिक वेग (सर्पदंश में सात - सुश्रुत; आठ - चरक); प्रत्येक की विशेष चिकित्सा।
terms.modern: Comparable to clinical stages of envenomation.

terms.en: Snake venom. Snakes are darvīkara (hooded, vāta-aggravating), maṇḍalī (with circular marks, pitta-aggravating), rājimanta (striped, kapha-aggravating) plus nirviṣa (non-poisonous) and vaikarañja (hybrid).
terms.hi: सर्प विष - दर्वीकर (फणधारी, वात), मण्डली (पित्त), राजिमन्त (कफ), निर्विष, वैकरञ्ज।
terms.modern: Darvīkara is often compared to elapids (cobras), maṇḍalī to vipers (e.g. Russell's viper), rājimanta to kraits; correlations are approximate.

terms.en: Applying a tourniquet four aṅgulas above the bite to stop the spread of poison; the first of the measures for snake-bite.
terms.hi: अरिष्टाबन्धन - दंश से चार अंगुल ऊपर बन्धन बाँधना; सर्पदंश का प्रथम उपाय।
terms.modern: Tight tourniquets are no longer recommended in snake-bite first aid (risk of ischaemia); pressure immobilisation and antivenom are standard.

terms.en: Caraka's 24 measures in poisoning: mantra, ariṣṭābandhana, utkartana (excision), niṣpīḍana (squeezing), cūṣaṇa (sucking), agni, pariṣeka, avagāha, raktamokṣaṇa, vamana, virecana, upadhāna, hṛdayāvaraṇa, añjana, nasya, dhūma, leha, auṣadha, praśamana, pratisāraṇa, prativiṣa, saṃjñāsthāpana, lepa and mṛtasañjīvana.
terms.hi: चतुर्विंशति उपक्रम - विष चिकित्सा के 24 उपाय (मन्त्र, अरिष्टाबन्धन, उत्कर्तन, चूषण, वमन, प्रतिविष आदि)।
terms.modern: Comparable to a toxicology management protocol (decontamination, elimination, antidotes, supportive care).

terms.en: Disorders from improper or excessive alcohol (madya), whose ten qualities are opposite to those of ojas; four types by doṣa, plus conditions like paramada, pānājīrṇa and pānavibhrama.
terms.hi: मदात्यय - अनुचित/अधिक मद्यपान से रोग; मद्य के दस गुण ओज के विपरीत।
terms.modern: Alcohol-use disorders and alcohol-related conditions (intoxication, withdrawal).

terms.en: Alcoholic drink; has ten qualities (tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa, rūkṣa, sūkṣma, amla, vyavāyī, āśukara, laghu, vikāśī, viśada) that oppose ojas. In proper amounts with food it is dīpana and cheering; in excess it causes madātyaya.
terms.hi: मद्य - शराब; दस गुण (तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण, रूक्ष, सूक्ष्म, अम्ल, व्यवायी, आशुकर, लघु, विकाशी, विशद) ओज के विपरीत।

terms.en: Poisoning from the bite of a rabid dog (alarka); a key sign is fear of water (jalatrāsa), which marks it as incurable.
terms.hi: अलर्क विष - पागल कुत्ते के काटने से विष; जलत्रास होने पर असाध्य।

terms.en: Medical jurisprudence and forensic aspects in Ayurvedic education, including the physician's legal and ethical duties.
terms.hi: व्यवहार आयुर्वेद - विधि वैद्यक; चिकित्सक के कानूनी व नैतिक कर्तव्य।

terms.en: Sound changes when two sounds meet at word or morpheme boundaries, merging words in writing (e.g. vāyuḥ + iti may become vāyur iti; ca + iti = ceti). Three kinds: svara (vowel), vyañjana (consonant) and visarga sandhi. Undoing sandhi is padaccheda.
terms.hi: सन्धि - दो वर्णों के मेल से होने वाला परिवर्तन (च + इति = चेति); स्वर, व्यञ्जन, विसर्ग सन्धि। (शारीर सन्धि से भिन्न)

terms.en: Vowel sandhi, e.g. dīrgha (a + a = ā: deha + adhi), guṇa (a + i = e: ca + iti = ceti), vṛddhi (a + e = ai), yaṇ (i + a = ya: iti + ādi = ityādi).
terms.hi: स्वर सन्धि - स्वरों का मेल; दीर्घ, गुण (च+इति=चेति), वृद्धि, यण् (इति+आदि=इत्यादि)।

terms.en: Consonant sandhi, e.g. t + c = cc (tat + ca = tac ca), final consonants becoming voiced before voiced sounds (vāk + īśa = vāgīśa).
terms.hi: व्यञ्जन सन्धि - व्यञ्जनों का मेल (तत् + च = तच्च; वाक् + ईश = वागीश)।

terms.en: Changes of visarga (ḥ) before following sounds, e.g. kaphaḥ + ca = kaphaś ca; doṣaḥ + api = doṣo 'pi; vāyuḥ + iti = vāyur iti.
terms.hi: विसर्ग सन्धि - विसर्ग का परिवर्तन (कफः + च = कफश्च; दोषः + अपि = दोषोऽपि)।

terms.en: Compound: two or more words joined into one, dropping case endings except at the end (e.g. doṣa-dhātu-malāḥ). Main types: tatpuruṣa, karmadhāraya, dvigu, dvandva, bahuvrīhi and avyayībhāva. Breaking a compound is vigraha.
terms.hi: समास - दो या अधिक पदों का मिलकर एक पद (दोषधातुमलाः); तत्पुरुष, कर्मधारय, द्विगु, द्वन्द्व, बहुव्रीहि, अव्ययीभाव।

terms.en: Analysis of a compound into its parts with case endings (e.g. āyurveda = āyuṣaḥ vedaḥ). Also means body or conflict in other contexts.
terms.hi: विग्रह - समास को विभक्ति सहित अलग करना (आयुर्वेदः = आयुषः वेदः)।

terms.en: Determinative compound where the second member is principal and the first stands in a case relation to it, e.g. rogapati (lord of diseases, ṣaṣṭhī), āyurveda (veda of life).
terms.hi: तत्पुरुष समास - उत्तरपद प्रधान, पूर्वपद में विभक्ति सम्बन्ध (रोगपतिः = रोगाणां पतिः)।

terms.en: Descriptive compound where both members refer to the same thing, usually adjective + noun, e.g. mahābhūta (great element), mandāgni (weak fire).
terms.hi: कर्मधारय समास - विशेषण-विशेष्य (महाभूत, मन्दाग्नि)।

terms.en: Numerical compound with a number as the first member, e.g. tridoṣa, triphalā, pañcakarma, ṣaḍrasa.
terms.hi: द्विगु समास - संख्यावाचक पूर्वपद (त्रिदोष, त्रिफला, पञ्चकर्म)।

terms.en: Copulative compound joining items with 'and', e.g. vāta-pitta-kaphāḥ, rasāsṛṅ-māṃsa-medo-'sthi-majja-śukrāṇi; both/all members are principal.
terms.hi: द्वन्द्व समास - 'और' से जुड़े पद (वातपित्तकफाः, रसासृङ्मांसमेदोऽस्थिमज्जशुक्राणि)।
