terms.en: Possessive compound referring to something outside its members, e.g. bahu-vrīhi 'having much rice' = a rich man; pīta-ambara 'whose garment is yellow' = Kṛṣṇa; sa-viparyayāḥ 'with their opposites'.
terms.hi: बहुव्रीहि समास - अन्य पद प्रधान (पीताम्बरः = पीत वस्त्र वाला, कृष्ण)।

terms.en: Adverbial compound whose first member is an indeclinable, e.g. yathā-śakti (according to strength), prati-dinam (daily).
terms.hi: अव्ययीभाव समास - पूर्वपद अव्यय (यथाशक्ति, प्रतिदिनम्)।

terms.en: Case endings of nouns. Sanskrit has seven cases plus the vocative (sambodhana): prathamā, dvitīyā, tṛtīyā, caturthī, pañcamī, ṣaṣṭhī and saptamī, each in three numbers.
terms.hi: विभक्ति - संज्ञा के कारक-प्रत्यय; प्रथमा से सप्तमी + सम्बोधन; तीन वचन।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Marks the subject (kartā), e.g. doṣaḥ, vāyuḥ.
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। प्रथमा - कर्ता (दोषः, वायुः)।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Marks the object (karma), e.g. annam pacati 'digests food'.
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। द्वितीया - कर्म (अन्नं पचति)।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Means 'by/with', e.g. samānaiḥ 'by similar things', agninā 'by fire'.
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। तृतीया - करण, 'से/द्वारा' (समानैः, अग्निना)।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Means 'for/to', e.g. hitāya 'for the benefit of', āyuṣe 'for life'.
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। चतुर्थी - सम्प्रदान, 'के लिए' (हिताय)।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Means 'from/because of', e.g. prāṇādi-bhedāt 'because of the division into prāṇa etc.'
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। पञ्चमी - अपादान, 'से' (कारण/अलगाव) (प्राणादिभेदात्)।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Means 'of', e.g. vātasya 'of vāta', āyuṣaḥ 'of life'.
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। षष्ठी - सम्बन्ध, 'का/की/के' (वातस्य, आयुषः)।

terms.en: One of the eight vibhaktis (cases) of Sanskrit nouns. Means 'in/on/at', e.g. hṛdi 'in the heart', koṣṭhe 'in the koṣṭha'.
terms.hi: आठ विभक्तियों में एक। सप्तमी - अधिकरण, 'में/पर' (हृदि, कोष्ठे)।

terms.en: The form of address, e.g. 'he agniveśa!' (O Agniveśa).
terms.hi: सम्बोधन - पुकारने का रूप (हे अग्निवेश!)।

terms.en: Grammatical number: ekavacana (singular), dvivacana (dual) and bahuvacana (plural). Dual forms (e.g. vṛkkau 'the two kidneys') often confuse beginners.
terms.hi: वचन - एकवचन, द्विवचन, बहुवचन (वृक्कौ = दो वृक्क)।

terms.en: (1) Grammatical gender: puṃliṅga (masculine, e.g. doṣaḥ), strīliṅga (feminine, e.g. sirā) and napuṃsakaliṅga (neuter, e.g. pittam). (2) In medicine, a sign or symptom (synonym of rūpa).
terms.hi: लिङ्ग - (1) व्याकरण में पुंलिङ्ग, स्त्रीलिङ्ग, नपुंसकलिङ्ग; (2) चिकित्सा में लक्षण।

terms.en: Verbal root from which verbs and nouns are derived, e.g. √car (to move) gives caraka, carati; √pac (to cook) gives pācaka, pācana. Not to be confused with body dhātu or metal.
terms.hi: धातु (व्याकरण) - क्रिया का मूल (√पच् से पाचक, पाचन)। (शरीर धातु से भिन्न)

terms.en: Suffix added to roots or stems to form words (kṛt, taddhita, case and verb endings), e.g. -aka in pācaka. In nidāna, pratyaya is a synonym of cause.
terms.hi: प्रत्यय - धातु/शब्द के बाद जुड़ने वाला अंश (पाचक में -अक); निदान में हेतु का पर्याय।

terms.en: Verbal prefix that modifies a root's meaning, e.g. pra-, vi-, sam-, anu-, ut- (as in pra-kopa, vi-recana, saṃ-śodhana, anu-lomana).
terms.hi: उपसर्ग - धातु से पहले जुड़कर अर्थ बदलने वाले (प्र, वि, सम्, अनु, उत्)।

terms.en: Indeclinable words that do not change form, e.g. ca (and), tu (but), hi (indeed/because), eva (only), api (also), iti (thus), atha (now). Recognising them helps parse ślokas.
terms.hi: अव्यय - जो रूप न बदलें: च, तु, हि, एव, अपि, इति, अथ।

terms.en: Particle meaning 'thus', closing a quotation or list (e.g. vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti 'vāyu, pitta and kapha - thus'); also ends chapters ('iti ... adhyāyaḥ').
terms.hi: इति - 'इस प्रकार'; उद्धरण या सूची का अन्त; अध्याय समाप्ति।

terms.en: 'Now, therefore': the opening formula of many chapters, e.g. 'athāto dīrghañjīvitīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' (now we shall explain the chapter on long life). It marks auspicious beginning and connection with the previous chapter.
terms.hi: अथातो - 'अब इसलिए'; अध्याय आरम्भ का सूत्र (अथातो दीर्घञ्जीवितीयमध्यायं व्याख्यास्यामः)।

terms.en: 'Thus indeed said the venerable Ātreya': the formula after the opening of each Caraka chapter, showing the teaching is Ātreya's as compiled by Agniveśa.
terms.hi: इति ह स्माह भगवानात्रेयः - 'ऐसा भगवान आत्रेय ने कहा'; चरक के प्रत्येक अध्याय के आरम्भ में।

terms.en: The sign ऽ (') marking an elided initial 'a' after sandhi, e.g. doṣo 'pi = doṣaḥ + api; medo-'sthi = medas + asthi.
terms.hi: अवग्रह (ऽ) - सन्धि में लुप्त 'अ' का चिह्न (दोषोऽपि = दोषः + अपि)।

terms.en: The sign ः (ḥ), a breathy sound after a vowel, common at word end (vāyuḥ, doṣāḥ); it changes by visarga sandhi.
terms.hi: विसर्ग (ः) - शब्दान्त में प्रायः (वायुः, दोषाः); विसर्ग सन्धि से बदलता है।

terms.en: The dot ं (ṃ) representing a nasal after a vowel (pittaṃ, saṃśodhana); before consonants it may be written as the corresponding nasal (saṅgraha / saṃgraha).
terms.hi: अनुस्वार (ं) - स्वर के बाद नासिक्य ध्वनि (पित्तं, संशोधन)।

terms.en: The sign ् (virāma) showing a consonant without its inherent vowel, e.g. vāk (वाक्), marut (मरुत्).
terms.hi: हलन्त (्) - व्यञ्जन बिना स्वर के (वाक्, मरुत्)।

terms.en: International Alphabet of Sanskrit Transliteration: Roman letters with diacritics (ā, ī, ū, ṛ, ṃ, ḥ, ś, ṣ, ṭ, ḍ, ṇ, ñ, ṅ) to write Sanskrit unambiguously; e.g. 'ś' as in śarīra, 'ṣ' as in doṣa, 'c' always like English 'ch'.
terms.hi: IAST - संस्कृत को रोमन अक्षरों में लिखने की मानक पद्धति (ā, ś, ṣ, ṭ आदि); 'c' = 'च'।

terms.en: The script in which Sanskrit (and Hindi) is commonly written, with consonants carrying an inherent 'a' and vowel signs (mātrā) attached to them.
terms.hi: देवनागरी - संस्कृत/हिन्दी की लिपि; व्यञ्जन में अन्तर्निहित 'अ' और मात्राएँ।

terms.en: A terse aphorism that holds much meaning in few words, like a thread (sūtra) holding flowers; also the Sūtrasthāna, the foundational section of the saṃhitās.
terms.hi: सूत्र - कम शब्दों में अधिक अर्थ वाला वाक्य; सूत्रस्थान (मूल सिद्धान्त भाग)।

terms.en: A verse, usually in the anuṣṭubh metre of four quarters (pādas) of eight syllables; most of the Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya is in ślokas. Prose passages are gadya.
terms.hi: श्लोक - पद्य, प्रायः अनुष्टुप् छन्द (चार पाद, प्रत्येक में आठ अक्षर); गद्य = पद्य-रहित।

terms.en: One of the four quarters of a śloka (a, b, c, d); the dividers | and || (daṇḍa) mark half and full verse. (Pada also means a word.)
terms.hi: पाद - श्लोक का चौथाई भाग (a, b, c, d); । अर्धश्लोक, ॥ पूर्ण श्लोक।

terms.en: Metre: the pattern of syllable count and weight in a verse, e.g. anuṣṭubh, indravajrā, upajāti, vasantatilakā (some chapter-ending verses use longer metres).
terms.hi: छन्द - पद्य में अक्षरों की संख्या और गुरु-लघु क्रम (अनुष्टुप्, उपजाति, वसन्ततिलका)।

terms.en: The commonest Sanskrit metre: four pādas of eight syllables (32 syllables), with the sixth syllable usually long and the fifth short in each pāda.
terms.hi: अनुष्टुप् छन्द - चार पाद × आठ अक्षर = 32 अक्षर; सबसे प्रचलित छन्द।

terms.en: Rearranging the words of a verse into natural prose order (subject, object, verb) so that its meaning is clear; the first step in understanding a śloka after padaccheda.
terms.hi: अन्वय - श्लोक के पदों को गद्य क्रम (कर्ता-कर्म-क्रिया) में लगाना।

terms.en: Splitting a verse into separate words by undoing sandhi (and noting compounds), e.g. 'kaphaś ceti' = kaphaḥ + ca + iti.
terms.hi: पदच्छेद - सन्धि-विच्छेद कर श्लोक के पद अलग करना (कफश्चेति = कफः + च + इति)।

terms.en: Commentary explaining a text, e.g. Cakrapāṇi's Āyurvedadīpikā on Caraka, Ḍalhaṇa's Nibandhasaṅgraha on Suśruta, Aruṇadatta's Sarvāṅgasundarā and Hemādri's Āyurvedarasāyana on the Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya.
terms.hi: टीका - ग्रन्थ की व्याख्या (चक्रपाणि - आयुर्वेददीपिका; डल्हण - निबन्धसंग्रह; अरुणदत्त - सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरा; हेमाद्रि - आयुर्वेदरसायन)।

terms.en: Explanation/commentary in general (bhāṣya is a detailed commentary, vṛtti a brief one); modern Hindi commentaries (e.g. Vidyotinī) help students.
terms.hi: व्याख्या - टीका/स्पष्टीकरण; भाष्य (विस्तृत), वृत्ति (संक्षिप्त)।

terms.en: Chapter. Caraka's 120 chapters are grouped into eight sthānas; chapter names usually come from the opening words (e.g. dīrghañjīvitīya, āyuṣkāmīya).
terms.hi: अध्याय - ग्रन्थ का अध्याय; नाम प्रायः प्रारम्भिक शब्दों से (दीर्घञ्जीवितीय, आयुष्कामीय)।

terms.en: Major section of a saṃhitā. Caraka has eight: sūtra, nidāna, vimāna, śārīra, indriya, cikitsā, kalpa and siddhi; Suśruta has five plus uttaratantra (sūtra, nidāna, śārīra, cikitsā, kalpa); the Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya has six (sūtra, śārīra, nidāna, cikitsā, kalpa-siddhi, uttara).
terms.hi: स्थान - संहिता का बड़ा भाग; चरक: आठ स्थान; सुश्रुत: पाँच + उत्तरतन्त्र; अष्टाङ्गहृदय: छह।

terms.en: A compiled classical treatise (literally 'collection'), e.g. Caraka Saṃhitā, Suśruta Saṃhitā, Kāśyapa Saṃhitā.
terms.hi: संहिता - संकलित शास्त्रीय ग्रन्थ (चरक, सुश्रुत, काश्यप संहिता)।

terms.en: Methodological devices for composing and interpreting scientific texts; Caraka lists 36 and Suśruta 32 (e.g. adhikaraṇa, yoga, padārtha, uddeśa, nirdeśa, upadeśa, apadeśa, atideśa). They help read concise ślokas correctly.
terms.hi: तन्त्रयुक्ति - शास्त्र-रचना व अर्थ-ग्रहण की युक्तियाँ; चरक: 36 (अधिकरण, योग, उद्देश, निर्देश आदि)।
terms.modern: Comparable to rules of textual interpretation (hermeneutics).

terms.en: Synonym; classical texts give many synonyms for each term (e.g. vāta = vāyu, anila, māruta, pavana, samīraṇa), so recognising paryāyas is essential when reading ślokas.
terms.hi: पर्याय - समानार्थी शब्द (वात = वायु, अनिल, मारुत, पवन, समीरण)।

terms.en: Formal scholarly debate; Caraka describes rules of discussion (sambhāṣā), friendly (sandhāya) and hostile (vigṛhya) debate, and 44 vāda-mārga terms (e.g. pratijñā, sthāpanā, hetu, dṛṣṭānta).
terms.hi: वाद - शास्त्रार्थ; सन्धाय और विगृह्य सम्भाषा; 44 वादमार्ग पद।

terms.en: Internal medicine, the first branch of aṣṭāṅga āyurveda; 'kāya' also means agni, so it is the treatment of diseases arising from disturbed agni throughout the body. Caraka Saṃhitā is its main text.
terms.hi: कायचिकित्सा - आन्तरिक चिकित्सा; अष्टाङ्ग आयुर्वेद का प्रथम अंग; मुख्य ग्रन्थ चरक संहिता।

terms.en: Branch (graha cikitsā) dealing with disorders attributed to bhūtas and grahas (unseen agents), treated by daivavyapāśraya and medicines; today often linked with psychiatry.
terms.hi: भूतविद्या (ग्रह चिकित्सा) - भूत-ग्रह जन्य विकारों की चिकित्सा; आज मनोरोग से सम्बद्ध।
terms.modern: Often related to psychiatry and some infectious conditions.

terms.en: 'The great three' classics: Caraka Saṃhitā, Suśruta Saṃhitā and Aṣṭāṅga Hṛdaya (some include Aṣṭāṅga Saṅgraha).
terms.hi: बृहत्त्रयी - चरक संहिता, सुश्रुत संहिता, अष्टाङ्गहृदय।

terms.en: 'The lesser three' classics: Mādhava Nidāna, Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā and Bhāvaprakāśa.
terms.hi: लघुत्रयी - माधव निदान, शार्ङ्गधर संहिता, भावप्रकाश।

terms.en: The foundational text of kāyacikitsā: Ātreya's teaching compiled by Agniveśa (Agniveśa Tantra), redacted by Caraka and completed by Dṛḍhabala; 8 sthānas and 120 chapters.
terms.hi: चरक संहिता - आत्रेय का उपदेश, अग्निवेश द्वारा संकलित, चरक द्वारा प्रतिसंस्कृत, दृढबल द्वारा पूरित; 8 स्थान, 120 अध्याय।

terms.en: Redactor (pratisaṃskartā) of the Agniveśa Tantra, which became the Caraka Saṃhitā; usually dated around the early centuries CE.
terms.hi: चरक - अग्निवेश तन्त्र के प्रतिसंस्कर्ता; चरक संहिता।

terms.en: Kashmiri scholar who completed the Caraka Saṃhitā by adding 17 chapters of Cikitsāsthāna and the whole of Kalpa and Siddhi sthānas.
terms.hi: दृढबल - चरक संहिता के पूरक; चिकित्सा के 17 अध्याय तथा कल्प और सिद्धि स्थान जोड़े।

terms.en: Sage-teacher whose teachings form the Caraka Saṃhitā; leader of the school of medicine (kāyacikitsā). His six disciples included Agniveśa, Bheḍa (Bhela), Jatūkarṇa, Parāśara, Hārīta and Kṣārapāṇi.
terms.hi: आत्रेय पुनर्वसु - चरक संहिता के उपदेष्टा; छह शिष्य: अग्निवेश, भेड, जतूकर्ण, पराशर, हारीत, क्षारपाणि।

terms.en: Foremost disciple of Ātreya, who composed the Agniveśa Tantra, the basis of the Caraka Saṃhitā.
terms.hi: अग्निवेश - आत्रेय के प्रमुख शिष्य; अग्निवेश तन्त्र के रचयिता।

terms.en: Treatise of Bheḍa (Bhela), a fellow disciple of Agniveśa; survives incompletely.
terms.hi: भेल संहिता - आत्रेय के शिष्य भेल की संहिता; अपूर्ण उपलब्ध।

terms.en: The foundational text of śalya tantra: teaching of Dhanvantari (as Divodāsa, king of Kāśī) to Suśruta; five sthānas plus uttaratantra; redacted later by Nāgārjuna according to Ḍalhaṇa.
terms.hi: सुश्रुत संहिता - शल्य तन्त्र का मूल ग्रन्थ; धन्वन्तरि (दिवोदास) का सुश्रुत को उपदेश; पाँच स्थान + उत्तरतन्त्र।

terms.en: Disciple of Dhanvantari (Divodāsa) and author of the Suśruta Saṃhitā; honoured as the father of Indian surgery.
terms.hi: सुश्रुत - धन्वन्तरि (दिवोदास) के शिष्य; सुश्रुत संहिता के रचयिता; शल्य चिकित्सा के जनक।

terms.en: Divine physician who emerged with nectar from the churning of the ocean; reborn as Divodāsa, king of Kāśī, who taught surgery to Suśruta. Regarded as the god of Āyurveda.
terms.hi: धन्वन्तरि - समुद्र मन्थन से अमृत सहित प्रकट; काशीराज दिवोदास रूप में सुश्रुत के गुरु; आयुर्वेद के देवता।

terms.en: Author of the Aṣṭāṅga Hṛdaya (and traditionally the Aṣṭāṅga Saṅgraha, attributed to an elder Vāgbhaṭa by some), from Sindh, around the 6th-7th century CE; he synthesised Caraka and Suśruta.
terms.hi: वाग्भट - अष्टाङ्गहृदय के रचयिता (अष्टाङ्ग संग्रह भी); सिन्धु देश, लगभग 6-7वीं शताब्दी; चरक-सुश्रुत का समन्वय।

terms.en: Vāgbhaṭa's verse compendium of all eight branches, 'neither too brief nor too long', in six sthānas and 120 chapters; widely memorised and the main text in Kerala tradition.
terms.hi: अष्टाङ्गहृदय - वाग्भट का पद्यात्मक ग्रन्थ; आठों अंग; छह स्थान, 120 अध्याय।

terms.en: Larger prose-and-verse compendium attributed to Vāgbhaṭa (Vṛddha Vāgbhaṭa), with Indu's commentary Śaśilekhā.
terms.hi: अष्टाङ्ग संग्रह - वाग्भट (वृद्ध वाग्भट) का गद्य-पद्य ग्रन्थ; इन्दु की शशिलेखा टीका।

terms.en: 13th-14th century text by Śārṅgadhara in three khaṇḍas, the key reference for pharmaceutics (kalpanās, measures), and an early source for pulse examination.
terms.hi: शार्ङ्गधर संहिता - 13-14वीं शताब्दी; तीन खण्ड; भैषज्य कल्पना और मान का मुख्य ग्रन्थ; नाडी परीक्षा का प्रारम्भिक स्रोत।

terms.en: 16th-century compendium by Bhāvamiśra, with a widely used nighaṇṭu; it includes newer items like phiraṅga roga (syphilis) and new drugs.
terms.hi: भावप्रकाश - भावमिश्र (16वीं शताब्दी); प्रसिद्ध निघण्टु; फिरङ्ग रोग का वर्णन।

terms.en: Classical text of paediatrics and obstetrics (Vṛddha Jīvakīya Tantra), teaching of Kaśyapa recorded by Vṛddha Jīvaka; survives incompletely. Describes lehana, suvarṇaprāśana, phakka and teething.
terms.hi: काश्यप संहिता (वृद्धजीवकीय तन्त्र) - बाल व प्रसूति का ग्रन्थ; लेहन, सुवर्णप्राशन, फक्क, दन्तोद्भव।

terms.en: 11th-century Bengali commentator who wrote Āyurvedadīpikā on the Caraka Saṃhitā (and Bhānumatī on Suśruta) and the formulary Cakradatta.
terms.hi: चक्रपाणिदत्त - 11वीं शताब्दी; चरक पर आयुर्वेददीपिका टीका; चक्रदत्त ग्रन्थ।

terms.en: 12th-century commentator whose Nibandhasaṅgraha is the standard commentary on the Suśruta Saṃhitā.
terms.hi: डल्हण - 12वीं शताब्दी; सुश्रुत संहिता पर निबन्धसंग्रह टीका।

terms.en: 13th-century commentator; his Sarvāṅgasundarā is a standard commentary on the Aṣṭāṅga Hṛdaya.
terms.hi: अरुणदत्त - अष्टाङ्गहृदय पर सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरा टीका।

terms.en: 13th-century scholar whose Āyurvedarasāyana commentary on the Aṣṭāṅga Hṛdaya is widely used.
terms.hi: हेमाद्रि - अष्टाङ्गहृदय पर आयुर्वेदरसायन टीका।

terms.en: The lineage by which Āyurveda came to humans: Brahmā to Dakṣa Prajāpati, then the Aśvins, Indra, and through Bharadvāja (Caraka) to Ātreya and his disciples; in Suśruta, Indra to Dhanvantari (Divodāsa).
terms.hi: आयुर्वेदावतरण - ब्रह्मा → दक्ष प्रजापति → अश्विनीकुमार → इन्द्र → भरद्वाज → आत्रेय (चरक); सुश्रुत: इन्द्र → धन्वन्तरि।

terms.en: Twin divine physicians who learned Āyurveda from Dakṣa and taught it to Indra; famed for restoring sage Cyavana's youth.
terms.hi: अश्विनीकुमार - देवताओं के युगल वैद्य; दक्ष से आयुर्वेद सीखा, इन्द्र को सिखाया; च्यवन ऋषि को यौवन दिया।

terms.en: Sage who, according to Caraka, went to Indra on behalf of the assembled sages and brought Āyurveda to the earth.
terms.hi: भरद्वाज - चरक के अनुसार इन्द्र से आयुर्वेद पृथ्वी पर लाने वाले ऋषि।

terms.en: Depletion of ojas, caused by anger, hunger, worry, grief, exertion etc.; signs: fearfulness, weakness, anxiety, impaired senses, poor complexion, dryness and emaciation. Suśruta describes three stages of ojas disorder: visraṃsa, vyāpat and kṣaya.
terms.hi: ओजः क्षय - क्रोध, क्षुधा, चिन्ता, शोक, श्रम से; भय, दुर्बलता, इन्द्रिय-व्यथा, कृशता; सुश्रुत: विस्रंस, व्यापत्, क्षय।
terms.modern: Often compared to states of lowered immunity and exhaustion.

terms.en: Processing that transforms the qualities of a substance (guṇāntarādhāna), e.g. by water, heat, churning, trituration, time, container, or impregnation; one of the parādi guṇas and the karaṇa factor of diet. Also: rite of passage and the purificatory processes of mercury.
terms.hi: संस्कार - द्रव्य के गुणों में परिवर्तन करने वाली प्रक्रिया (गुणान्तराधान): जल, अग्नि, मन्थन, भावना, काल आदि से।
terms.modern: Comparable to pharmaceutical processing that alters a substance's properties.

terms.en: India's Ministry of Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa and Homoeopathy; NCISM regulates Indian-system medical education including BAMS.
terms.hi: आयुष - आयुर्वेद, योग, यूनानी, सिद्ध, सोवा-रिग्पा, होम्योपैथी मन्त्रालय; NCISM बीएएमएस शिक्षा का नियामक।
